66312.recognize_zh: 左側細胞比旁邊的小淋巴球大，細胞核圓形偏在一側、染色質呈粗塊狀，細胞質豐富呈灰藍色；偏心核加粗塊染色質與豐富細胞質，符合漿細胞或淋巴漿細胞樣細胞，在周邊血中出現需考慮淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤等疾病。
features: Cell larger than the adjacent small lymphocyte with a round, eccentrically placed nucleus
Coarse, clumped chromatin with small areas of parachromatin clearing; no nucleoli
Abundant grey-blue cytoplasm, paler than a classic plasma cell, with an indistinct perinuclear hof
Adjacent small mature lymphocyte with dense chromatin and a thin rim of basophilic cytoplasm
Background normocytic red cells without definite rouleaux; scattered normal platelets
66312.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic red cells without definite rouleaux formation and adequate scattered platelets. There is a plasmacytoid cell with a round, eccentric nucleus, coarsely clumped chromatin, and abundant grey-blue cytoplasm; the perinuclear hof is not conspicuous and the cytoplasm is less basophilic than a classic mature plasma cell. An adjacent small mature lymphocyte is present for comparison. Findings are consistent with a circulating plasma cell/plasmacytoid lymphocyte, which in the reported clinical context of an IgM-lambda paraprotein and marrow lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate supports lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasmacytosis (viral infection, sepsis, serum sickness)
ddx.vs: Reactive circulating plasma cells are polytypic on flow cytometry and resolve with the underlying illness, whereas LPL shows a light chain-restricted B-cell and plasma cell population with IgM paraprotein.
Plasma cell leukemia shows many circulating clonal plasma cells without a CD19+ B-cell component, typically with IgG/IgA or light chain paraprotein rather than IgM.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; MYD88 L265P mutation, IgM paraprotein and a diffuse marrow pattern favor LPL, while splenic or extranodal involvement and absent MYD88 favor MZL.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm that scallops around red cells with a centrally placed nucleus and more open chromatin rather than an eccentric nucleus with clumped chromatin.

66120.recognize_zh: 上方單核球與下方嗜中性球胞質內都有數個金黃褐色、細小棒狀的折光性結晶，而左下另一顆白血球沒有；背景紅血球呈鋸齒狀，符合高膽紅素血症時白血球內的膽紅素結晶。
features: Monocyte (top) with irregular nucleus and gray-blue cytoplasm containing several small golden-yellow rod-shaped crystals
Neutrophil (bottom) with lobulated nucleus and similar golden crystals over nucleus and cytoplasm
A band/segmented leukocyte at lower left without visible crystals
Background crenated red cells; a degenerated brownish cell remnant in the center
Image is low resolution and slightly blurred
66120.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows crenated red cells and three leukocytes. A monocyte and a neutrophil each contain several small, golden-yellow, refractile, rod-shaped intracytoplasmic crystals, while a third leukocyte lacks them; a degenerated brownish cell remnant is also present. The low image resolution limits detailed crystal morphology. Findings are consistent with bilirubin crystals within neutrophils and monocytes, associated with marked hyperbilirubinemia.

ddx.vs: Hemosiderin is granular golden-brown to blue-black and Prussian blue-positive, whereas bilirubin crystals are yellow rods that are iron-negative.
Hemozoin is brown-black granular pigment with parasitized red cells, which are not seen here.
Stain precipitate is purple-black and deposits randomly over cells and background, not as yellow intracytoplasmic rods.

66056.recognize_zh: 這不是形態圖，而是血球計數儀的體積分布直方圖：RBC 曲線主峰約在 80–90 fL，但右側有一條延伸到 300 fL 以上、未回到基線的長尾巴，代表凝集成對或成團的紅血球被當成大顆粒計算；WBC 曲線在最左端（約 35 fL）出現異常尖峰，提示小顆粒干擾。
features: RBC histogram: main peak near 80–90 fL with a prolonged right-sided tail extending beyond 300 fL that does not return to baseline (doublets/aggregates)
WBC histogram: sharp spike at the lower threshold (~35 fL) followed by a small lymphocyte peak and a dominant granulocyte peak near 300 fL
The low-end WBC spike indicates interference by small particles at the lymphocyte threshold
PLT histogram: peak around 4–5 fL with right skew and a tail approaching baseline near 20 fL; no marked abnormality evident on this plot alone
66056.describe_en: This figure shows automated analyzer volume histograms rather than morphology. The RBC histogram has a main peak at approximately 80–90 fL with an abnormally long right-sided tail extending past 300 fL, indicating red cell doublets and aggregates counted as single large particles; this pattern falsely lowers the RBC count and hematocrit and falsely raises the MCV and MCHC. The WBC histogram shows a spike at the lower threshold of about 35 fL, indicating interference by small particles in the lymphocyte region, while the platelet histogram shows a right-skewed curve that is not clearly abnormal on its own. In context with visible agglutination on the smear, these findings are consistent with cold agglutinin interference; rewarming the sample to 37 °C and re-running is recommended.

ddx.vs: Platelet clumps give a platelet histogram that does not return to baseline at the upper end and a spike at the WBC lower threshold, with platelet aggregates on the smear rather than red cell agglutinates.

ddx.dx: Dimorphic red cell population (transfusion, treated deficiency)
ddx.vs: A dimorphic population shows a second discrete peak or broad shoulder within the physiologic range, not a flat tail extending to very large volumes that resolves on warming.

ddx.dx: Nucleated red cells or giant platelets
ddx.vs: NRBCs and giant platelets also cause a WBC lower-threshold spike but are identified on smear review and do not produce a prolonged RBC histogram tail.

65672.recognize_zh: 右側大圖一顆大細胞內染色質凝集成兩團不規則、邊緣參差的塊狀，屬分裂中期至後期的有絲分裂像（mitotic figure），周圍為骨髓細胞與後骨髓細胞；多極紡錘在此解析度下無法確認，僅能說是可疑異常分裂。
features: Right panel: large cell with abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm containing two separated, irregular, condensed chromatin masses (anaphase/telophase-like mitotic figure)
Chromatin masses are ragged and asymmetric; spindle poles are not resolvable
Surrounding granulocytic precursors (myelocytes/metamyelocytes) with pink granular cytoplasm
Lower left panel: cell with two separate condensed nuclear/chromatin clumps in granular cytoplasm
Upper left panel: large round cell with granular cytoplasm and indistinct chromatin next to two small dense erythroid precursors
Image quality and pink cast limit detailed chromatin assessment
65672.describe_en: Marrow aspirate smear shows granulocytic precursors at myelocyte and metamyelocyte stages. Several cells show mitotic activity, including a large cell with two separated, irregular, condensed chromatin masses in an anaphase/telophase-like configuration, and another cell with two condensed chromatin clumps. The chromatin masses appear ragged and asymmetric, but multipolar spindles cannot be confidently resolved at this image quality. Isolated mitoses are not specific; atypical mitotic figures together with multilineage dysplasia and cytopenias are suggestive of, but not diagnostic for, a myelodysplastic neoplasm, which requires blast count, dysplasia quantitation, and cytogenetic/molecular correlation.

ddx.dx: Normal mitoses in a regenerating marrow
ddx.vs: Normal mitoses show a symmetric bipolar metaphase plate or two equal daughter chromatin sets, whereas atypical mitoses show asymmetric, multipolar or lagging chromatin.
Megaloblastic marrow shows nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, giant metamyelocytes and increased mitoses, reversible with B12/folate replacement.
Apoptotic cells have multiple round, smooth, dense nuclear fragments with condensed eosinophilic cytoplasm rather than elongated ragged chromosome masses.
These have intact nuclear membranes with smooth-contoured lobes, whereas mitotic chromatin lacks a nuclear membrane and appears as irregular chromosome clumps.

65800.recognize_zh: 油鏡下多數紅血球內有一至數個大小不一的小型透亮空泡，單獨或成群分佈、未見內含物，病人為脾臟切除後一個月，符合脾臟移除後無法清除的紅血球空泡（pits/vesicles）；中央另有一團破碎的紫色顆粒狀細胞/血小板聚集。
features: Many red cells contain one to several small, sharply outlined clear vacuoles of varying size, single or clustered
Vacuoles lack stainable inclusions
Some red cells crenated (echinocytic) with a few pointed/teardrop-like forms
A central irregular purple granular structure, likely a smudged leukocyte or platelet aggregate
Scattered small platelet clumps in the background
65800.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows numerous red cells containing small, clear, sharply demarcated vacuoles that vary in size and number and occur singly or in clusters, without visible inclusions. Some red cells are crenated, and a smudged granular cell or platelet aggregate is present centrally with scattered platelet clumps. In a patient one month after splenectomy, the vacuoles are compatible with red cell pits/autophagic vesicles normally removed by the spleen; drying artifact should be excluded by reviewing a well-prepared smear.

ddx.vs: Artifactual refractile holes are highly refractile, change with focusing, and cluster in poorly dried areas, whereas true vacuoles are consistent across the smear.
Howell-Jolly bodies are dense round purple DNA remnants, not clear vacuoles, although both reflect hyposplenism.
Pappenheimer bodies are small clustered basophilic granules that stain with Prussian blue, rather than clear spaces.
Stomatocytes have a single slit-like central pallor rather than multiple discrete round vacuoles.

65736.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞圖：CD45/SSC 圖分出 CD45 亮的淋巴球群與 CD45 較暗的母細胞群；淋巴球中的 B 細胞為 CD5+ 且 CD20 偏弱（CLL 表型），母細胞群則 CD34+、CD117+、CD33+、CD13-，代表同時存在的髓系母細胞。
features: CD45 vs SSC: lymphocyte gate (bright CD45, low SSC) and a distinct CD45-dim, low-SSC blast gate
Lymphocyte gate: CD19+ B cells separated from CD3+ T cells
Gated B cells: uniformly CD5-positive with dim CD20
Gated blasts: CD34-positive with dim to moderate CD117
Gated blasts: CD33-positive and CD13-negative
65736.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plots show two abnormal populations. In the lymphocyte gate, CD19+ B cells are uniformly CD5-positive with dim CD20, a pattern typical of chronic lymphocytic leukemia (the report adds CD43+, CD81-negative and dim lambda restriction). A separate CD45-dim, low side-scatter blast population expresses CD34, dim CD117 and CD33 without CD13, consistent with myeloblasts. Interpreted with the morphology, karyotype and NGS results, the findings support concurrent CLL and a therapy-related high-grade myeloid neoplasm.

ddx.vs: MCL is also CD5+ but has brighter CD20 and surface light chain, is usually CD23-negative/CD200-negative, and carries cyclin D1/CCND1 rearrangement.
Hematogones form a continuous CD34/CD10/CD19 maturation spectrum rather than a discrete CD34+/CD117+/CD33+ myeloid blast cluster lacking CD19.

64776.recognize_zh: 新亞甲藍超活體染色下，部分紅血球內布滿均勻細小、平均分布的藍色點狀包涵體，外觀像高爾夫球表面（golf ball），即 HbH 包涵體；另有少數細胞內是粗大不規則的網狀藍色物質，屬網狀紅血球，要區分開來。
features: Many red cells with numerous fine, evenly distributed blue-green stippled inclusions (golf-ball appearance)
Inclusions are uniform in size and diffusely distributed over the whole cell
Scattered cells with coarser, irregular dark blue reticular or granular precipitates consistent with reticulocytes
Red cells appear small with variation in size
Supravital staining with pale blue background; no nucleated cells in this field
64776.describe_en: Supravital new methylene blue preparation of peripheral blood shows numerous red cells containing multiple fine, uniform, evenly distributed blue inclusions imparting a golf-ball appearance, characteristic of precipitated hemoglobin H (beta-4 tetramers). Separate cells contain coarser, irregular dark blue reticular material, consistent with reticulocytes. Red cells appear small and variable in size. Findings are consistent with hemoglobin H disease; confirmation by hemoglobin electrophoresis/HPLC and alpha-globin gene analysis is recommended.

ddx.vs: Reticulocytes show coarse, irregular, filamentous or clumped blue reticulum rather than fine evenly spaced golf-ball dots.
Heinz bodies are one to a few larger inclusions attached to the membrane periphery, not numerous fine uniform dots.
Alpha-thalassemia trait shows only rare or no HbH inclusions after prolonged incubation, compared with frequent inclusions in HbH disease.
Basophilic stippling is seen on Romanowsky-stained smears and represents ribosomal RNA, not a supravital hemoglobin precipitate.

exam.answer_en: Hemoglobin H disease — supravital stain showing golf-ball HbH (beta-4) inclusions, distinct from reticulocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指「高爾夫球狀」細胞問是什麼包涵體、用什麼染色；答 HbH inclusions（β4 tetramer 沉澱），brilliant cresyl blue 或 new methylene blue 超活體染色並孵育。
遺傳：3 個 α-globin gene 失去功能（如 --/-α）；台灣與東南亞常見 --SEA deletion 合併 -α3.7 或 -α4.2。
新生兒期表現為 Hb Bart's（γ4）上升；成人以 HPLC/電泳見 fast-moving HbH band，確診靠 α-globin 基因分析。
臨床：慢性小球性溶血性貧血、脾腫大；感染、氧化性藥物或發燒時可急性溶血加重。
CBC 陷阱（本題分類）：小紅血球與紅血球碎片可被分析儀誤算為血小板，造成血小板假性偏高。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與網狀紅血球混淆：網狀紅血球為粗大不規則網狀藍色物質；Heinz bodies 則為少數較大、貼細胞膜邊緣的顆粒（crystal violet 染）。

quiz.q: 圖中呈均勻細點「高爾夫球」外觀的紅血球包涵體成分為何？病人缺少幾個 α-globin 基因？
quiz.a: HbH（β4 tetramer）沉澱；3 個 α-globin 基因失去功能。

65544.recognize_zh: 這是四格組合圖：A 周邊血可見大型芽細胞樣淋巴瘤細胞，細胞質深藍、核內有明顯核仁；B 流式顯示單株 kappa、CD19/CD20 陽性且 CD5 陽性、CD10/TdT/CD34 陰性；C 骨髓切片為大細胞瀰漫取代；D 光學基因圖譜顯示 MYC、BCL2、BCL6 與 IGH 融合。這些合起來支持 CD5 陽性、帶 MYC/BCL2/BCL6 重組的高惡性度 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Panel A (PB, Wright-Giemsa): large atypical lymphoid cells, 2–3 times RBC size, with round to indented nuclei, vesicular chromatin, conspicuous nucleoli and a rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Panel B (flow): CD45+ population that is CD19+, CD20+, CD38+, CD5+, CD10−, CD34−, TdT−, MPO− with kappa light chain restriction
Panel C (BM biopsy, H&E): diffuse sheets of large cells with vesicular nuclei and nucleoli replacing the marrow
Panel D (optical genome mapping): circos plot with multiple inter-chromosomal translocations; table lists BCL6::IGH::MYC, IGH::BCL2 and CDKN2A deletion
Background PB red cells show poikilocytes including crenated forms
65544.describe_en: Composite figure. Peripheral blood smear shows numerous large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular chromatin, prominent nucleoli and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, some mimicking blasts. Flow cytometry demonstrates a kappa-restricted mature B-cell population (CD19+, CD20+, CD38+) with aberrant CD5 expression and lack of CD10, CD34 and TdT. The bone marrow biopsy is replaced by diffuse sheets of large cells, and optical genome mapping shows rearrangements juxtaposing MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 with IGH. Findings are consistent with CD5-positive high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 rearrangements (DLBCL/HGBL with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements) in leukemic phase.

ddx.dx: Pleomorphic or blastoid mantle cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Blastoid MCL is also CD5+ and can be leukemic but is cyclin D1 and SOX11 positive with t(11;14), both of which were negative here.
Richter transformation arises from a CD5+/CD23+ CLL clone with dim surface immunoglobulin and prior CLL history, and double-hit rearrangements are uncommon.
B-ALL blasts express TdT and/or CD34 and lack surface light chains, whereas these cells are TdT−, CD34− and kappa restricted.
Burkitt lymphoma is CD10+, BCL2−, with isolated MYC::IG rearrangement and uniform medium-sized cells with lipid vacuoles, rather than CD5+/CD10− cells with concurrent BCL2 rearrangement.

65224.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的紅血球內，各有一顆單一、小而圓、深紫色的點狀包涵體，通常靠近細胞邊緣，就是 Howell-Jolly body。背景紅血球大小形狀不一，可見棘狀細胞、碎片與標靶樣細胞，提示脾功能低下或其他紅血球生成異常。
features: Single, small (about 1 µm), round, dense dark purple inclusion within several red cells (arrows), often eccentric
One inclusion per cell, sharply defined and uniform, unlike fine diffuse stippling
Marked anisopoikilocytosis with echinocytes/acanthocyte-like cells, irregular fragments and target-like cells
Scattered platelets in the background; no nucleated cells in this field
65224.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with crenated and spiculated red cells, irregular red cell fragments and occasional target-like forms. Several red cells contain a single small, round, dense basophilic inclusion, typically located near the cell periphery, consistent with Howell-Jolly bodies. Platelets are present and nucleated red cells are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with Howell-Jolly bodies, suggesting hyposplenism/asplenia or dyserythropoiesis; correlation with splenic status is recommended.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are multiple, smaller, irregular granules clustered at the cell periphery and are iron positive on Prussian blue, whereas Howell-Jolly bodies are single, round, larger DNA remnants.
Basophilic stippling consists of numerous fine or coarse dots distributed throughout the cell, not a single discrete round body.
An overlying platelet is larger, shows granular texture with a pale halo and lies in a different focal plane.
Parasites show a blue cytoplasmic ring with a red chromatin dot rather than a solid dense purple sphere.

exam.answer_en: Howell-Jolly bodies — single small round dense basophilic RBC inclusions, indicating hyposplenism/asplenia
pearls_zh: 考法：箭頭指紅血球內單一深紫圓點問名稱與成因；答 Howell-Jolly body，為 DNA 核殘留物（Feulgen 陽性）。
最常見原因：脾切除或功能性無脾（sickle cell disease autosplenectomy、celiac disease 等）；亦見於 megaloblastic anemia、dyserythropoiesis。
臨床意義：無脾病人易發生 encapsulated bacteria（S. pneumoniae、H. influenzae、N. meningitidis）猛爆性感染，需疫苗與發燒時及早抗生素。
脾臟功能低下的抹片伴隨發現：target cells、acanthocytes、Pappenheimer bodies、血小板增多。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Pappenheimer bodies（多顆、細小、成簇、Prussian blue 陽性）或疊在紅血球上的血小板（周圍有透明暈、顆粒狀）混淆；Howell-Jolly 通常單一、圓、深染均質。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指紅血球內單一深紫色圓點為何？最常提示病人哪個器官功能缺失？
quiz.a: Howell-Jolly body；脾臟（asplenia/hyposplenism）。

65416.recognize_zh: 數位影像分類系統（CellaVision）的細胞圖庫中，大量細胞核呈雙葉、摺疊或腎形（butterfly nucleus），細胞質淡藍、顆粒少，另有少數細胞帶粗顆粒與 Auer rod，這個一致性的異常族群指向 APL。
features: Monotonous population of medium-large cells with bilobed, folded, reniform or 'butterfly' nuclei
Fine chromatin with nuclear folds and grooves visible through the cytoplasm
Many cells with sparse, fine granules and pale blue cytoplasm (hypogranular appearance)
A minority of cells with coarse granules and rod-like inclusions (e.g., cells 2 and 7)
Irregular cell outlines with occasional cytoplasmic blebs
65416.describe_en: Digital morphology gallery (CellaVision-type) displays numerous pre-classified cells from the same sample. The predominant population consists of medium to large cells with bilobed, folded or reniform nuclei, fine chromatin, and pale to lightly granular cytoplasm; several cells show coarse azurophilic granules with rod-like inclusions suggestive of Auer rods. Normal maturing neutrophils and lymphocytes are not represented among these cells. Findings are consistent with abnormal promyelocytes of acute promyelocytic leukemia, including hypogranular forms; automated analyzers may misclassify such cells as monocytes or blasts, so manual review is essential.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts and promonocytes have gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and lack Auer rod bundles, and are strongly NSE-positive with HLA-DR and CD14/CD64 expression.
Cup-like nuclear invaginations can mimic folded APL nuclei and share CD34/HLA-DR negativity, but PML::RARA is absent and faggot cells are not seen.
Mature monocytes have lacy chromatin, vacuolated gray cytoplasm and no Auer rods, with a mixed polyclonal background.

exam.answer_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia incl. hypogranular forms — digital gallery of bilobed 'butterfly' abnormal promyelocytes, some with Auer rods
pearls_zh: 考法：數位影像分類系統圖庫，考官問「分析儀可能把這些細胞分成什麼？」常被分為 monocyte 或 blast，需人工複核為異常前骨髓球。
CellaVision 等自動分類只是預分類，最終須由人員確認；單一異常族群、雙葉核應觸發人工 review。
同檢體中找到少數含粗顆粒與 Auer rod 的細胞，可支持低顆粒族群屬 APL，而非單核球性 AML。
疑似 APL 屬危急通報：立即通知臨床開始 ATRA，並檢查 PT、aPTT、fibrinogen、D-dimer 評估 DIC。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤判為 acute monocytic leukemia；少數細胞有 Auer rod、對稱雙葉核、MPO 強陽性與 CD34−/HLA-DR− 支持 APL。

quiz.q: 圖庫中少數細胞質內的桿狀構造是什麼？對判讀有何意義？
quiz.a: Auer rods；證實為異常骨髓系細胞，支持 APL 而非單核球或反應性細胞

65288.recognize_zh: 中央細胞的細胞質已呈灰藍色（polychromatic，已有血紅素），但核仍大而染色質呈點狀篩網、未緻密化，形成「核老化落後於細胞質」的核質不同步（nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony）；旁邊有淡紫色多染性大紅血球，符合巨母紅血球性多染性紅血球母細胞。
features: Enlarged polychromatic erythroblast with grey-blue cytoplasm
Round nucleus with open, sieve-like stippled chromatin lacking the expected condensation
Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony (cytoplasm more mature than nucleus)
Adjacent large polychromatophilic red cells
Background anisopoikilocytosis with oval macrocytes, target-like cells and echinocytes
65288.describe_en: Smear shows a single polychromatic erythroblast among mature red cells. The cell is enlarged, with grey-blue hemoglobinizing cytoplasm and a round nucleus retaining open, finely stippled chromatin, indicating nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony. Adjacent red cells include large polychromatophilic cells, and the background shows anisopoikilocytosis with oval macrocytes and echinocytes. The findings are consistent with a megaloblastic polychromatic erythroblast in B12/folate deficiency.

ddx.vs: Normal polychromatic erythroblasts are smaller with a checkerboard pattern of coarsely clumped chromatin that matches cytoplasmic maturity.
MDS megaloblastoid erythroblasts look similar but occur with normal B12/folate, other dysplastic features, and often clonal cytogenetic changes.
Plasma cells have an eccentric nucleus with clockface chromatin and a perinuclear hof, and lymphocytes lack grey hemoglobinized cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Megaloblastic anemia — megaloblastic polychromatic erythroblast with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony (open sieve-like chromatin in hemoglobinizing cytoplasm)
pearls_zh: 考法：指中央細胞問成熟階段與異常處：polychromatic erythroblast，細胞質已灰藍但核染色質仍呈篩網狀，即 nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony。
機轉：B12 或 folate 缺乏使 DNA 合成延遲，而 RNA 與血紅素合成正常，故細胞質成熟領先核；ineffective erythropoiesis 使 LDH 與 indirect bilirubin 上升。
同時要找：骨髓 giant metamyelocyte/band，周邊血 macro-ovalocyte 與 hypersegmented neutrophil。
檢查：methylmalonic acid 在 B12 缺乏時升高、folate 缺乏時正常；homocysteine 兩者皆升高。B12 缺乏若只補 folate，神經症狀可能惡化。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 MDS 的 megaloblastoid change；兩者形態相似，需以 B12/folate 濃度、其他系列 dysplasia 與核型區分，補充維生素後改善支持 megaloblastic anemia。

quiz.q: 圖中細胞的核與細胞質成熟度有何不一致？主要原因為何？
quiz.a: 細胞質已 polychromatic 但核染色質仍開放（N:C asynchrony）；B12/folate 缺乏導致 DNA 合成障礙。

65160.recognize_zh: 流式細胞圖第二組：異常族群（紅色）CD4 與 CD123 共表現、NG2 陽性、CD56 部分陽性，而 CD16、CD57、CD8、TCR、CD2、CD1a、CD38、cyMPO、cyCD79a、cyTdT、cyCD3 皆陰性，這組 CD4+/CD56+/CD123+ 的表型指向 BPDCN。
features: CD56 partially positive (about half the events) with CD16 negative
CD57, CD8, TCR alpha/beta, TCR gamma/delta, CD2 and CD1a negative
NG2 (CSPG4) positive with CD38 negative
CD4 and CD123 co-expressed on the abnormal population
Cytoplasmic MPO, CD79a, TdT and CD3 negative, excluding myeloid, B- and T-lineage commitment
65160.describe_en: Flow cytometry dot plots (panel 2) of the abnormal population (red) show partial CD56 expression without CD16, and absence of CD57, CD8, TCR alpha/beta, TCR gamma/delta, CD2 and CD1a. The cells co-express CD4 and CD123 and are NG2-positive and CD38-negative. Cytoplasmic MPO, CD79a, TdT and CD3 are all negative, excluding myeloid, B- and T-lymphoblastic lineage assignment. Together with CD7, CD33 and HLA-DR expression on the companion panel, the CD4+/CD56+/CD123+ phenotype is most suggestive of blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monocytic AML may be CD4+/CD56+ but usually has MPO or nonspecific esterase activity and CD11b/CD14/CD64, whereas these cells are cyMPO-negative with bright CD123.
NK neoplasms are CD56+ with CD2, CD16 or cytoplasmic CD3 epsilon and are typically CD4-negative and CD123-negative, unlike this CD4+/CD123+ population.
T-ALL requires cytoplasmic CD3 and commonly TdT, both negative here.

65096.recognize_zh: CD20 低倍染色顯示許多小型濾泡，B 細胞排成環狀包圍縮小、淡染的生發中心，部分中心可見血管腔，濾泡間區 CD20 陽性細胞稀少，呈現萎縮（regressed）濾泡的 Castleman 型模式。
features: Low-power (2x) CD20 immunostain showing numerous small, evenly scattered follicles
CD20-positive B cells arranged as concentric rings (expanded mantle zones) around small pale centers
Atrophic germinal centers, several containing a central vascular lumen
Occasional follicles with two small germinal centers or tangentially cut mantles
Sparse CD20-positive cells in interfollicular areas, which are CD20 negative overall
65096.describe_en: CD20 immunohistochemistry at low power highlights numerous small B-cell follicles scattered across the lymph node. The follicles show concentric rings of CD20-positive mantle zone B cells surrounding small, pale, regressed germinal centers, several of which contain a penetrating central vessel. The interfollicular areas contain only scattered B cells. Follicular architecture is preserved, without diffuse or nodular sheets of B cells. Findings are consistent with the atrophic follicles of Castleman disease-like changes, in keeping with the TAFRO subtype of idiopathic multicentric Castleman disease in the appropriate clinical setting.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma with mantle zone growth pattern
ddx.vs: In mantle cell lymphoma the expanded mantle cells coexpress CD5 and cyclin D1/SOX11, whereas the mantle B cells in Castleman disease are polytypic and cyclin D1 negative.
Morphology can be similar, but HHV-8 disease shows LANA-1-positive plasmablasts in the mantle zones, which should be negative in TAFRO-type iMCD.
Follicular lymphoma has back-to-back enlarged neoplastic follicles with attenuated mantles and BCL2-positive germinal centers, not small regressed centers ringed by thick mantles.

64968.recognize_zh: 上排為發炎性巨噬細胞：細胞大、核圓或腎形、細胞質豐富且布滿小空泡並成群聚集；下排為印戒樣巨噬細胞：細胞質被一個大空泡填滿，把核壓扁推到一側呈新月形，形似印戒。
features: Panel A: large macrophages with round to kidney-shaped nuclei and moderately dispersed chromatin
Panel A: abundant basophilic cytoplasm with numerous small clear vacuoles, singly and in cohesive-appearing clusters
Panel B: macrophages with a single large clear cytoplasmic vacuole containing faint foamy material
Panel B: nucleus compressed into a crescent at the cell periphery (signet-ring appearance), with condensed chromatin
Background of small lymphocytes, red cells and occasional neutrophils
64968.describe_en: Cytospin preparation of bronchoalveolar lavage fluid shows numerous macrophages. Panel A shows inflammatory (activated) macrophages with round to reniform nuclei and abundant finely vacuolated basophilic cytoplasm, occurring singly and in clusters. Panel B shows macrophages in which a single large cytoplasmic vacuole displaces and compresses the nucleus into a crescent, producing a signet-ring appearance; the nuclei are bland without atypia. Small lymphocytes and red cells are present in the background. Findings are consistent with reactive alveolar macrophages, including signet-ring forms, in the setting of active pulmonary tuberculosis; these should not be mistaken for signet-ring carcinoma cells.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells show nuclear atypia, hyperchromasia, prominent nucleoli and cohesive three-dimensional clusters, with mucin and cytokeratin positivity.
Mesothelial cells have dense central cytoplasm with a peripheral pale rim, windows between cells and are calretinin-positive, and are not expected in BAL.
Reactive pneumocytes form cohesive clusters with larger nucleoli and are TTF-1/cytokeratin positive, CD68-negative.
Lipid-laden macrophages have multiple small fat vacuoles that stain with Oil Red O, rather than a single large vacuole, and correlate with aspiration.

64904.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD138 免疫染色中，大量細胞呈清楚的膜狀棕色陽性，並在右下方聚成緻密片狀集落，其餘散在於脂肪間，代表漿細胞增加並形成聚集，支持合併漿細胞腫瘤。
features: Strong membranous CD138 staining in numerous plasma cells
Large, confluent aggregate/sheet of positive cells in the lower right of the field
Additional interstitial clusters and single positive cells between fat spaces
CD138-negative background hematopoietic cells with blue nuclear counterstain
Adipocytes and bone trabecula fragments at the edge
64904.describe_en: CD138 immunohistochemistry on the bone marrow trephine highlights an increased population of plasma cells with strong membranous staining. Positive cells are distributed interstitially and in small clusters, and form a prominent confluent aggregate in part of the field, where they account for a substantial proportion of cellularity. The negative background cells include residual hematopoietic elements. In this field the plasma cell burden appears more than mild; quantitation should be performed across the whole core together with light-chain restriction studies. Findings support a concurrent plasma cell neoplasm in this patient with hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are scattered or perivascular without large sheets and show polytypic kappa and lambda expression.
LPL contains a mixed population of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with CD20+ B cells and usually MYD88 L265P.
Hairy cells are CD138-negative and are highlighted instead by CD20, DBA44, annexin A1, and BRAF V600E.

64520.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中成片出現核偏位、染色質呈粗塊狀（車輪狀）、細胞質豐富灰藍的漿細胞，部分核較大、染色質較細或雙核，數量明顯增加，符合漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Sheets and clusters of plasma cells replacing normal hematopoietic elements
Eccentric round nuclei with coarse clumped (clock-face) chromatin
Abundant grey-blue cytoplasm; perinuclear hof not prominent in these fields
Some immature forms with larger nuclei, finer chromatin, and occasional binucleation
Admixed residual erythroid and myeloid precursors
Warm color cast and variable focus across panels limit fine detail
64520.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear panels show numerous plasma cells in sheets and clusters, with eccentric round nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin, and abundant grey-blue cytoplasm. A subset shows immature features, including larger nuclei with finer chromatin and occasional binucleation. Residual erythroid and myeloid precursors are present. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma involving the bone marrow; quantitation of plasma cells, light chain restriction by flow cytometry or IHC, and FISH risk stratification are recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature, usually <10% of marrow cells, dispersed around vessels, and polytypic for kappa and lambda.
LPL shows a mixture of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes, and plasma cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P rather than sheets of plasma cells.
Erythroid precursors have central round nuclei with deep blue cytoplasm and no eccentric nucleus, and they lack CD138.
Plasmablastic lymphoma is composed of large blastic cells with prominent nucleoli, is usually EBER positive, and presents as an extramedullary mass.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell myeloma — sheets and clusters of plasma cells with eccentric clock-face nuclei, including immature and binucleate forms
pearls_zh: 考法：指成片漿細胞中較大、染色質細、雙核的細胞問「代表什麼？」——答未成熟/非典型漿細胞，支持腫瘤性而非反應性。
計數陷阱：抽吸抹片常因稀釋與分布不均低估漿細胞比例，應同時看 biopsy 的 CD138 IHC，取兩者較高值。
克隆性證明：cytoplasmic kappa/lambda（flow 或 IHC/ISH）；異常表型如 CD19−、CD45−、CD56+、CD117+ 可區分正常與腫瘤性漿細胞。
Plasmablastic 形態（大核、明顯核仁、細緻染色質）在骨髓瘤屬不良預後特徵。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把成群的紅系前驅細胞（basophilic normoblast）當作漿細胞；紅系核位於中央、細胞質均勻深藍無核旁淡染區，漿細胞則核偏位並 CD138 陽性。

quiz.q: 骨髓抹片評估漿細胞比例常被低估，應搭配哪個切片免疫染色來評估？
quiz.a: CD138 IHC（骨髓切片）

64392.recognize_zh: 九格拼圖皆為骨髓中的巨大細胞：有成熟分葉核、細胞質富含顆粒的巨核細胞，也有核分離成數個圓形核、單葉/低分葉核，以及細胞質偏嗜鹼的較不成熟形態，用來比較巨核細胞的各種型態。
features: Very large cells (many times the size of surrounding red cells) with abundant granular pink-violet cytoplasm, typical of megakaryocytes
Mature forms with lobulated, folded nuclei (bottom left, bottom center)
Hypolobated / monolobated or bilobed nuclei in several cells (top center, center right)
Megakaryocyte with multiple widely separated round nuclei (middle left), a dysplastic pattern
Less mature forms with more basophilic, less granular cytoplasm and a large single nucleus (top right, bottom right)
Platelet budding/cytoplasmic fragmentation at the edge of some cells
64392.describe_en: Composite of bone marrow aspirate fields from different patients illustrates the morphologic range of megakaryocytes. Mature megakaryocytes are very large with abundant granular cytoplasm and multilobated nuclei, and some show peripheral platelet budding. Other examples show hypolobated or monolobated nuclei, a megakaryocyte with multiple separated round nuclei, and less mature forms with a single large nucleus and more basophilic, less granular cytoplasm. Hypolobated and separated-nuclei forms are dysplastic patterns that, when numerous (at least 10% of megakaryocytes), support dysplasia in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts have multiple separate, uniform oval nuclei each with a nucleolus, whereas megakaryocyte nuclei are lobulated and connected (except in dysplastic separated-nuclei forms).
Tumor cells form cohesive clusters with high N:C ratio and prominent nucleoli, lacking the granular platelet-forming cytoplasm of megakaryocytes.
Histiocytes have a small single eccentric nucleus and vacuolated or wrinkled cytoplasm rather than a large lobulated nucleus with fine azurophilic granules.

exam.answer_en: Megakaryocyte morphologic spectrum — mature multilobated forms versus dysplastic hypolobated/monolobated and separated-nuclei megakaryocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：九宮格逐格問「正常還是異常？」——成熟分葉核為正常；單葉/低分葉、多個分離圓核、micromegakaryocyte 屬 dysplasia。
MDS 發育不良門檻：WHO 5th 與 ICC 2022 皆以單一系別 ≥10% 細胞異常作為 dysplasia；巨核系最可靠的是 micromegakaryocyte（可用 CD61 IHC 找）。
特定形態連結：MDS with isolated del(5q) 常見小而單葉核巨核細胞；inv(3)/t(3;3)（MECOM）常見小型單/雙葉核巨核細胞合併血小板正常或上升。
MPN 對照：ET 為大型高分葉「鹿角狀」巨核細胞；PMF 為成簇、核深染呈雲朵狀（cloud-like）的異型巨核細胞；CML 為小型低分葉（dwarf）巨核細胞。
exam.pitfall_zh: 多個分離圓核的巨核細胞易被誤認為 osteoclast；osteoclast 各核大小一致、各有核仁且細胞質無血小板顆粒，巨核細胞細胞質有細顆粒並可見血小板出芽。

quiz.q: 圖中核為單一圓葉、體積偏小的巨核細胞若大量出現在 MDS，最常聯想哪個細胞遺傳異常？
quiz.a: Isolated del(5q)

64328.recognize_zh: 細胞團左側一顆巨噬細胞的空泡化細胞質內含數顆大小一致的小卵圓形酵母菌，各有透明暈與偏心深染核點，周圍為造血細胞與破碎細胞，符合播散性組織胞漿菌症。
features: Macrophage (left of the cell cluster) with vacuolated cytoplasm containing several small, uniform oval yeasts
Yeasts with a clear halo around a small eccentric dark-staining nuclear dot
Adjacent large cells with open chromatin, erythroid precursors with dense nuclei, and several smudged/disrupted cells
Thin smear background with scattered red cells and fine debris; quick stain with brownish cast
64328.describe_en: Rapid-stained bedside smear shows a small cluster of marrow cells including a macrophage whose vacuolated cytoplasm contains several small, uniform oval yeasts with clear halos and eccentric nuclear staining. Adjacent cells include erythroid precursors, larger mononuclear cells and several smudged forms. The number of organisms in this field is limited and cell preservation is suboptimal. Findings are consistent with intracellular Histoplasma yeasts in the setting of disseminated histoplasmosis.

ddx.vs: Leishmania shows a kinetoplast beside the nucleus without a halo, unlike these halo-bearing yeasts.
Nonspecific vacuoles and debris vary in size and shape and lack a uniform oval body with a nuclear dot.
Talaromyces yeasts show central transverse septa and sausage-shaped forms rather than uniformly oval budding cells.
Candida yeasts are larger with visible budding and possible pseudohyphae and usually lack a halo.

64136.recognize_zh: Masson 三色染色中，紅色的骨小樑表面貼著一層藍色膠原（paratrabecular collagen），並延伸至骨髓腔成為大量藍紫色膠原纖維與梭形細胞，呈串流狀排列，造血細胞稀少，代表原發性骨髓纖維化的膠原纖維化。
features: Bony trabecula (red) with lamellar lines and osteocyte lacunae at upper left
Band of blue-staining collagen apposed to the trabecular surface (paratrabecular collagen deposition)
Marrow space replaced by dense blue-purple collagen fibers with elongated spindle cells in streaming fascicles
Marked paucity of recognizable hematopoietic cells and fat
Staining colors are somewhat intense and color-shifted, limiting fine assessment
64136.describe_en: Masson trichrome-stained bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a bony trabecula with a band of blue-staining collagen apposed to its surface, extending into an intertrabecular space that is replaced by dense collagen fibers and spindled stromal cells arranged in streaming fascicles. Recognizable hematopoietic elements and fat are markedly reduced. Findings indicate collagen fibrosis with paratrabecular apposition, corresponding to a high grade of marrow fibrosis (collagen grade 2-3 / MF-3 range with reticulin correlation), consistent with the overt fibrotic stage of primary myelofibrosis in the clinical context; the image color balance limits precise grading.

ddx.vs: Desmoplastic metastases contain cohesive keratin-positive epithelial nests within the collagen, which should be sought on H&E and IHC.
Therapy-related fibrosis occurs in a hypocellular marrow without atypical clustered megakaryocytes and is supported by treatment history.
Hyperparathyroidism produces peritrabecular fibrosis with increased osteoclasts and dissecting resorption, but without a myeloproliferative megakaryocytic proliferation.
Mastocytosis shows paratrabecular spindled mast cell aggregates with eosinophils that are CD117/tryptase positive.

64008.recognize_zh: 這是超活體染色的濕片（wet preparation），大量紅血球內緣各有一顆深紫色、貼著細胞膜的小圓形包涵體，這就是 Heinz body（變性沉澱的血紅素），支持藥物引起的氧化性溶血。
features: Numerous red cells each containing one (occasionally two) small, round, dark purple inclusion(s) located at or near the cell membrane
Inclusions are refractile and uniform, consistent with Heinz bodies (denatured hemoglobin)
Wet preparation artifacts: many crenated cells and refractile ring-like (cup-shaped) red cells
Occasional larger purple-staining nucleated cells (leukocytes) and scattered platelets
High proportion of red cells affected
64008.describe_en: Wet film preparation with supravital staining (high power) shows a large proportion of red cells containing single, small, round, dark purple inclusions typically positioned at the inner aspect of the red cell membrane, consistent with Heinz bodies. Background red cells show crenation and refractile cup-shaped forms attributable to the wet preparation. Occasional leukocytes and platelets are present. Findings indicate oxidative denaturation of hemoglobin and are consistent with drug-induced oxidative hemolysis, as seen with oxidant drugs, G6PD deficiency or unstable hemoglobins.

ddx.vs: HbH precipitates appear after brilliant cresyl blue incubation as multiple fine, evenly distributed 'golf ball' inclusions rather than one or two large membrane-associated bodies.
Reticulocytes contain a blue filamentous or granular reticulum network rather than discrete round peripheral inclusions.
Pappenheimer bodies are small clustered iron-containing granules visible on Romanowsky stain and positive with Prussian blue, unlike Heinz bodies which are invisible on Wright stain.
Howell-Jolly bodies are single DNA remnants seen on routine Wright-Giemsa stain, whereas Heinz bodies need supravital stain and are usually attached to the membrane.

exam.answer_en: Heinz bodies on supravital wet preparation — single small dark round inclusions at the RBC membrane, indicating oxidative hemoglobin denaturation
pearls_zh: 考法：指紅血球膜內側的小深紫點問名稱與染色法；答 Heinz body，需 supravital stain（如 crystal violet、new methylene blue），一般 Wright 染色看不到。
Heinz body 為氧化變性沉澱的血紅素，常附著於膜內側；見於 G6PD deficiency 等氧化性溶血、oxidant drugs 暴露與 unstable hemoglobin。
Unstable hemoglobin 可用 isopropanol 或 heat stability test 篩檢；脾切除後 Heinz bodies 在周邊血更容易看到。
臨床連結：dapsone、primaquine 等氧化藥物可同時造成 Heinz body 溶血與 methemoglobinemia；G6PD 缺乏者禁用 methylene blue 治療 methemoglobinemia。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 HbH inclusions 混淆：HbH 以 brilliant cresyl blue 培育後呈多顆細小均勻點（golf ball）；Heinz body 則為一至數顆較大、貼膜的點；Pappenheimer bodies 在 Wright 染色可見且 Prussian blue 陽性。

quiz.q: 圖中紅血球膜內側的深色圓形小包涵體稱為什麼？為什麼需要 supravital stain 才看得到？
quiz.a: Heinz bodies；它們是變性血紅素，Romanowsky（Wright）染色不著色，需 crystal violet 等 supravital stain。

63880.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中出現體積約為小淋巴球兩倍的大型淋巴細胞，核圓、染色質濃縮呈粗條紋狀、細胞質少量淡藍，與旁邊典型 CLL 小淋巴球形成對比；左下淋巴結切片則是成片大型細胞、核不規則且有核仁，符合 CLL 大細胞轉化（Richter transformation）。
features: PB (top and right panels): large lymphoid cells roughly twice the diameter of adjacent small lymphocytes
Large cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, condensed coarse streaky chromatin, no conspicuous nucleoli and a thin rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Adjacent small mature CLL-type lymphocytes with dense block-like chromatin for comparison
Lymph node H&E (bottom left): diffuse sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular vesicular nuclei, visible nucleoli and scattered apoptotic bodies
Red cells unremarkable; no smudge-cell-rich field captured in these panels
63880.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear panels show small mature lymphocytes with dense clumped chromatin typical of CLL, together with a distinct population of large lymphoid cells about twice their size, with round nuclei, condensed coarse chromatin and a narrow rim of pale cytoplasm. These large cells differ from prolymphocytes, which have a single prominent central nucleolus. The accompanying lymph node section shows diffuse sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular vesicular nuclei and nucleoli, replacing the architecture. Findings are consistent with large cell (Richter) transformation of chronic lymphocytic leukemia, with circulating large cells detected on the smear.

ddx.vs: Prolymphocytes are medium-sized with moderately condensed chromatin and a single prominent central nucleolus, whereas these large cells lack a conspicuous nucleolus and the tissue shows sheets of large cells.

ddx.dx: Reactive large granular or activated lymphocytes
ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have abundant basophilic cytoplasm that scallops around red cells, unlike the scant cytoplasm and CLL-like immunophenotype (CD5/CD23/CD200) here.
Blastoid MCL cells have fine blastic chromatin and are cyclin D1/SOX11-positive and CD23/CD200-negative, whereas this case is cyclin D1-negative.
Hodgkin-type transformation shows scattered CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed inflammatory background rather than sheets of large B cells.

63816.recognize_zh: 視野中最醒目的是大量有核紅血球（圓形深染小核、灰藍到粉紅色細胞質），合併偏大的多染性紅血球、深染無中央淡染的小球形紅血球，以及數個紅血球黏成小團；有核紅血球大量出現加上球形細胞與紅血球凝集，符合自體免疫溶血性貧血的骨髓強力代償。
features: Numerous nucleated red cells (polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts) with round, dense nuclei, some in small groups
Large polychromatophilic red cells (macrocytic, bluish-grey) indicating reticulocytosis
Scattered dense spherocytes/microspherocytes lacking central pallor
Small irregular clusters of adherent red cells, suggestive of agglutination, though only focal in this field
Two neutrophils and scattered platelets; occasional poikilocytes including a teardrop-shaped cell
63816.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows markedly increased nucleated red cells, predominantly polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts, together with prominent polychromasia, macrocytic reticulocytes and scattered spherocytes. Several small irregular clumps of red cells are present, suggestive of autoagglutination, although agglutination is focal rather than marked in this particular field. Neutrophils appear morphologically unremarkable and platelets are present. In the setting of a strongly positive direct antiglobulin test and reticulocytosis, findings are consistent with autoimmune hemolytic anemia with brisk erythroid regeneration; red cell agglutination with spuriously high MCV and MCHC should prompt evaluation for a cold-reactive autoantibody.

ddx.vs: Cold agglutinin disease shows large irregular red cell agglutinates that disperse on warming to 37 °C, with a DAT positive for C3d only and a high-titer cold agglutinin, whereas warm AIHA shows spherocytes with IgG positivity.
Rouleaux are linear stacks of red cells resembling coins in the thin area of a smear, associated with paraproteins or high fibrinogen, not irregular grape-like clumps.
HS shows spherocytes and polychromasia but a negative DAT, no agglutination, and a family history or abnormal EMA binding.
Leukoerythroblastosis pairs nucleated red cells with immature granulocytes and teardrop cells without spherocytes, agglutination or a positive DAT.

63752.recognize_zh: CD20 染色中大多區域的大型非典型細胞呈弱陽（箭頭）或陰性（圓圈），僅小 B 細胞強陽；另一區大細胞 CD20 較明顯。OCT-2 與 BOB.1 在大細胞多為陰性、少數弱陽，這種 B 細胞轉錄程式缺失支持古典何杰金淋巴瘤。
features: CD20 (upper left): large atypical cells weak (arrows) or negative (circles); small reactive B cells strongly positive
CD20 (upper right): another area with stronger membranous CD20 on many large cells, showing heterogeneity
OCT-2: large atypical cells mostly negative (circles) while scattered small cells are positive
BOB.1: occasional weak nuclear positivity in large cells (arrows) with most negative (circles)
Background of numerous small lymphocytes
63752.describe_en: Additional immunohistochemical stains on the lymph node show heterogeneous CD20 expression in the large atypical cells: in most areas CD20 is weak or negative in the large cells compared with the strongly positive small background B cells, while other areas show more prominent CD20 staining. The B-cell transcription factors OCT-2 and BOB.1 are largely negative in the large atypical cells, with only occasional weak nuclear positivity. Loss or down-regulation of the B-cell program (weak/variable CD20, absent OCT-2 and BOB.1) in CD30+/CD15+ large cells supports classical Hodgkin lymphoma; the focal strong CD20 should prompt consideration of gray zone lymphoma if accompanied by sheet-like growth.

ddx.vs: LP cells are uniformly strong CD20, OCT-2 and BOB.1 positive, unlike the weak or lost expression here.
THRLBCL large cells are strongly and uniformly CD20, OCT-2 and BOB.1 positive and CD30/CD15 negative.

ddx.dx: Gray zone lymphoma (B-cell lymphoma with features intermediate between DLBCL and cHL)
ddx.vs: Gray zone lymphoma shows sheets of large cells with strong, uniform CD20 and preserved OCT-2/BOB.1 despite CD30/CD15 expression.

63688.recognize_zh: 紅血球像一疊銅板般串成線狀堆疊（rouleaux，箭頭處），視野中央並有兩顆偏心核、染色質呈車輪狀、細胞質嗜鹼性並有核周淡染區的漿細胞，提示高球蛋白血症，例如多發性骨髓瘤。
features: Red cells stacked in short linear chains resembling stacks of coins (rouleaux, arrows)
Two adjacent plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and coarse clock-face chromatin
Plasma cells show basophilic cytoplasm with a pale perinuclear hof
Many red cells still separate in this thin area, with preserved central pallor
Platelets present; no background bluish protein staining evident at this resolution
63688.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells arranged in multiple linear stacks of three to five cells, consistent with rouleaux formation, in a relatively thin area of the film. Two circulating plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a perinuclear hof are present in the center of the field. Platelets are present and no red cell agglutinates are identified. Findings are consistent with increased plasma proteins and circulating plasma cells, suggestive of a plasma cell neoplasm such as multiple myeloma; serum protein electrophoresis and immunofixation are recommended.

ddx.vs: Agglutinates are irregular, three-dimensional grape-like clumps rather than orderly linear coin stacks, and disperse on warming.
Pseudo-rouleaux in thick parts of the smear disappear in the thin monolayer, whereas true rouleaux persist where cells are otherwise separated.
Rouleaux can reflect raised fibrinogen or polyclonal immunoglobulins, so clonality must be shown by immunofixation and marrow studies.
Plasmacytoid lymphocytes are smaller with lymphoid chromatin and less abundant cytoplasm, and IgM paraprotein with MYD88 L265P supports LPL.

exam.answer_en: Rouleaux with circulating plasma cells — suggests a plasma cell neoplasm such as multiple myeloma
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指串成錢幣狀的紅血球問名稱與機轉；答 rouleaux，因血漿蛋白（免疫球蛋白、fibrinogen）增加降低紅血球間排斥力，臨床伴 ESR 上升。
關聯檢查：SPEP、immunofixation、serum free light chain，再做骨髓檢查與 FISH；周邊出現漿細胞需計算比例。
分類門檻：IMWG 2021 與 WHO 5th 將周邊血漿細胞 ≥5% 定義為 plasma cell leukemia，預後差。
輸血醫學連結：rouleaux 可造成血型鑑定與交叉試驗假凝集，以 saline replacement 可分散，與真凝集區分。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與紅血球凝集（cold agglutinin）混淆：rouleaux 為線性堆疊、需在薄層判讀；凝集為不規則葡萄串狀團塊，加溫至 37°C 可分散。厚片區的假性堆疊也要排除。

quiz.q: 圖中紅血球的排列稱為什麼？中央兩顆偏心核細胞為何種細胞？
quiz.a: Rouleaux（錢串狀排列）；漿細胞（plasma cells）

63624.recognize_zh: 上方中央一顆紅血球內有一條紫紅色細線圍成的環狀結構（Cabot ring），右上角可見淚滴形紅血球（dacrocyte），另有多染性紅血球與含核殘餘的細胞，符合骨髓纖維化的紅血球變化。
features: Red cell containing a thin, purple-red, ring- or loop-shaped inclusion outlining the cell interior (Cabot ring)
Teardrop cells (dacrocytes) with single tapered tails
Polychromatic red cell containing a dense nuclear remnant/Howell-Jolly-like body
Anisocytosis with scattered polychromatic cells and a faint ghost-like red cell
Scattered platelets; field contains red cells only and resembles a thin blood-like area
63624.describe_en: Smear shows a thin red cell area with anisopoikilocytosis including teardrop cells and polychromatic red cells. One red cell contains a thin purple-red ring-shaped inclusion characteristic of a Cabot ring, and a polychromatic cell contains a dense nuclear remnant. Platelets are present and no hematopoietic precursors are included in this field. Findings are consistent with Cabot rings and dacrocytes, supporting disordered erythropoiesis in the setting of myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: Parasite rings are small with a chromatin dot and blue cytoplasm occupying a small portion of the cell, whereas a Cabot ring is a thin loop spanning the cell without a chromatin dot.
Drying artifact is refractile and varies with focus, whereas a Cabot ring stains purple-red and is fixed within the cell.
Stippling consists of dispersed blue granules rather than a continuous thin loop.

63560.recognize_zh: 同一視野內有三顆被深紫黑色粗大顆粒覆蓋細胞核的嗜鹼性球（basophil），其中右側一顆顆粒部分脫落；加上兩顆核形不規則的單核球（箭頭），在周邊血液出現嗜鹼性球增多時要想到 CML。
features: Increased basophils: three cells with coarse dark purple-black granules obscuring the nucleus in a single field
One basophil at right partially degranulated with granules scattered at the cell periphery
Two monocytes (arrows) with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and irregular folded/lobulated nuclei (abnormal nuclear morphology)
Monocyte nuclei with fine chromatin and deep clefts, one appearing bilobed
Background red cells are normocytic and normochromic; no blasts in this field
63560.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a leukocyte cluster containing three basophils with coarse, dark metachromatic granules obscuring the nuclei, one of which is partly degranulated. Two monocytes (arrows) show abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and irregular, deeply folded to bilobed nuclei. No blasts are seen in this limited field and red cells are unremarkable. Absolute basophilia is a characteristic finding of chronic myeloid leukemia; findings are suggestive of CML in the appropriate clinical context, requiring confirmation of BCR::ABL1 by cytogenetics, FISH or RT-PCR, and blast enumeration for phase assignment.

ddx.vs: Reactive basophilia is mild and not accompanied by left-shifted granulocytosis or dysplastic monocytes; BCR::ABL1 testing is negative.
CMML shows persistent absolute monocytosis with dysgranulopoiesis and lacks BCR::ABL1, with basophilia uncommon, whereas CML shows marked granulocytosis with basophilia.

ddx.dx: Mast cells in blood (systemic mastocytosis / mast cell leukemia)
ddx.vs: Mast cells are larger with a round or oval non-lobated nucleus and cytoplasm packed with fine metachromatic granules, while basophils are smaller with lobed nuclei obscured by coarser granules.

exam.answer_en: Chronic myeloid leukemia (suggested) — absolute basophilia with three basophils in a single field
pearls_zh: 考法：指深紫黑顆粒遮住核的細胞問名稱（basophil），再問周邊血嗜鹼性球增多最該想到的疾病：CML。
確診需證明 BCR::ABL1：karyotype t(9;22)(q34.1;q11.2)、FISH 或 RT-PCR；治療追蹤用定量 RT-PCR（IS）。
WHO 5th 將 CML 分為慢性期與 blast phase（取消 accelerated phase）；ICC 2022 保留 accelerated phase，周邊血嗜鹼性球 ≥20% 為條件之一。
其他嗜鹼性球增多原因：甲狀腺低下、過敏、發炎性腸病，以及其他 MPN。
一線治療為 TKI（imatinib、dasatinib、nilotinib 等），依 BCR::ABL1 IS 評估分子反應。
exam.pitfall_zh: 嗜鹼性球易誤認為肥大細胞；肥大細胞較大、核圓而居中不分葉、顆粒細密，嗜鹼性球核分葉並常被粗大顆粒遮蓋。

quiz.q: 同一視野中深紫黑顆粒遮住細胞核的三顆細胞是什麼？
quiz.a: Basophils（嗜鹼性球）

63496.recognize_zh: 肝臟針刺切片的高倍 H&E 中，整個視野被大型異型細胞片狀取代，細胞核大小不一、深染，部分核仁可見，夾雜凋亡小體與擠壓變形的細胞，看不到正常肝細胞板，符合淋巴瘤浸潤肝臟。
features: Diffuse sheets of large atypical cells replacing the field
Pleomorphic, hyperchromatic to vesicular nuclei with occasional visible nucleoli
High N:C ratio with scant to moderate cytoplasm
Scattered apoptotic bodies and crushed, smeared nuclei
No recognizable hepatocyte plates or portal structures in this field
63496.describe_en: Core biopsy of the liver at high power shows effacement by diffuse sheets of large atypical cells with pleomorphic, vesicular to hyperchromatic nuclei, occasional nucleoli, and high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios. Apoptotic bodies are present, and some cells show crush artifact. No residual hepatocyte plates are identified in this field. Image resolution limits assessment of fine nuclear detail. Findings are consistent with involvement by a high-grade large-cell neoplasm, and with immunohistochemistry, diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, germinal center type.

ddx.vs: Tumor cells have abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, trabecular architecture, and are HepPar-1/arginase-1 positive and CD45 negative.
Shows cohesive nests or gland formation with keratin positivity and no lymphoid marker expression.
Involves sinusoids of intact hepatic parenchyma with medium-sized cells that are CD3+ and CD20 negative rather than forming mass-like sheets.
Composed of monotonous medium-sized cells with a starry-sky pattern and MYC rearrangement rather than pleomorphic large cells.

63432.recognize_zh: 箭頭處可見一個由約 16–20 個紫色小核（merozoite）組成的團塊，中央有棕色瘧色素聚集，為成熟裂殖體（schizont）；裂殖子數目多於 12 個，支持間日瘧（P. vivax），且宿主紅血球輪廓已不清楚。
features: Mature schizont composed of numerous (approximately 16-20) discrete merozoites with magenta chromatin
Centrally aggregated golden-brown hemozoin pigment within the merozoite cluster
Host red cell membrane poorly defined, suggesting a rupturing or segmented schizont
Surrounding red cells are uninfected and show mild anisocytosis with central pallor
Merozoites are irregularly arranged rather than forming a neat rosette
63432.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature malarial schizont containing approximately 16-20 merozoites arranged irregularly around a central clump of golden-brown hemozoin pigment. The outline of the host red cell is indistinct, consistent with a segmenting schizont near rupture. The remaining red cells are uninfected. The number of merozoites and the presence of schizonts in peripheral blood favor Plasmodium vivax; findings are consistent with P. vivax schizont.

ddx.vs: P. malariae schizonts contain fewer merozoites (6-12) arranged in a regular rosette around central pigment within a normal-sized or small red cell.
P. ovale schizonts contain 6-14 merozoites within an oval, fimbriated red cell with James dots.
P. falciparum schizonts are rarely seen in peripheral blood, and their presence usually accompanies heavy parasitemia with many small rings and crescent gametocytes.
Platelet aggregates contain purple granules within pale cytoplasm but lack discrete nuclear chromatin dots and hemozoin pigment.

exam.answer_en: Plasmodium vivax mature schizont — about 16–20 merozoites around central golden-brown hemozoin
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指箭頭處裂殖體要求計數裂殖子；>12 個且不排成規則玫瑰花狀，支持 P. vivax 而非 P. malariae。
成熟裂殖體中央聚集瘧色素是晚期特徵；裂殖體破裂釋放裂殖子與色素，對應臨床每 48 小時一次的間日熱（tertian fever）。
P. falciparum 周邊血極少見裂殖體（sequestration），若出現常代表重症；P. vivax 則常見各期別。
P. knowlesi 形態易與 P. malariae/P. falciparum 混淆且可快速高寄生蟲血症，東南亞旅遊史需以 PCR 確認種別。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 P. malariae 裂殖體；P. malariae 裂殖子較少（約 6–12）並圍繞中央色素排成玫瑰花狀，紅血球不增大。

quiz.q: 這個裂殖體中央聚集的棕色物質是什麼？裂殖體破裂對應 P. vivax 何種熱型？
quiz.a: Hemozoin（瘧色素）；每 48 小時的間日熱（tertian fever）

63304.recognize_zh: 40 倍（A）與 100 倍（B）視野中，一顆胞質淡而邊界不清的大型巨噬細胞內含多顆圓形深染的小細胞核（被吞噬的紅母細胞），周圍另有紅系與顆粒球前驅細胞圍繞，屬骨髓中的噬血現象（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Large macrophage with abundant pale, wispy grey-blue cytoplasm and a round nucleus with fine chromatin
Several engulfed small round, dense nuclei (consistent with erythroblasts) within the macrophage cytoplasm
Additional erythroblasts and myeloid cells clustered around and overlying the macrophage periphery
Surrounding marrow with maturing neutrophils, bands and scattered lymphocytes on a red-cell background
63304.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (panel A, 40x; panel B, 100x) shows a large macrophage with abundant pale cytoplasm containing several phagocytosed nucleated cells with small, round, condensed nuclei consistent with erythroid precursors. Additional erythroblasts and granulocytic cells are clustered around the macrophage. The surrounding marrow shows maturing granulocytes without increased blasts in these fields. Findings demonstrate hemophagocytosis; this finding is neither sensitive nor specific for hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis and must be interpreted with clinical and laboratory criteria.

ddx.vs: In an erythroblastic island erythroblasts surround the macrophage externally and remain intact, whereas in hemophagocytosis whole cells are enclosed within cytoplasmic phagosomes.
Tingible body macrophages contain irregular apoptotic nuclear fragments of varying size rather than intact whole cells.
Overlapping cells lie in a different plane and lack a surrounding phagosome halo, whereas ingested cells are embedded within the macrophage cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Hemophagocytosis in bone marrow — macrophage containing multiple engulfed erythroblasts; requires HLH-2004 clinical/laboratory correlation
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍（40x）找目標、高倍（100x）確認胞質內包著完整的有核細胞；考官常追問「如何與 erythroblastic island 區分」。
噬血現象敏感度與特異性皆不高：輸血、敗血症、化療後骨髓都可見到，而 HLH 早期骨髓也可能看不到噬血。
疑似 HLH 時骨髓檢查更重要的任務是找誘因：淋巴瘤浸潤、Leishmania 或 Histoplasma 等病原；CD163 IHC 可幫助顯示組織球。
HLH 是血液急症：可快速進展為多重器官衰竭與低纖維蛋白原出血，需儘早找誘因並評估 dexamethasone/etoposide 為基礎的治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 erythroblastic island 混淆：island 的紅母細胞貼附在巨噬細胞外圍且形態完整，噬血則是整顆細胞被包在胞質吞噬泡中。

quiz.q: 巨噬細胞胞質內那些小而深染的圓核細胞最可能是哪一系細胞？
quiz.a: 紅系前驅細胞（erythroblasts）

63240.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央偏左一顆含橘紅色粗顆粒的嗜酸性球，胞質內吞入一團圓形、均質、淡紫色的核物質，把自己的細胞核推到邊緣；這是發生在嗜酸性球的 LE 細胞現象。
features: Eosinophil with coarse orange-red specific granules and its nucleus displaced to the periphery
Large, round, smooth, homogeneous pale lilac intracytoplasmic inclusion lacking chromatin pattern (phagocytosed denatured nuclear material)
Surrounding cellular aspirate with myelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils, erythroid precursors and lymphocytes
Clean background with scattered platelets and cell debris
63240.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular with maturing myeloid and erythroid elements. Near the center, an eosinophil with coarse orange-red granules contains a large, round, homogeneous lilac intracytoplasmic body that displaces the eosinophil nucleus to the periphery; the inclusion lacks a recognizable chromatin pattern, consistent with phagocytosed denatured nuclear material. The same phenomenon in neutrophils defines the classic LE cell. Findings are consistent with an LE-cell phenomenon involving an eosinophil in the setting of systemic lupus erythematosus.

ddx.vs: The engulfed nucleus in a tart cell retains visible chromatin structure and the host is usually a monocyte/macrophage, whereas the LE body is smooth and homogeneous.
Ingested apoptotic cells show dense pyknotic chromatin fragments or a recognizable cell outline rather than a single swollen, structureless lilac mass.

ddx.dx: Dysplastic eosinophil with separated nuclear lobes
ddx.vs: Nuclear lobes stain dark with coarse chromatin and remain connected by filaments, unlike the pale, structureless ingested LE body.

63176.recognize_zh: 胸部 X 光（AP 位）可見兩側多數肋骨前端明顯膨大、骨小樑粗糙，右側較明顯，縱膈與脊椎旁陰影增寬，是無效造血導致的髓外造血與骨髓腔擴張。
features: Frontal (AP) chest radiograph of a young adult male
Marked expansion of the anterior/sternal ends of multiple ribs bilaterally, more prominent on the right
Coarse, widened rib contours consistent with marrow cavity expansion
Widened paravertebral/mediastinal soft tissue shadow
No definite focal consolidation assessable at this resolution
63176.describe_en: This is not a microscopic image but an AP chest radiograph. It shows expansion of the anterior ends of almost all ribs, more pronounced on the right, with coarse widened rib contours, and widening of the paravertebral soft tissue shadow. These changes reflect marrow hyperplasia and extramedullary hematopoiesis driven by chronic ineffective erythropoiesis. In a splenectomized patient with hemoglobin E/beta-thalassemia, findings are consistent with extramedullary hematopoiesis; paravertebral masses warrant MRI to exclude spinal cord compression.

ddx.vs: Neurogenic tumors are usually solitary and lack diffuse rib expansion, whereas extramedullary hematopoiesis presents as bilateral paravertebral masses with widened ribs in a patient with chronic hemolysis.
Lymphoma causes anterior/middle mediastinal nodal masses without generalized expansion of the ribs.

ddx.dx: Multiple myeloma or metastatic bone disease
ddx.vs: These produce lytic, destructive rib lesions rather than smooth diffuse expansion with a coarse trabecular pattern.

63112.recognize_zh: 高倍下見彼此吻合的不規則血管腔，內襯細胞飽滿、呈立方或釘狀（hobnail），核卵圓、細胞質淡而部分空泡化，並有細胞脫落到腔內；內襯細胞溫和無明顯異型，符合 littoral cell angioma。
features: Irregular, anastomosing vascular channels containing red cells
Channels lined by tall, plump cuboidal to hobnail cells rather than flat endothelium
Lining cell nuclei ovoid with fine chromatin and small nucleoli; mild variation only
Pale, focally vacuolated cytoplasm; some lining cells detached into lumens
Intervening stroma with lymphocytes and hemorrhage; no mitoses or necrosis evident
63112.describe_en: Higher-power view of the splenic lesion shows irregular, anastomosing vascular channels lined by plump, tall cuboidal to hobnail cells with ovoid nuclei and pale, focally vacuolated cytoplasm. Some lining cells are shed into the lumens alongside red cells. Nuclear atypia is mild, and mitoses and necrosis are not evident. Findings are consistent with littoral cell angioma; confirmation of the dual endothelial-histiocytic (CD31+/CD68+/CD21+, CD8-/CD34-) phenotype is recommended.

ddx.vs: Hemangioma channels are lined by flat, attenuated endothelium without hobnail or shed histiocytoid cells.
Angiosarcoma has marked pleomorphism, frequent mitoses, solid growth and necrosis rather than bland plump lining cells.

ddx.dx: Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis / reactive histiocytosis in red pulp
ddx.vs: Reactive histiocytes are scattered in otherwise normal cords and sinuses without forming a discrete lesion of anastomosing cystic channels.

63048.recognize_zh: 紅箭頭的異常嗜伊紅性前驅細胞內混有大顆、深紫黑色的嗜鹼性顆粒，黑箭頭則是核摺疊、呈單核球樣且有核仁的母細胞；異常嗜伊紅球加上骨髓單核球性母細胞，是 inv(16) AML 的典型組合。
features: Abnormal eosinophil precursor (red arrow) with large, dark purple-black basophilic-staining granules admixed with eosinophilic granules
Blasts (black arrows): large cells with round to folded monocytoid nuclei, fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Additional granulocytic precursor (promyelocyte/myelocyte) with abundant granular cytoplasm
Several eosinophil-lineage cells with distorted nuclei in the upper left
Background red cells and hemodiluted smear
63048.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows blasts with round to folded monocytoid nuclei, fine chromatin, conspicuous nucleoli and moderately basophilic cytoplasm. Abnormal eosinophil precursors are present, one containing large, dark purple basophilic-appearing granules intermixed with eosinophilic granules. Maturing granulocytic precursors are also seen. Findings are consistent with acute myelomonocytic leukemia with abnormal eosinophils, suggestive of AML with inv(16)(p13.1q22)/t(16;16); CBFB::MYH11 should be confirmed by cytogenetics, FISH or RT-PCR.

ddx.vs: Other myelomonocytic leukemias lack the abnormal eosinophils with large basophilic granules; genetics is required to confirm.

t(8;21) blasts have abundant cytoplasm with a salmon-colored perinuclear hof, single long Auer rods and pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules, without monocytoid nuclei and dysplastic basophil-granulated eosinophils.
CMML has <20% blasts and promonocytes with persistent monocytosis and lacks inv(16) eosinophils.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and tyrosine kinase fusion
ddx.vs: These show mature eosinophilia with PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2 rearrangement rather than monocytoid blasts with abnormal basophilic eosinophil granules.

exam.answer_en: AML with inv(16)/t(16;16) CBFB::MYH11 — myelomonocytic blasts with abnormal eosinophils containing large purple-black basophilic granules
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指紅箭頭細胞問「這顆嗜伊紅前驅細胞哪裡不正常」：混有大顆深紫黑色嗜鹼性顆粒，再問對應的遺傳異常 inv(16)。
細胞化學：異常嗜伊紅球的 chloroacetate esterase 呈陽性（正常嗜伊紅球為陰性）；母細胞 MPO 與 NSE 可同時陽性，反映骨髓單核球分化。
inv(16) 在常規核型上可能很細微而漏看，應以 FISH 或 RT-PCR 檢測 CBFB::MYH11；WHO 5th 不設母細胞門檻，ICC 2022 需 ≥10%。
ELN 2022 屬 favorable；KIT 突變常見；可用 CBFB::MYH11 定量 PCR 追蹤 MRD，並以 high-dose cytarabine 為鞏固基礎。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為一般 acute myelomonocytic leukemia 或 CMML with eosinophilia；關鍵在嗜伊紅球含異常大嗜鹼性顆粒，確診仍需 CBFB::MYH11。

quiz.q: 紅箭頭所指含大顆深紫色顆粒的嗜伊紅前驅細胞，提示哪一種 AML 遺傳亞型？
quiz.a: AML with inv(16)(p13.1q22) 或 t(16;16)；CBFB::MYH11

62984.recognize_zh: 臨床照片可見軀幹紅色丘疹斑塊合併脫屑結痂，皮膚切片真皮內有密集小淋巴球浸潤且表皮保留；免疫染色中小型淋巴球瀰漫強陽性，符合 CLL/SLL 皮膚浸潤出現在先前發炎或受損皮膚部位（isotopic response）的情境。
features: Clinical photos: erythematous, scaly, crusted papules and plaques on the trunk/flank
Low power H&E: dense, band-like to nodular dermal lymphoid infiltrate with an overlying intact epidermis and a narrow grenz zone
High power H&E: monotonous small to medium lymphocytes with round to slightly irregular nuclei, coarse chromatin and scant cytoplasm
IHC panel D: diffuse strong membranous/cytoplasmic staining of nearly all infiltrating lymphocytes (B-cell/CLL marker per context)
IHC panel E: many positive nuclei among the infiltrate (nuclear marker, e.g. proliferation or transcription factor)
IHC panel G: only scattered positive cells in the superficial dermis and epidermis
62984.describe_en: Composite figure: clinical photographs show erythematous, scaly and crusted papules coalescing into plaques on the trunk. Skin biopsy shows a dense dermal lymphoid infiltrate arranged in sheets and nodules beneath an intact epidermis. At high power the infiltrate consists of monotonous small to medium-sized lymphocytes with condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm; large transformed cells are not prominent at this magnification. Immunostains show diffuse strong positivity of the infiltrate with one marker and a nuclear-staining marker in many cells, while a further stain highlights only scattered cells. In the clinical context, findings are consistent with cutaneous involvement by CLL/SLL arising at a site of prior skin inflammation (isotopic immune response); the specific markers are not labeled in the image.

ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates are mixed T- and B-cells with germinal centers and polytypic plasma cells, whereas CLL shows a monotonous CD5+/CD23+ B-cell infiltrate with light-chain restriction.
Marginal zone lymphoma has plasmacytoid/monocytoid cells and reactive follicles and is CD5-/CD23-, unlike CD5+/CD23+/LEF1+ CLL.
Mycosis fungoides shows epidermotropic atypical T-cells with Pautrier microabscesses, whereas this infiltrate spares the epidermis and is B-cell predominant.
Richter transformation shows sheets of large cells with vesicular chromatin, prominent nucleoli and high Ki-67, not the small monotonous cells seen here.

62920.recognize_zh: 箭頭指向一個紅血球內單一、圓形、深紫紅色的小包涵體，即 Howell-Jolly 小體（核殘餘，提示脾功能低下或切脾後）；背景有大小不一的紅血球、標靶細胞、碎片及右上角的有核紅血球，符合重型乙型地中海貧血。
features: Red cell with a single small, round, dense purple Howell-Jolly body (arrow)
Marked anisocytosis including microcytes and larger round cells
Poikilocytes including target cells, fragments, and irregular forms
Nucleated red blood cell with dense nucleus at upper right
Granulocyte at top of the field; scattered platelets
62920.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with microcytes, target cells, and fragmented red cells. The arrow marks a red cell containing a single small, round, dense purple Howell-Jolly body. A nucleated red blood cell is present at the upper right, together with a granulocyte and scattered platelets. Howell-Jolly bodies indicate splenic hypofunction or prior splenectomy, which is common in thalassemia major. Findings are consistent with beta-thalassemia major with Howell-Jolly bodies.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are multiple small peripheral clustered granules that are Prussian blue positive, not a single round central-to-eccentric dot.
A platelet on top of a red cell is larger with a pale hyalomere and granular center and lies in a different focal plane.
Plasmodium rings show a chromatin dot attached to a thin blue cytoplasmic ring rather than a solitary dense dot.
Stippling consists of many fine or coarse blue dots distributed throughout the red cell.

exam.answer_en: Howell-Jolly body in beta-thalassemia major — single round dense purple red-cell inclusion with target cells, fragments and an NRBC
pearls_zh: 考法：箭頭指紅血球內單一圓形深紫小點，問名稱（Howell-Jolly body）、成分（DNA 核殘餘）與臨床意義（脾功能低下/切脾後）。
Howell-Jolly body Feulgen 染色陽性、Prussian blue 陰性；Pappenheimer bodies 則為含鐵顆粒，Prussian blue 陽性。
其他造成 HJ bodies 的情形：功能性無脾（鐮刀型貧血）、celiac disease、巨母紅血球性貧血與病態造血。
切脾或無脾者感染風險：encapsulated bacteria（S. pneumoniae、H. influenzae、N. meningitidis），需疫苗接種。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為重疊的血小板或 Pappenheimer bodies：血小板較大、有淡色外圍且不在同一焦平面；Pappenheimer 為多顆細小周邊顆粒且鐵染色陽性。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指紅血球內的單一圓形深紫小體是什麼？代表什麼臨床狀態？
quiz.a: Howell-Jolly body；脾功能低下或切脾後

62856.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中有多團無色、透明的長方形或菱形針柱狀結晶呈放射狀（玫瑰花狀）排列，周圍圍繞多核異物巨細胞與纖維化基質，這種放射狀排列的透明結晶是草酸鈣沉積（oxalosis）的特徵。
features: Clusters of colorless, refractile, rhomboid to rod-shaped crystals arranged in radiating rosettes
Crystal aggregates surrounded by multinucleated foreign-body-type giant cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm
Fibrotic spindle-cell stroma replacing normal hematopoietic marrow
Scattered brown pigment granules (likely hemosiderin) at lower left
No residual hematopoietic cells in this field
62856.describe_en: High-power H&E section of bone marrow trephine shows replacement of the marrow space by fibrotic spindle-cell stroma containing multiple aggregates of colorless, refractile, rhomboid and rod-shaped crystals arranged in radiating rosettes. The crystal deposits are rimmed by multinucleated foreign-body-type giant cells, and scattered brown pigment is present. Normal hematopoietic elements are not seen in this field. The crystal morphology, with confirmation of birefringence under polarized light, is consistent with calcium oxalate deposition (oxalosis), typically primary hyperoxaluria or end-stage renal disease.

ddx.vs: Urate crystals are needle-shaped, strongly negatively birefringent and usually dissolve in aqueous formalin, leaving amorphous tophaceous material with palisading histiocytes.
CPPD crystals are short rhomboid, weakly positively birefringent, and typically involve cartilage and joints rather than diffusely replacing marrow.
Metastatic carcinoma shows cohesive keratin-positive epithelial nests in fibrotic marrow, without crystal rosettes.
PMF shows atypical clustered megakaryocytes and osteosclerosis without crystalline deposits or foreign-body giant cells.

62728.recognize_zh: 中倍 H&E 下成熟脂肪細胞與大片細胞密集的造血組織交錯，造血區內可見紅血球前驅細胞、骨髓系細胞與少數深染的大型細胞（疑為巨核細胞），並有較密集的小淋巴球聚集，整體如同脂肪內的骨髓，符合腎上腺骨髓脂肪瘤。
features: Admixture of mature adipocytes and cellular hematopoietic tissue in roughly equal proportions
Hematopoietic areas composed of small dark erythroid precursors and granulocytic cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm
Occasional larger hyperchromatic cells consistent with megakaryocytes
Denser cluster of small round cells in the center, possibly a lymphoid aggregate or erythroid cluster
Congested red cells and delicate fibrous septa; no lipoblasts or atypical stromal cells
62728.describe_en: Section of the adrenal mass at medium power shows mature adipocytes intermixed with cellular hematopoietic tissue containing erythroid and granulocytic precursors, occasional megakaryocyte-like cells, congested red cells and a denser central aggregate of small round cells. Delicate fibrous septa are present, and there are no lipoblasts or cytologically atypical stromal cells. Lineage detail is limited at this magnification. Findings are consistent with adrenal myelolipoma with a prominent hematopoietic component.

ddx.vs: Forms masses of hematopoietic tissue in patients with marrow failure or hemoglobinopathy, typically without a substantial mature adipose component.
Features atypical hyperchromatic stromal cells and lipoblasts in fibrous septa, rather than trilineage hematopoiesis.

ddx.dx: Involvement by lymphoma or myeloid sarcoma
ddx.vs: Shows a monotonous sheet of atypical lymphoid cells or blasts effacing the tissue, rather than orderly maturing multilineage hematopoiesis.

62664.recognize_zh: 左側為成片的大型細胞，細胞質豐富偏雙染性、核偏心、染色質空泡狀並有明顯核仁，呈漿母細胞/免疫母細胞樣，界線清楚；右側對照為小型成熟淋巴球，大小差異明顯，符合 PEL 的細胞型態。
features: Sheet of large cells, several times the size of adjacent small lymphocytes
Abundant amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm with distinct cell borders
Round to oval, often eccentric nuclei with vesicular chromatin and prominent central or multiple nucleoli
Plasmablastic/immunoblastic cytology with occasional binucleated cells and mitoses
Scattered apoptotic bodies and small lymphocytes within the tumor sheet
Adjacent small mature lymphocyte population on the right
62664.describe_en: H&E section at high power shows a cohesive sheet of large neoplastic cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm and distinct cell borders. The nuclei are round to oval and often eccentric, with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli, giving an immunoblastic to plasmablastic appearance; occasional binucleated forms, mitoses and apoptotic bodies are present. A population of small mature lymphocytes lies to the right for comparison. Findings are consistent with a high-grade large-cell lymphoma with plasmablastic features; in the context of HHV8 positivity, they are consistent with extracavitary primary effusion lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Cytologically near-identical; separated by HHV8 (LANA-1) negativity.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic plasma cell myeloma / plasmablastic myeloma
ddx.vs: Shares plasmacytic cytology but is HHV8-negative, usually expresses CD138 with clonal light chain and has serum paraprotein and lytic lesions.
Hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei and strong CD30 with ALK or T-cell markers, HHV8-negative.
Cohesive polygonal cells may mimic this; cytokeratin positivity and CD45/MUM1 negativity distinguish it.

exam.answer_en: Extracavitary primary effusion lymphoma (H&E) — sheets of large immunoblastic/plasmablastic cells with prominent nucleoli
pearls_zh: 考法：H&E 問「大型細胞型態」屬 immunoblastic/plasmablastic，並問下一步最關鍵的染色（HHV8 LANA-1、EBER、B 細胞與漿細胞標記）。
Plasmablastic 型態鑑別三角：PEL（HHV8+）、plasmablastic lymphoma（HHV8−、常 EBV+）、plasmablastic myeloma（HHV8−、有 M protein 與溶骨）。
此類腫瘤常缺 CD20，因此 CD20 陰性時不可排除淋巴瘤，需加 CD45、MUM1、CD138 與 CD30。
應檢驗 HIV；PEL 多見於 HIV 感染或其他免疫低下者（亦見於 HHV8 流行地區的老年人）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為低分化癌或 ALCL；癌 cytokeratin+ 且 CD45/MUM1−，ALCL 有 hallmark cells 且 HHV8−，須以 IHC 而非單看 H&E 區分。

quiz.q: H&E 見大型 plasmablastic 細胞片狀浸潤、CD20 陰性，哪一個染色可區分 PEL 與 plasmablastic lymphoma？
quiz.a: HHV8 LANA-1（PEL 陽性、plasmablastic lymphoma 陰性）

62600.recognize_zh: CD30 免疫染色中部分腫瘤細胞呈強弱不一的細胞膜及細胞質（高基氏體區）棕色染色，其餘細胞弱陽性或陰性，屬於部分、異質性的 CD30 表現。
features: Diffuse sheet of tumor cells with round, eccentric nuclei
Heterogeneous CD30 staining: a subset with strong membranous and paranuclear (Golgi) cytoplasmic staining
Many cells with weak granular cytoplasmic blush; others negative
No large Reed-Sternberg-like or anaplastic hallmark cells evident
62600.describe_en: CD30 immunohistochemistry shows variable expression in the neoplastic infiltrate, with a subset of cells demonstrating strong membranous and Golgi-pattern staining and a larger proportion showing weak cytoplasmic staining or no staining. There are no large anaplastic or Hodgkin-like cells. Partial CD30 expression is common in EBV-associated and plasmacytic/plasmablastic neoplasms and is not specific. Findings are in keeping with EBV-positive plasmacytoma-like PTLD.

ddx.vs: ALCL shows uniform strong CD30 in large hallmark cells with T-cell antigens, rather than heterogeneous staining in plasma cells.
CHL-type PTLD has scattered large CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells in a reactive background, not sheets of plasmacytoid cells.
PEL is often CD30-positive with plasmablastic cytology but is HHV8/LANA-positive.

62536.recognize_zh: S100 免疫染色下，體積很大的組織球細胞核與細胞質都強陽性，細胞質內包著完整、未被 S100 染色的小淋巴球（細胞穿越現象，emperipolesis），是 Rosai-Dorfman 病（SHML）的特徵。
features: Very large histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm, some multinucleated, showing strong nuclear and cytoplasmic S100 positivity
Intact small lymphocytes (S100-negative, blue nuclei) within the histiocyte cytoplasm, often surrounded by a clear halo (emperipolesis)
Histiocyte nuclei round to oval with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli
Background of S100-negative small lymphocytes and plasma cells
62536.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for S100 shows numerous large histiocytes with strong nuclear and cytoplasmic staining. Many contain intact, S100-negative lymphocytes within their cytoplasm, some surrounded by clear halos, highlighting emperipolesis. A large multinucleated histiocyte at right contains several engulfed lymphocytes. The background small lymphoid cells are negative. Findings are consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease (sinus histiocytosis with massive lymphadenopathy).

ddx.vs: LCH cells are smaller with grooved, reniform nuclei, lack emperipolesis, and are CD1a and langerin positive, whereas RDD histiocytes are CD1a negative.
Ordinary sinus histiocytes are S100 negative and lack prominent emperipolesis.
Melanoma cells are S100 positive but also SOX10/HMB45/Melan-A positive, cytologically atypical, and lack engulfed intact lymphocytes.

exam.answer_en: Rosai-Dorfman disease — very large S100-positive histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm containing intact S100-negative lymphocytes (emperipolesis)
pearls_zh: 考法：指著 S100 陽性大細胞內的藍色小核，問是什麼細胞在裡面（完整淋巴球，有時為漿細胞或紅血球）與此現象名稱。
IHC 確認：RDD 組織球 S100+、CD163+、CD68+，CD1a 與 langerin 陰性，可與 LCH 區分。
家族型 RDD 與 SLC29A3 突變相關（H syndrome 等）；自體免疫性淋巴增生症候群（ALPS）患者也可見 RDD 樣病變。
淋巴結外 RDD 常見部位包括皮膚、鼻腔與鼻竇、眼眶與中樞神經，形態相同但竇擴張不一定明顯。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 emperipolesis 誤認為一般吞噬作用（如 HLH 的 hemophagocytosis）：吞噬細胞內的血球會被分解變形；RDD 組織球內的淋巴球完整並有透明暈，且組織球 S100 陽性。

quiz.q: 圖中 S100 陽性組織球的 CD1a 應為陽性或陰性？此結果用來排除什麼疾病？
quiz.a: 陰性；Langerhans cell histiocytosis

62472.recognize_zh: 胸腹部臨床照片中有多發、大小不一的深紫褐色斑片與略隆起的斑塊，部分呈圓形或環狀、表面輕度苔蘚化並有細屑，背景皮膚色素不均，符合蕈狀肉芽腫的多發斑塊期皮膚病灶。
features: Clinical photograph of the anterior chest and abdomen
Multiple variably sized dusky violaceous to dark brown patches and slightly raised plaques
Several round to annular lesions with darker borders, including lesions around both nipples and on the abdomen
Background mottled hyperpigmentation with fine scale and mild lichenification
No tumor-stage nodules or ulceration
62472.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the anterior trunk shows multiple dusky violaceous-brown patches and thin plaques of varying size, some round to annular with darker borders, on a background of mottled hyperpigmentation with fine scale. No exophytic tumors or ulcers are present. This is a clinical image and is not diagnostic on its own; in a patient with documented blood involvement, the distribution and appearance are compatible with patch/plaque-stage mycosis fungoides.

ddx.vs: Nummular eczema forms coin-shaped, often vesicular or crusted plaques and biopsy shows spongiosis rather than epidermotropism of atypical cerebriform lymphocytes.
Psoriatic plaques are sharply demarcated with thick silvery scale and show psoriasiform hyperplasia with Munro microabscesses.
Tinea shows an active scaly advancing border with central clearing and fungal hyphae on KOH or PAS.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma
ddx.vs: ATLL has HTLV-1 positivity and CD25-positive 'flower cells' in blood, which distinguishes it from mycosis fungoides.
