62408.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中央一大團邊界不清的淋巴球聚集，由小型成熟淋巴球為主，夾雜漿細胞樣淋巴球與漿細胞，周圍有散在含鐵血黃素的巨噬細胞（棕色色素）；這種小淋巴球合併漿細胞分化的骨髓浸潤是淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤的典型表現。
features: Large, poorly circumscribed lymphoid aggregate within a fatty-hematopoietic marrow
Predominantly small lymphocytes with round, dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Admixed plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and more cytoplasm
Scattered macrophages with golden-brown hemosiderin pigment
Infiltrate blends into adjacent hematopoietic marrow; no bony trabeculae in this field
62408.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows a large, poorly circumscribed lymphoid aggregate composed predominantly of small lymphocytes with round dense nuclei, admixed with plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells. Scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages are present, and the infiltrate merges with the surrounding hematopoietic marrow. There are no large transformed cells or germinal centers. Findings are consistent with involvement by a low-grade B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation, compatible with lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma in the setting of an IgM paraprotein and supported by light-chain restriction and MYD88 L265P.

ddx.vs: Benign aggregates are small, well-circumscribed, non-paratrabecular and composed of mixed T and B cells without light-chain-restricted plasma cells.
CLL/SLL has proliferation centers with prolymphocytes, is CD5/CD23/LEF1-positive and lacks a prominent clonal plasma cell component.
Splenic or nodal MZL can show plasmacytic differentiation, favoring intrasinusoidal infiltration and lacking MYD88 L265P in most cases.
Mantle cell lymphoma lacks plasma cells, has slightly irregular nuclei and is cyclin D1/SOX11-positive.

62344.recognize_zh: 骨小樑（下方粉紅色骨）旁邊有一片大型細胞，細胞質豐富淡染、核泡狀帶核仁，與右上方小而圓、深染的正常紅血球與骨髓系前驅細胞形成明顯分界，是漿細胞瘤灶性侵犯骨髓的表現。
features: Paratrabecular sheet of large cells with abundant pale amphophilic cytoplasm
Eccentric round to oval nuclei with vesicular chromatin and small distinct nucleoli
Loss of intervening normal hematopoiesis within the focus
Sharp transition to adjacent normal erythroid (dark round nuclei) and myeloid precursors
Occasional binucleated atypical cells
62344.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a patchy paratrabecular aggregate of large atypical cells replacing the normal hematopoietic elements. The cells have abundant pale amphophilic cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli. Adjacent marrow contains unremarkable maturing erythroid and myeloid precursors with a relatively sharp interface. Findings are consistent with focal bone marrow involvement by plasma cell myeloma, to be confirmed by CD138 and kappa/lambda staining.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma forms cohesive epithelial nests often with desmoplasia and is cytokeratin-positive, whereas myeloma cells are CD138-positive and light-chain restricted.
Follicular lymphoma aggregates are composed of small cleaved lymphocytes with scant cytoplasm and CD20/CD10 positivity, not large cells with abundant plasmacytoid cytoplasm.
Reactive plasma cells are small, mature, scattered or perivascular and polytypic rather than forming sheets of atypical nucleolated cells.

62280.recognize_zh: IgD 染色中，大結節內 IgD 陽性套層細胞（mantle cells）向內滲入、把生發中心切割成網狀的淡染碎片；下方的正常濾泡則是完整的 IgD 陽性套層環包住 IgD 陰性的生發中心，兩者對比正是 PTGC 的典型表現。
features: Enlarged nodule with IgD-positive mantle zone B cells extending into and permeating the germinal center
Germinal center broken into irregular, IgD-negative pale fragments giving a reticulated, moth-eaten pattern
Normal secondary follicle at the bottom with an intact IgD-positive mantle ring surrounding an IgD-negative germinal center (internal control)
Small IgD-positive ring-like follicle at the left edge
Interfollicular areas show only weak background staining
62280.describe_en: IgD immunohistochemistry shows an enlarged nodule in which IgD-positive mantle zone B cells infiltrate the germinal center and break it into irregular IgD-negative fragments, producing a reticulated pattern with loss of the sharp mantle-germinal center boundary. By contrast, an adjacent normal secondary follicle shows an intact IgD-positive mantle cuff surrounding an IgD-negative germinal center. This pattern of mantle cell infiltration into a disrupted germinal center is characteristic of progressive transformation of germinal centers.

ddx.vs: NLPHL nodules also contain IgD+ small B cells, so the discriminator is the presence of LP cells (CD20+, OCT2+, BOB1+, EMA+, sometimes IgD+) rimmed by PD-1+ T cells within the nodules.
Follicular lymphoma follicles show attenuated or absent IgD-positive mantles around expanded IgD-negative neoplastic follicles, rather than IgD+ mantle cells invading a fragmented germinal center.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma shows expanded monotonous cyclin D1/SOX11-positive mantle zones around naked germinal centers, not polytypic IgD+ cells infiltrating the center.

exam.answer_en: PTGC on IgD immunostain — IgD+ mantle B cells permeate and fragment the germinal center, contrasted with a normal follicle's intact IgD+ mantle ring
pearls_zh: 考法：給 IgD 染色問「哪顆是正常濾泡、哪顆是 PTGC」：正常濾泡為完整 IgD+ 套層環包住 IgD− 生發中心；PTGC 則 IgD+ 細胞侵入把生發中心切成網狀碎片。
IgD 為 naive 套層 B 細胞標記，生發中心 B 細胞 IgD 陰性，因此圖下方正常濾泡可當內部對照。
與 NLPHL 鑑別：NLPHL 結節內 CD20+ LP 細胞散在，周圍有 PD1+ T 細胞 rosette；部分 NLPHL 的 LP 細胞可 IgD 陽性，須結合 CD20、PD1 判讀。
PTGC 屬反應性，但可與 NLPHL 同時或先後出現，病理報告應註明並建議追蹤，持續或復發淋巴結需再切片。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 IgD+ 細胞擴張誤判為 mantle cell lymphoma：MCL 為 cyclin D1/SOX11 陽性單形細胞，且無被切割的生發中心殘塊；PTGC 內仍有 IgD− 生發中心碎片。

quiz.q: 此 IgD 染色中，下方濾泡與上方大結節的染色型態有何不同？上方結節代表什麼？
quiz.a: 下方為完整 IgD+ 套層環包 IgD− 生發中心；上方 IgD+ 套層細胞滲入切割生發中心，代表 PTGC

62216.recognize_zh: 紅血球背景中有一小團約七顆彼此黏著的大細胞，細胞質灰紫並充滿透明空泡，核有明顯藍色核仁，這種成團、帶空泡且非造血的細胞是骨髓轉移性癌的線索。
features: Small cohesive cluster of about seven large cells sharing cell borders
Round to oval nuclei with granular chromatin and prominent blue nucleoli
Moderate grey-purple cytoplasm with numerous small clear vacuoles
Cells far larger than surrounding red cells; relatively high N:C ratio
Background of red cells with stacking; no admixed hematopoietic cells in the cluster
62216.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a small cohesive cluster of large non-hematopoietic cells in a background of red cells. The cells have round to oval nuclei with granular chromatin and prominent nucleoli, and moderate grey-purple cytoplasm containing numerous clear vacuoles. The tight cohesion with shared borders is not a feature of normal marrow elements. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma, compatible with breast primary in this patient; immunohistochemical confirmation is recommended.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts have eccentric nuclei with a distant pale hof and small nucleoli, and are not tightly cohesive with vacuolated cytoplasm.
Burkitt cells are vacuolated but discohesive, with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and CD45/CD20/CD10 expression.
Plasma cells have eccentric clock-face nuclei with perinuclear hof and are CD138 positive, cytokeratin negative.

62152.recognize_zh: 數顆中大型母細胞（blast），核質比高、染色質細緻、可見小核仁，胞質少而淡藍、無明顯顆粒，部分核有凹陷，符合骨髓母細胞（myeloblast）。
features: Medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio
Round to indented or folded nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin
Small but discernible nucleoli in several cells
Scant to moderate pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm; no Auer rods seen in this field
Background of numerous red cells without maturing granulocytes in this field
62152.describe_en: Aspirate smear shows a hemodilute field with numerous red cells and scattered medium to large blasts. The blasts have high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to indented nuclei with fine open chromatin and small nucleoli, and scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm. Auer rods are not identified in this field, and maturing granulocytic precursors are not represented, so maturation cannot be assessed from this image alone. Findings are consistent with myeloblasts; classification as AML with maturation requires differential counting, MPO/flow cytometry, and genetic studies.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts tend to be smaller with scantier cytoplasm and inconspicuous nucleoli, but separation requires MPO negativity and a lymphoid immunophenotype by flow cytometry.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have more abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with vacuoles and delicately folded nuclei, and are nonspecific esterase positive with CD14/CD64 expression.
Microgranular APL shows bilobed or reniform nuclei with fine cytoplasmic dusting and often Auer rod bundles, confirmed by PML::RARA.
AML-M1 has fewer than 10% maturing granulocytic cells, whereas AML-M2 requires at least 10% maturing neutrophil lineage cells on a differential count.

exam.answer_en: Acute myeloid leukemia with maturation (FAB M2) — myeloblasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and small nucleoli
pearls_zh: 考法：指這些細胞問是 myeloblast 還是 lymphoblast；型態重疊時必須靠 MPO／Sudan black B 或 flow 判定系別。
細胞化學：MPO 或 SBB 在 ≥3% blasts 陽性支持骨髓系；Auer rod 出現即可確定骨髓系，但此視野未見。
AML with maturation 最常關聯 t(8;21)(q22;q22.1) RUNX1::RUNX1T1：blast 常有橙色細顆粒、細長 Auer rod、核周淡染區，flow 可異常表現 CD19、PAX5。
t(8;21) 屬 ELN favorable，但合併 KIT 突變需注意；WHO 5th 對 RUNX1::RUNX1T1 AML 不設 blast 門檻，ICC 2022 為 ≥10%。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把無顆粒 myeloblast 誤判為 lymphoblast：lymphoblast 核仁不明顯、染色質較均勻緻密且 MPO 陰性；本病需 MPO 陽性或 flow 證實骨髓系。

quiz.q: 這些高核質比、染色質細緻並有小核仁的細胞，要確定是骨髓系應做哪種細胞化學染色？
quiz.a: Myeloperoxidase（MPO）或 Sudan black B

62024.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中多為帶顆粒的骨髓系前驅細胞：箭頭所指為核圓、有核旁淡染區與細紫紅顆粒的前骨髓細胞（promyelocyte），周圍還有數個含顆粒的骨髓細胞與較成熟的後骨髓細胞，顯示 G-CSF 刺激下的骨髓系增生與左移。
features: Predominance of granulated myeloid precursors: promyelocytes, myelocytes and metamyelocytes
Arrowed promyelocyte: large cell with round eccentric nucleus, fine chromatin, perinuclear clear zone and abundant azurophilic granules
Myelocytes with round-to-oval nuclei, more condensed chromatin and granular pink-purple cytoplasm
Occasional band/metamyelocyte with indented nucleus; one cell with dark condensed chromatin (possible erythroid precursor)
No Auer rods, no blasts clusters and no dysplastic hypogranulation evident; stain precipitate in background
62024.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a predominance of granulocytic precursors across the maturation spectrum, including large promyelocytes with round eccentric nuclei, a perinuclear clear zone and abundant azurophilic granules (arrow), myelocytes, and occasional metamyelocytes/band forms. A cell with dark condensed chromatin may represent an erythroid precursor. No Auer rods, blast aggregates, or obvious granulocytic dysplasia are identified, and background stain precipitate is present. Findings are consistent with a left-shifted myeloid hyperplasia secondary to G-CSF therapy; correlation with the recent G-CSF administration and a blast count on a well-spread area is recommended to exclude residual or relapsed leukemia.

ddx.vs: APL shows sheets of abnormal hypergranular promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and faggot cells with arrested maturation, whereas here maturation to myelocytes and metamyelocytes is preserved.
CML shows myeloid hyperplasia with myelocyte bulge, basophilia and small hypolobated megakaryocytes with BCR::ABL1 fusion, and lacks a G-CSF history.
Regenerating marrow also shows synchronous left-shifted myelopoiesis and is separated mainly by clinical timing, with both lacking a blast excess.
ALL relapse shows agranular lymphoblasts with high N:C ratio and fine chromatin, whereas these cells are granulated maturing myeloid forms.

61960.recognize_zh: CD20染色中陽性細胞為大小中等、散在或成小群的背景B細胞，而核大、淡染的大型腫瘤細胞為陰性；ALCL腫瘤細胞不表現B細胞標記，這是排除大B細胞淋巴瘤的重要一步。
features: Membranous and granular cytoplasmic CD20 staining in scattered and loosely clustered small-to-intermediate cells
Large cells with vesicular, pale nuclei are CD20-negative
Positive cells interspersed among negative tumor cells rather than forming uniform sheets
Granular background staining in the stroma
61960.describe_en: CD20 immunostain shows positive staining in scattered and loosely clustered small-to-intermediate B cells, whereas the large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei are negative. The positive cells are interpreted as residual reactive B cells. Lack of CD20 in the neoplastic population supports a non-B-cell lineage, consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma in conjunction with CD30 and T-cell/cytotoxic markers.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, anaplastic variant
ddx.vs: Anaplastic DLBCL may be CD30+ but the large cells are CD20+/PAX5+, unlike the negative large cells here.
HRS cells are usually CD20-negative too, so separation relies on weak PAX5 and CD15 positivity in cHL versus PAX5 negativity with cytotoxic markers in ALCL.
This entity has plasmablastic large cells that are CD20-negative but ALK-positive with plasma cell markers and granular cytoplasmic ALK, and is CD30-negative or weak.

61896.recognize_zh: 皮下脂肪與真皮的淋巴浸潤中，CD56 幾乎全為陰性，只有極少數細胞呈弱陽性；表示浸潤並非以 NK 細胞為主，屬於 HV 樣淋巴增生性疾病（HVLPD）的 T 細胞型表現。
features: Subcutaneous fat and deep dermis with a moderately dense interstitial lymphoid infiltrate
CD56 negative in the vast majority of infiltrating cells
Only rare cells with weak granular/cytoplasmic CD56 staining
No angiocentric clusters of CD56-positive cells
Adipocytes separated by lymphoid cells without obvious rimming
61896.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD56 on a skin biopsy shows a moderately dense lymphoid infiltrate in the deep dermis and subcutaneous fat. The infiltrating cells are almost entirely CD56 negative, with only rare weakly stained cells, and there are no angiocentric aggregates of CD56-positive cells. This argues against an NK-cell-predominant process. In combination with a CD3-positive, EBER-positive infiltrate, findings favor the T-cell type of hydroa vacciniforme-like lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: ENKTL is usually diffusely CD56 positive with angiocentric necrotizing growth, whereas CD56 is essentially negative here.

ddx.dx: NK-cell type HVLPD / severe mosquito bite allergy
ddx.vs: NK-cell-type disease shows CD56-positive EBV-infected NK cells, often associated with hypersensitivity to mosquito bites, unlike this CD56-negative infiltrate.
Gamma-delta TCL is frequently CD56 positive with TCR-delta expression and is typically EBER negative.

61832.recognize_zh: 非黏合性的大型多形細胞成片生長，細胞質豐富嗜伊紅、部分呈空泡狀，核偏心、形狀不規則，並散見奇異的多核巨細胞，夾雜發炎細胞；這種大型組織球樣惡性細胞的組合，經 CD68/CD163/PU.1 證實後即為組織球肉瘤。
features: Large discohesive neoplastic cells with abundant eosinophilic to focally vacuolated cytoplasm
Marked nuclear pleomorphism with eccentric, oval to irregular and reniform nuclei
Scattered bizarre multinucleated tumor giant cells
Vesicular chromatin with visible nucleoli in some cells
Admixed small lymphocytes and inflammatory cells in a loose background
61832.describe_en: Section shows a diffuse proliferation of large discohesive cells with abundant eosinophilic, focally vacuolated cytoplasm and markedly pleomorphic, eccentric oval to irregular nuclei with vesicular chromatin and occasional nucleoli. Scattered bizarre multinucleated tumor giant cells are present, together with admixed small lymphocytes and other inflammatory cells. The morphology is that of a high-grade neoplasm with histiocytoid features and requires immunohistochemistry to exclude lymphoma, carcinoma, and melanoma. With CD68, CD163, and PU.1 expression and absence of other lineage markers, findings are consistent with histiocytic sarcoma.

ddx.vs: ALCL hallmark cells have horseshoe nuclei with a paranuclear Golgi zone, often sinusoidal growth, and are CD30+ with ALK or T-cell markers rather than CD163/PU.1.
Carcinoma and melanoma form more cohesive groups and express keratins or SOX10/S100/HMB45, lacking CD163.
LC sarcoma retains grooved nuclei and CD1a/Langerin positivity.
Undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma may contain CD68+ cells but lacks diffuse CD163 and PU.1 expression and has a more spindled fascicular component.

61768.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中有兩顆異常淋巴細胞，比小淋巴球大，核有凹陷或不規則輪廓、染色質細緻分散、細胞質稀少淡藍；這種帶母細胞樣染色質的中型異常淋巴細胞在血中出現，符合母細胞型被套細胞淋巴瘤的血液侵犯。
features: Two atypical lymphoid cells, medium-sized (larger than a small lymphocyte)
Irregular, indented/cleaved nuclear contours
Finely dispersed chromatin, more open than a mature lymphocyte
Scant to moderate pale basophilic cytoplasm
No cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods; background red cells unremarkable aside from occasional crenated forms
61768.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two atypical medium-sized lymphoid cells with irregular, indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, and scant pale blue cytoplasm. No granules, Auer rods, or smudge cells are seen in this field, and the red cells show only occasional crenation artifact. The cells are larger with more open chromatin than typical CLL cells. In the context of the known diagnosis, findings are consistent with circulating mantle cell lymphoma cells with blastoid features.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are small with round nuclei and coarse block-like chromatin with smudge cells, and are CD23-positive and cyclin D1-negative.
Blasts are TdT- and/or CD34-positive on flow cytometry, whereas MCL cells show surface light-chain restriction with CD5 and CD20.
FL cells are small with deeply cleaved (buttock-like) nuclei and are CD10-positive and CD5-negative.

61704.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中幾乎整片都是漿細胞：核偏心、胞質深藍且有核旁淡染區（hof），部分細胞核較大、染色質較細並可見明顯核仁，還有雙核形式，呈未成熟／異型漿細胞片狀增生。
features: Sheets of plasma cells replacing normal marrow elements
Round, eccentric nuclei; many with finer chromatin and distinct nucleoli (immature/plasmablastic features)
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof in better-preserved cells
Occasional binucleated plasma cells and scattered small cytoplasmic vacuoles
Anisonucleosis with variation in nuclear size
Few residual granulocytic precursors and red cells in the background
61704.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows sheets of plasma cells that essentially replace normal hematopoietic elements. The plasma cells have abundant basophilic cytoplasm, eccentric round nuclei and perinuclear clearing, and many show immature features including larger nuclei with finer chromatin and distinct nucleoli; binucleated forms and fine cytoplasmic vacuoles are also present. Only rare residual myeloid precursors are seen. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with immature plasma cell morphology; flow cytometry or CD138/light-chain studies can confirm clonality.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature, small, usually <10-20% and scattered or perivascular, without sheets, nucleoli or binucleation, and are polytypic.
PBL consists of larger blasts with high N:C ratio, often EBER+ and MYC-rearranged, typically at extranodal sites in immunosuppressed patients, and lacks a serum M protein or lytic bone disease.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with only a minority of mature plasma cells, rather than sheets of atypical plasma cells.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monoblasts and promonocytes have folded nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm without a hof and are NSE-positive rather than CD138-positive.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell myeloma, marrow aspirate — sheets of immature plasma cells with nucleoli, anisonucleosis and binucleation replacing normal elements
pearls_zh: 考法：指整片深藍胞質、核偏心、有核仁的細胞問名稱與成熟度；並問抹片中雙核、大小不一的漿細胞代表什麼：neoplastic/immature plasma cells。
漿細胞幾乎取代骨髓時（≥60% 為 SLiM 事件之一），即使沒有 CRAB 也符合需治療的骨髓瘤。
細胞遺傳需以 CD138 分選後做 FISH：t(4;14)、t(14;16)、t(14;20)、del(17p)、1q gain/amp 屬高危險；t(11;14) 與 venetoclax 反應相關。
Flow 可證明胞質 κ/λ 限制與異常表型（CD19−、CD56+、CD45−）；R-ISS/R2-ISS 預後分期需 β2-microglobulin、albumin、LDH 與高危險 FISH。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為單核球性 AML 或 plasmablastic lymphoma：單核球胞質灰藍含細顆粒、核折疊、NSE+ 且 CD138−；本圖細胞保留偏心核、核旁 hof 與深藍胞質，CD138+。

quiz.q: 這片骨髓抽吸幾乎全是核偏心、深藍胞質、帶核仁的細胞，最可能診斷為何？骨髓此細胞比例達多少即屬 SLiM 事件？
quiz.a: Plasma cell myeloma；克隆性骨髓漿細胞 ≥60%。

61640.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中出現數個未成熟顆粒球：兩個較大細胞核染色質略開放、細胞質佈滿粗大紫黑色顆粒（像未成熟的嗜酸/嗜鹼顆粒球），另有後骨髓球樣細胞與帶狀核細胞；左移並伴隨異常顆粒的細胞，配合嗜酸性球增多提示 PCM1::JAK2 骨髓/淋巴腫瘤。
features: Two large immature granulocytic cells with moderately open chromatin and coarse dark purple (basophilic-type) cytoplasmic granules
Cell with eccentric, slightly indented nucleus and pale blue agranular to finely granular cytoplasm (myelocyte-like)
Small band-form granulocyte at the upper right
Polychromatophilic red cell at left edge; red cells with mild anisocytosis
Occasional platelets
61640.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating immature granulocytic cells. Two large cells with moderately open chromatin contain coarse dark purple cytoplasmic granules, resembling immature eosinophils/basophils with abnormal basophilic-type granulation; a myelocyte-like cell and a band form are also present. Red cells show mild anisocytosis with a polychromatophilic cell. The granule lineage cannot be assigned with certainty on Wright-Giemsa alone. In the context of a PCM1::JAK2 fusion, the left-shifted granulopoiesis with abnormally granulated eosinophil/basophil precursors is consistent with a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and JAK2 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: CML shows a myelocyte and neutrophil peak with absolute basophilia but is defined by BCR::ABL1, which must be excluded by molecular testing.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with PDGFRA or FGFR1 rearrangement
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps (eosinophilia, immature granulocytes), so separation requires FISH/RT-PCR for PDGFRA, PDGFRB and FGFR1.
APL promyelocytes have bilobed nuclei, dense azurophilic granules and Auer rod bundles with PML::RARA, rather than eosinophil/basophil-type granules in a left-shifted CML-like picture.
Reactive eosinophils are mature with normal orange-red granules and normal lobation, without circulating immature granulocytes with abnormal granulation.

61576.recognize_zh: 流式圖中紅色母細胞群 CD19 陽性、CD34 由弱到強陽性（多數偏強），與紫色 CD19+CD34− 成熟 B 細胞及綠色 CD19− 非 B 細胞分開；CD19+CD34+ 的前驅 B 細胞群大量擴張支持 B 淋巴母細胞白血病。
features: Bivariate dot plot: CD34-PC7 (x-axis) versus CD19-APC700 (y-axis), log scales
Red (blast-gated) population CD19-positive (about 10^1) with CD34 spanning dim to bright, densest near 10^2
Purple CD19-positive, CD34-negative cluster representing mature B cells
Green CD19-negative, CD34-negative events (T/NK/myeloid cells)
Few scattered CD19-negative, CD34-positive events (non-B progenitors)
61576.describe_en: This flow cytometry dot plot displays CD34 versus CD19. The gated blast population (red) is CD19-positive with CD34 expression spanning dim to bright, most events being brightly CD34-positive. Mature B cells (purple) are CD19-positive and CD34-negative, non-B events (green) are negative for both, and a few scattered CD19-negative, CD34-positive events represent residual non-B progenitors. The expanded CD19+/CD34+ population supports a precursor B-cell (B-lymphoblastic) leukemia phenotype, which is further characterized by CD10, cCD79a and CRLF2 expression.

ddx.vs: Normal CD34+ stage-1 hematogones are few and transition smoothly to CD34-negative CD20+ stages rather than forming a dominant CD34-bright population.
CD34+ blasts show only partial dim CD19 with MPO/CD117/CD13 positivity and lack CD10/cCD22.
Requires concurrent MPO or monocytic marker expression in addition to strong B-lineage markers.

61512.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中滿是大型母細胞，細胞質豐富、呈灰藍色，核圓形至略有凹陷、染色質細緻且可見明顯核仁，部分有細小空泡；細胞大、核質比相對低、細胞質多，這些是單核母細胞（monoblast）的線索。
features: Numerous large blasts, roughly 2-3 times the diameter of a red cell
Moderate to abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, giving a relatively low N:C ratio for blasts
Round to slightly indented or folded nuclei with finely dispersed, lacy chromatin
One or more conspicuous nucleoli in many cells
Occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles; no Auer rods or coarse granules identified
A few smaller, densely stained cells with a coarse granular appearance in the background
61512.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a marked increase in large blasts with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm. The blasts have round to slightly indented nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and conspicuous nucleoli, and some contain fine cytoplasmic vacuoles. Auer rods and cytoplasmic granulation are not identified, and maturing monocytes are few. Findings are suggestive of acute monoblastic leukemia, which is best confirmed by nonspecific esterase cytochemistry and flow cytometry (CD14, CD64, CD11b, lysozyme).

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal or no maturation
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts usually have less cytoplasm, may show Auer rods, and are MPO strongly positive and nonspecific esterase negative.
Lymphoblasts are smaller with scant cytoplasm and a high N:C ratio, and are MPO/NSE negative with B- or T-lineage markers.
APL cells have bilobed, sliding-plate nuclei, strong MPO, and PML::RARA, whereas monoblasts have round nuclei and weak or absent MPO.
CMML shows mature monocytes with fewer than 20% blasts and promonocytes, whereas this field is dominated by blasts.

exam.answer_en: Acute monoblastic leukemia — numerous large blasts with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, fine chromatin, prominent nucleoli and fine vacuoles
pearls_zh: 考法：看到胞質豐富、灰藍色、低核質比的大 blast，要說出「monoblast」並提出確認單核球系的檢查（NSE、flow），而非只寫 AML。
細胞化學：NSE（α-naphthyl butyrate/acetate）強陽性並被 NaF 抑制，MPO 常陰性或弱陽性；需與 AML minimally differentiated 區分。
臨床急症：單核球性 AML 常伴高白血球、leukostasis、DIC 與腫瘤溶解症候群；可有牙齦增生與 leukemia cutis，並易侵犯 CNS。
遺傳：KMT2A rearrangement（如 t(9;11)）與 NPM1 突變常見；NPM1 突變且無 FLT3-ITD 通常預後較佳。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把胞質豐富的 monoblast 誤認為大顆粒淋巴球、漿母細胞或反應性單核球；monoblast 核仁明顯、染色質細緻且 NSE 陽性，漿細胞有核旁淡染區與偏心核。

quiz.q: 這些胞質豐富灰藍色的母細胞，哪一項細胞化學染色最能支持其為單核球系？該染色會被什麼抑制？
quiz.a: Nonspecific esterase（α-naphthyl butyrate/acetate）；sodium fluoride（NaF）

61448.recognize_zh: G 帶核型圖：一條第 1 號染色體長臂縮短（箭頭，del(1q)），第 5 號只剩一條，另一條第 10 號較長並帶有額外物質（箭頭，der(10)t(5;10)），性染色體為 XY，即 45,XY,del(1)(q21q25),-5,der(10)t(5;10)(q10;q10)。
features: G-banded karyogram, male (X and faint Y) with 45 chromosomes
One chromosome 1 homolog with a shortened long arm (arrow), consistent with interstitial del(1q)
Only one normal chromosome 5 present
One chromosome 10 is elongated with additional material (arrow), consistent with der(10) whole-arm translocation with chromosome 5
Remaining autosomes appear paired and structurally normal at this band resolution
61448.describe_en: G-banded karyogram from an overnight unstimulated bone marrow culture shows a male hypodiploid complement. There is an interstitial deletion of the long arm of one chromosome 1 and an abnormal chromosome 10 carrying extra material derived from chromosome 5, with loss of one normal chromosome 5, reported as 45,XY,del(1)(q21q25),-5,der(10)t(5;10)(q10;q10). The unbalanced whole-arm translocation results in net loss of 5p or 5q material depending on the retained arm. These are uncommon abnormalities in T-lymphoblastic leukemia, so their prognostic significance is uncertain; confirmation with FISH or chromosomal microarray is recommended.

ddx.vs: True monosomy lacks chromosome 5 material on another chromosome, whereas here extra material is attached to chromosome 10.

ddx.dx: Common T-ALL rearrangements (TLX1 t(10;14), TLX3 t(5;14))
ddx.vs: These involve 10q24 or 5q35 with chromosome 14 (TCR loci), and t(5;14) is cryptic by karyotype, so FISH is needed.
Heteromorphisms involve heterochromatin regions (1qh, 9qh) rather than euchromatic band loss or gain.

61384.recognize_zh: A 圖鐵染色可見一顆紅血球前驅細胞核周圍環繞藍綠色鐵顆粒（環狀鐵粒母細胞）；C、D 圖骨髓抹片中的早期骨髓系與紅血球系前驅細胞細胞質內有多個清楚空泡；B 圖週邊血液有嗜中性球及淋巴球。空泡化前驅細胞加上環狀鐵粒母細胞，是銅缺乏模仿骨髓化生不良症候群（MDS）的典型線索。
features: Panel A: Prussian blue stain with an erythroid precursor showing perinuclear blue-green iron granules, consistent with a ring sideroblast
Panels C-D: cytoplasmic vacuoles in early myeloid (promyelocyte/myelocyte) and erythroid precursors
Panel D: maturing granulocytes with preserved segmentation and granulation
Panel B: peripheral blood with a neutrophil and a lymphocyte; red cells show crenation, likely artifact
Low image resolution limits assessment of subtle dysplasia
61384.describe_en: Iron-stained aspirate (A) shows an erythroid precursor with perinuclear siderotic granules consistent with a ring sideroblast. Wright-Giemsa-stained aspirate smears (C, D) show prominent cytoplasmic vacuolization of early myeloid and erythroid precursors, while maturing granulocytes appear adequately granulated and segmented. The peripheral blood smear (B) shows a neutrophil and a lymphocyte with crenated red cells, likely an artifact. Image resolution limits evaluation for other dysplastic features. In a patient with cytopenias, vacuolated precursors with ring sideroblasts are suggestive of copper deficiency, which mimics myelodysplastic syndrome and should be confirmed with serum copper and ceruloplasmin (and zinc levels) before a diagnosis of MDS is made.

ddx.vs: Morphology can overlap, but MDS typically shows multilineage dysplasia and SF3B1 mutation or clonal cytogenetics with normal copper levels.
Also causes vacuolated precursors and ring sideroblasts; history, macrocytosis and reversal with abstinence separate it from copper deficiency.
Produces identical pronormoblast vacuolation, distinguished by drug exposure history and normal copper levels.
Vacuoles are largely restricted to myeloid and erythroid precursors in older men with systemic inflammation, confirmed by somatic UBA1 mutation.

exam.answer_en: Copper deficiency mimicking MDS — cytoplasmic vacuoles in early myeloid/erythroid precursors with ring sideroblasts
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指 C/D 圖前驅細胞的空泡或 A 圖的環狀鐵粒母細胞，問「診斷 MDS 前要先排除什麼？」答案是銅缺乏（及鋅過量）。
必驗：serum copper、ceruloplasmin、serum zinc；常見原因為胃繞道/減重手術、吸收不良、長期補充鋅（含鋅假牙黏著劑）。
臨床表現：貧血合併嗜中性球低下（血小板多相對保留），可伴隨類似 B12 缺乏的脊髓病變（myelopathy），需及早補銅，血液學通常可恢復但神經損傷可能殘留。
前驅細胞空泡的鑑別：酒精、linezolid/chloramphenicol、銅缺乏，以及 VEXAS（UBA1 突變）；MDS 則靠 clonal 細胞遺傳或 SF3B1 等突變支持。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤診為 MDS with ring sideroblasts；銅缺乏時前驅細胞出現明顯空泡、血清銅/ceruloplasmin 低、無克隆性異常，且補銅後可逆，據此區分。

quiz.q: 減重手術後患者貧血與嗜中性球低下，骨髓如圖可見前驅細胞空泡與環狀鐵粒母細胞。最應先檢驗哪兩項？
quiz.a: Serum copper 與 ceruloplasmin（另可驗 zinc）

61320.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一個大型巨核細胞，細胞質豐富呈細緻粉紅顆粒狀，核分成幾個相連圓葉，周邊未見明顯血小板生成（platelet budding）；ITP 的巨核細胞常數量正常或增加、形態偏未成熟，但此變化不具特異性，診斷仍需臨床排除其他原因。
features: Large megakaryocyte with abundant finely granular pink-purple cytoplasm
Nucleus with a few rounded, connected lobes
No appreciable platelet budding at the cytoplasmic margin
Surrounding small lymphocytes, erythroid precursors, and a granulocyte
Thick area of smear with poorly spread grey red cells
61320.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with a lobulated nucleus composed of a few rounded connected lobes and abundant finely granular cytoplasm, without evident platelet budding. Surrounding marrow elements include small lymphocytes, erythroid precursors, and granulocytes. The red cells in this thick area are poorly spread. These megakaryocytic changes, including reduced platelet budding, may be seen in immune thrombocytopenia but are not specific, and ITP remains a diagnosis of exclusion.

ddx.vs: MDS shows micromegakaryocytes or widely separated nuclear lobes accompanied by dysplasia in other lineages and often cytogenetic abnormalities.
Inherited forms show giant platelets and family history or genetic variants rather than acquired megakaryocytic changes.
ET megakaryocytes are giant with hyperlobated staghorn nuclei in clusters, with thrombocytosis rather than thrombocytopenia.

61256.recognize_zh: 組圖中黑箭頭是毛狀細胞（hairy cell）：核卵圓或腎形、染色質均勻，細胞質大量淡藍、周邊有細毛狀突起；紅箭頭則是細胞質深藍、核偏心的漿細胞；流式 D 顯示 CD103+/CD123+ 細胞共表現 CD11c 與 CD25，E 顯示 CD38+/CD138+ 漿細胞 kappa 限制。同一病人同時有毛狀細胞白血病與漿細胞腫瘤。
features: Panels A-C, black arrows: hairy cells with oval to bean-shaped nuclei, evenly dispersed chromatin, absent nucleoli and abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm with circumferential fine hair-like projections
Panels A-C, red arrows: plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, clumped chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, some with irregular cytoplasmic blebs
Panel C background includes maturing myeloid precursors, indicating a marrow aspirate
Panel D (flow): CD103+/CD123+ lymphocytes co-express CD11c and CD25 as a tight cluster
Panel E (flow): CD38+/CD138+ tumoral plasma cells show kappa light-chain restriction
61256.describe_en: Aspirate smears show two distinct abnormal populations: hairy cells with oval to reniform nuclei, homogeneous chromatin and abundant pale cytoplasm with circumferential fine projections (black arrows), and plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and deeply basophilic, focally irregular cytoplasm (red arrows). Flow cytometry demonstrates a CD103+/CD123+ B-cell population that co-expresses CD11c and CD25, and a separate CD38+/CD138+ plasma cell population with kappa light-chain restriction. The coexistence of two clonal populations supports two concurrent neoplasms. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia coexisting with a kappa-restricted plasma cell neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: Cells have a distinct nucleolus and lack CD25 and CD123 (and annexin A1/BRAF V600E), whereas this population is CD25+/CD123+.

Villous lymphocytes have polar short projections and usually are CD103-negative and CD25/CD11c variable, and may show plasmacytic differentiation from the same clone rather than a separate plasma cell clone.
Shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells sharing one light chain with MYD88 L265P, rather than hairy cells plus a separate plasma cell population.
Plasma cells show a normal kappa:lambda ratio without restriction on flow cytometry.

61192.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中有大量大小不一的微小球形紅血球與紅血球碎片、出芽狀紅血球（放大小圖），血球分析儀的 PLT-O 與 RET 散佈圖在低前向散射區出現異常群（紅圈、箭頭），代表碎片被誤算為血小板，符合熱傷害造成的後天性熱變性異形紅血球症。
features: Panel A: marked anisopoikilocytosis with numerous microspherocytes and tiny red cell fragments (microfragments) of platelet size
Insets: red cells with budding protrusions, spherocytic fragments and irregular dense forms
Panel B: RBC histogram with a main peak plus a left-sided shoulder/tail from small particles
Panel C: PLT impedance histogram with a right tail not returning to baseline, suggesting interfering small red cells
Panels E-F: PLT-O and RET scattergrams showing an abnormal population in the low forward-scatter region (red circles/arrows) representing red cell fragments
Panel D: PLT-F (fluorescent platelet) scattergram used as the reference count, less affected by fragments
61192.describe_en: Composite of a peripheral blood smear and hematology analyzer output. The smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with abundant microspherocytes, budding red cells and platelet-sized red cell microfragments, with scattered normal-appearing platelets and a leukocyte. The analyzer histograms and scattergrams show an abnormal small-particle population in the low forward-scatter region of the optical platelet and reticulocyte channels (circled), indicating that red cell fragments interfere with optical/impedance platelet counts, whereas the fluorescent platelet channel is more reliable. Findings are consistent with acquired thermal-injury ('pyro') poikilocytosis, such as after extensive burns, resembling hereditary pyropoikilocytosis.

ddx.vs: Similar microspherocytes and fragments but lifelong, with elliptocytes in family members, spectrin defects and extremely low MCV without burn history.
Schistocytes are helmet and triangular forms with severe thrombocytopenia, rather than round microspherocytes and budding cells with a normal fluorescent platelet count.
Spherocytes are of more uniform size without abundant microfragments or budding, with positive DAT in immune cases or EMA-binding defect in HS.

61128.recognize_zh: 紅血球多呈拉長的橢圓形與雪茄形，並混有兩端尖的船形／鐮刀樣細胞、碎片與梨形紅血球，缺少中央淡染區，背景血小板散在；多種紅血球形態異常同時出現，符合鐮狀細胞特質合併 β 地中海型貧血與橢圓形紅血球增多。
features: Marked poikilocytosis dominated by elongated elliptocytes and ovalocytes
Scattered pointed boat-shaped and sickle-like cells with tapered ends
Red cell fragments, teardrop-like and irregular forms
Many red cells lack central pallor; mild anisocytosis
Scattered platelets across the field; one segmented neutrophil with unremarkable granulation
61128.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked poikilocytosis with numerous elliptocytes and ovalocytes, admixed with pointed boat-shaped to sickle-like cells, fragments and teardrop-like forms. Many red cells lack central pallor, and mild anisocytosis is present. Platelets are scattered throughout the field, although platelet number cannot be reliably quantified from a single field, and a segmented neutrophil appears unremarkable. The combination of sickle-like forms and elliptocytosis is unusual for simple sickle cell trait and is consistent with compound sickle hemoglobin with beta-thalassemia and coexisting elliptocytosis, requiring hemoglobin fractionation and red cell indices for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Sickle cell anemia shows many classic crescent sickle cells, target cells and Howell-Jolly bodies, and electrophoresis lacks HbA.
Isolated HE shows elliptocytes with preserved central pallor without pointed boat-shaped or sickle forms.
Iron deficiency shows hypochromic microcytes with pencil cells, not sickle-like forms, and has normal hemoglobin fractionation.
Myelofibrosis has prominent dacrocytes with leukoerythroblastosis and giant platelets rather than elliptocytes and sickle forms.

61064.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一個巨大組織球，核小而偏位、染色質粗，周圍有極大量淡藍灰色細胞質，內含細小顆粒與模糊的纖維狀紋理（接近皺紙樣外觀），配合嬰兒肝脾腫大即指向 Gaucher 細胞。
features: Very large histiocyte many times the size of surrounding cells, with a low N:C ratio
Small, eccentric, somewhat teardrop-shaped nucleus with coarse chromatin
Abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm with fine granular stippling and faint fibrillary/striated texture suggestive of wrinkled tissue paper
No discrete vacuoles or foamy bubbles
Background of crowded marrow cells and red cells poorly preserved and overlapping; weakly stained, low-contrast image limits evaluation of striations
61064.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large histiocyte with a small eccentric nucleus and abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm containing fine granules and a faint fibrillary texture approaching a wrinkled tissue-paper appearance. The cytoplasm is not vacuolated or foamy. The background is crowded and poorly stained, and the characteristic striations are less distinct than in classic examples. In an infant with anemia and massive hepatosplenomegaly, findings are consistent with a Gaucher cell, and diagnosis should be confirmed by glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay and GBA1 genotyping.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (CML, myeloma, thalassemia, mycobacterial infection)
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells are morphologically similar but occur with an underlying neoplasm or infection and normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
Niemann-Pick cells have bubbly, vacuolated foamy cytoplasm rather than fibrillary wrinkled-paper cytoplasm and show sphingomyelinase deficiency.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain distinct blue-green granules of ceroid rather than pale striated cytoplasm.
Hemophagocytes contain engulfed red cells, platelets or nucleated cells instead of uniform fibrillary cytoplasm.

61000.recognize_zh: 此圖並非紀錄描述中的脊椎 MRI（STIR），而是一張偏黃色調的骨髓抹片：可見數顆細胞質藍染、核偏位的漿細胞，右下方有一顆細胞質豐富、藍染的多核大細胞（多核漿細胞或蝕骨細胞），背景為骨髓系前驅細胞，與漿細胞腫瘤的臨床情境相符。
features: Bone marrow aspirate smear with a yellow color cast (white-balance artifact)
Several plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, clock-face chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm, some with perinuclear hof
Large multinucleated cell with abundant blue cytoplasm and several round nuclei at lower right (multinucleated plasma cell vs osteoclast)
Admixed granulocytic precursors (myelocytes, metamyelocytes) and an eosinophil at upper left
Small lymphocytes and occasional erythroid precursors; red cells appear pale/ghost-like due to color cast
61000.describe_en: Note: the record description refers to MRI STIR signal changes of the lumbar spine, but the image provided is a bone marrow aspirate smear rather than a radiologic study. The smear shows a mixed hematopoietic population with granulocytic precursors, an eosinophil and small lymphocytes, together with several plasma cells showing eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm. A large cell at the lower right contains multiple round nuclei within abundant blue cytoplasm, favoring a multinucleated plasma cell over an osteoclast. The yellow color cast limits evaluation of subtle cytoplasmic features. Plasma cell quantification on a well-stained smear and CD138/light-chain studies are required; findings are suggestive of a plasma cell neoplasm in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature, mononuclear, polyclonal and usually <10%, without multinucleated or atypical forms.
Osteoclasts are much larger with many (often >5) uniform, well-separated oval nuclei with single nucleoli and pink granular cytoplasm, rather than a few nuclei in basophilic cytoplasm.
Megakaryocytes have a single multilobated nucleus and granular pink cytoplasm instead of separate round nuclei in blue cytoplasm.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with an IgM paraprotein and MYD88 mutation, not lytic bone lesions.

60936.recognize_zh: 低倍下抹片羽狀邊緣可見散在的聚集物，高倍下為大量血小板緊密聚成一團（platelet aggregate），部分血小板偏大；在血小板低下的病人，需想到第 2B 型類血友病因 vWF 與 GPIb 親和力增加而自發性聚集。
features: Low power feathered edge with small purple clumps rather than evenly dispersed platelets
High power: large platelet aggregate composed of numerous tightly clustered platelets
Platelets within aggregate variable in size with some enlarged forms and preserved granulation
Few single platelets in the surrounding field despite the aggregate
Red cells normocytic without schistocytes
60936.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows scattered clumps at the feathered edge. At high power, a large aggregate of tightly clustered platelets with variably sized, including enlarged, forms is present, with few single platelets in the surrounding field. Red cells show no fragmentation. Platelet clumping of this type may cause spurious thrombocytopenia and, in the appropriate clinical setting with enhanced ristocetin-induced platelet aggregation at low ristocetin concentrations and loss of high-molecular-weight multimers, is consistent with von Willebrand disease type 2B.

ddx.vs: Clumping disappears in citrate or fingerstick samples and von Willebrand factor studies and RIPA are normal.
Morphology and low-dose RIPA are identical, and separation requires mixing studies or GP1BA sequencing showing the defect in platelets rather than VWF.
Platelets rosette around neutrophils rather than forming free-standing aggregates.
Show single giant platelets without clumping, and MYH9 disorders have Döhle-like neutrophil inclusions.

exam.answer_en: Platelet aggregates with enlarged platelets in von Willebrand disease type 2B — spontaneous VWF-GPIb mediated clumping with thrombocytopenia
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指羽狀邊緣的血小板團，問「假性血小板低下以外還要想到什麼」→ 在有出血傾向、家族史的病人，需想到 VWD type 2B。
機轉：VWF A1 domain 功能增益突變，使 VWF 自發性結合血小板 GPIbα，造成血小板聚集被清除、高分子量 multimers 流失。
實驗室：低濃度 ristocetin 誘發血小板凝集（low-dose RIPA）增強；VWF:RCo/VWF:Ag 比值下降，multimer 缺少高分子量部分。
治療陷阱：desmopressin（DDAVP）可釋出異常 VWF 而加重血小板低下，一般避免；以含 VWF 濃縮製劑為主。懷孕、手術壓力時血小板低下可惡化。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 platelet-type (pseudo) VWD 混淆：兩者 low-dose RIPA 都增強，但後者突變在血小板 GP1BA；以混合試驗區分（病人血漿加正常血小板聚集→2B）。也要排除 EDTA 誘發的假性聚集。

quiz.q: 血片見圖中血小板聚集並有血小板低下，若 low-dose RIPA 增強、缺乏高分子量 multimers，最可能診斷為何？為何通常避免使用 DDAVP？
quiz.a: VWD type 2B；DDAVP 釋出高親和力異常 VWF，會加重血小板聚集與血小板低下

60808.recognize_zh: CD11c 在肝竇內成團的淋巴細胞呈強烈膜狀陽性，細胞邊界清楚、胞質豐富，而肝細胞陰性；B 細胞共表現 CD11c 並呈竇內分布，支持毛細胞白血病。
features: Sinusoidal aggregates of cells with strong membranous CD11c staining
Crisp cell borders outlining abundant cytoplasm (fried-egg appearance)
Round to oval, bland nuclei
Unstained hepatocytes and occasional small fat vacuoles in background
60808.describe_en: CD11c immunohistochemistry on liver shows sinusoidal clusters and cords of cells with strong membranous staining outlining abundant cytoplasm and bland oval nuclei. Hepatocytes in the intervening plates are negative. Strong CD11c expression in the sinusoidal B-cell infiltrate supports hepatic involvement by hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Kupffer cells are CD11c+ but are scattered single elongated cells lining sinusoids and are CD68+/CD163+ and CD20 negative, not cohesive clusters.
Also CD11c+ but CD25 and annexin A1 negative with BRAF V600E wild type.
CD11c may be dim/partial, but the cells lack CD25/CD103/annexin A1 and favor portal nodules.

60616.recognize_zh: 中性球（以及單核球）胞質內可見明亮的藍綠色折光包涵體（green inclusions），背景紅血球多為棘狀（echinocytes）；此類綠色包涵體與急性肝衰竭、乳酸中毒相關，常預示預後極差。
features: Segmented neutrophil containing one or more discrete, bright blue-green refractile cytoplasmic inclusions
Second neutrophil with several green inclusions and cytoplasmic vacuolization
Monocyte with finely granular cytoplasm; background cells lack Döhle bodies at this resolution
Numerous echinocytes (crenated red cells) with regular spicules
Nuclear segmentation otherwise unremarkable
60616.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows neutrophils containing distinct, brightly blue-green cytoplasmic inclusions, accompanied by cytoplasmic vacuolization in some cells. A monocyte is also present, and the red cells show numerous echinocytes. These so-called green neutrophilic inclusions are thought to represent lipofuscin-like biliverdin-containing material and are associated with acute liver injury, lactic acidosis and multiorgan failure. Findings are consistent with green ("death") neutrophilic inclusions and should prompt urgent clinical notification.

ddx.vs: Döhle bodies are pale gray-blue, ill-defined peripheral cytoplasmic patches rather than bright, refractile green globules.
Toxic granules are fine, dark purple and distributed throughout the cytoplasm instead of a few discrete green bodies.
Morulae are purple granular clusters and yeasts show a cell wall or budding, whereas green inclusions are homogeneous refractile blue-green bodies.
Chédiak-Higashi granules are large gray-purple/red granules present in all granulocytes from birth, not acquired green inclusions in critically ill patients.

exam.answer_en: Green neutrophilic ('death') inclusions — bright blue-green refractile cytoplasmic inclusions in neutrophils (and monocyte), with echinocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指嗜中性球胞質內亮藍綠色、會折光的小球問名稱與臨床意義；答 green inclusions，代表病人極可能處於急性肝衰竭/多重器官衰竭，預後極差。
臨床關聯：常見於急性肝損傷（如 shock liver）與 lactic acidosis，多數病例在出現後短期內死亡；此發現應主動通報臨床團隊。
成分推測：與 biliverdin 或 lipofuscin 類物質有關（肝損傷後膽色素代謝產物被吞噬），可同時出現在單核球。
判讀流程：區分 Döhle bodies、toxic granulation 與被吞噬的微生物；同時檢查肝功能、乳酸與凝血，排除敗血症來源。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 Döhle bodies：Döhle bodies 為胞質周邊淡灰藍、邊界模糊的片狀區；green inclusions 則是邊界清楚、亮藍綠色、有折光的圓形小球。

quiz.q: 嗜中性球內這些亮藍綠色包涵體最常與哪兩種臨床狀態相關？
quiz.a: 急性肝損傷/肝衰竭與 lactic acidosis（常伴多重器官衰竭，預後極差）。

60680.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中可見多個小而圓、缺乏中央淡染區的深染紅血球（紅箭頭，球形紅血球 spherocyte），伴隨略大、偏藍灰色的多染性紅血球（藍箭頭）；在 MDS 病人出現此形態，提示後天性紅血球膜異常而非遺傳性球形紅血球症。
features: Numerous small, dense, round red cells lacking central pallor (spherocytes, red arrows)
Scattered larger bluish-gray polychromatophilic red cells (blue arrows)
Moderate anisocytosis with a mixed population of normochromic cells and spherocytes; occasional fragmented or irregular forms
Neutrophils present with segmented nuclei and granular cytoplasm, without obvious dysplasia in this field
No red cell agglutination or rouleaux
60680.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a dimorphic-appearing red cell population with numerous spherocytes, which are small, dense, round cells lacking central pallor, admixed with normocytic red cells and occasional larger polychromatophilic cells. There is mild poikilocytosis without agglutination. Neutrophils in the field do not show overt dysplasia, and platelets are present. In a patient with myelodysplastic syndrome, prominent spherocytosis in the absence of immune hemolysis is consistent with an acquired red cell membrane defect, which genomic analysis attributed to clonal loss or mutation of an erythrocyte membrane gene.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; HS is congenital with a family history and lacks MDS-related cytopenias, dysplasia, or clonal somatic lesions in membrane genes.
Warm AIHA shows spherocytes with marked polychromasia and a positive direct antiglobulin test, whereas acquired MDS-related spherocytosis is DAT negative.
MAHA is characterized by schistocytes (helmet cells, fragments) and thrombocytopenia rather than predominantly round spherocytes.
These cause abrupt massive spherocytosis/microspherocytes in an acute clinical setting, not a chronic finding in an MDS patient.

60744.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一個大型巨噬細胞（右箭頭），細胞質內吞噬多顆紅血球並含灰藍色顆粒；左上角箭頭指向被吞噬、呈細長形的紅血球，符合鐮刀型貧血病人的噬血現象 (hemophagocytosis)。
features: Large macrophage with abundant foamy grey-blue cytoplasm containing multiple engulfed red cells (right arrow)
Phagocytosed red cells retain their outline within cytoplasmic vacuoles; fine blue granular debris present
Upper-left arrow: cell with an engulfed elongated red cell, consistent with a phagocytosed sickled/distorted erythrocyte
Background: numerous erythroid precursors at various stages (erythroid hyperplasia) and maturing granulocytes
Free red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with some elongated and folded forms
60744.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows erythroid hyperplasia with abundant erythroid precursors and maturing granulocytes. A large macrophage with abundant foamy cytoplasm contains several engulfed red blood cells, and an adjacent cell contains an elongated phagocytosed erythrocyte. Background red cells show poikilocytosis. Findings demonstrate hemophagocytosis in a patient with sickle cell disease; isolated hemophagocytosis is nonspecific and a diagnosis of hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis requires fulfillment of clinical and laboratory criteria (fever, cytopenias, ferritin, sCD25, triglycerides, fibrinogen).

ddx.vs: HLH requires clinical/laboratory criteria and often shows numerous histiocytes engulfing neutrophils, platelets and lymphocytes, not merely erythrophagocytosis in a hemolytic setting.
Reactive erythrophagocytosis in chronic hemolysis or post-transfusion involves red cells only and lacks systemic HLH features.
Storage histiocytes contain lipid or granular material rather than intact engulfed red cells.

60552.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆漿細胞：細胞核圓形、明顯偏向一側且染色質呈粗塊狀，細胞質豐富深藍，靠核旁有一塊較淡的核周淡染區（perinuclear hof）；在周邊血出現即應考慮漿細胞白血病。
features: Medium-sized oval cell with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Round, markedly eccentric nucleus with coarse clumped chromatin
Pale perinuclear clearing (hof) in the cytoplasm adjacent to the nucleus
No conspicuous nucleoli
Red cells show overlapping and short stacks; occasional platelets
60552.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells with overlapping and short stacks and scattered platelets. A circulating plasma cell is present, with an oval outline, abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, a round eccentric nucleus with coarse clumped chromatin, and a distinct pale perinuclear hof. No nucleoli or plasmablastic features are seen in this cell. With an absolute or relative circulating plasma cell count meeting diagnostic criteria, findings are consistent with plasma cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive peripheral plasma cells are sparse and polytypic for kappa/lambda, whereas plasma cell leukemia shows a clonal population above threshold.
LPL shows mostly small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes, typically with MYD88 L265P, rather than a monomorphous plasma cell population.
Reactive lymphocytes have more central nuclei, less clumped chromatin, and cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells without a defined hof.

exam.answer_en: Circulating plasma cell — eccentric nucleus, clumped chromatin, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and distinct perinuclear hof; supports plasma cell leukemia if ≥5%
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指有明顯核旁淡染區的細胞，問「淡染區叫什麼？對應什麼構造？」→ perinuclear hof，為發達的 Golgi apparatus。
胞質深藍是因大量 rough ER 合成免疫球蛋白；plasma cell 出現在周邊血屬異常，需量化並判斷單株或多株。
Flow：CD38 bright、CD138+、CD45 陰性或弱、CD19−，cytoplasmic κ/λ 限制可確認單株；反應性 plasma cell 通常 CD19+、CD45+ 且多株。
PCL 可為 primary（初診即表現）或 secondary（myeloma 末期轉變），後者預後更差。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與反應性 plasmacytosis（病毒感染、登革熱、藥物）混淆：反應性多株、數量有限且多伴其他反應性淋巴球；PCL 為輕鏈限制的單株族群並有 myeloma 相關表現。

quiz.q: 圖中 plasma cell 核旁的淡染區叫什麼？對應哪個胞器？
quiz.a: Perinuclear hof；Golgi apparatus

60488.recognize_zh: ALK 免疫染色下，大型多形性腫瘤細胞同時呈細胞核與細胞質強陽性（nuclear + cytoplasmic），小型背景淋巴球為陰性；此核質雙重染色型態代表 NPM1::ALK 融合，是 ALK 陽性間變性大細胞淋巴瘤的特徵。
features: Sheets of large pleomorphic tumor cells with strong ALK staining
Combined nuclear and cytoplasmic ALK positivity, typical of NPM1::ALK fusion
Tumor nuclei are large, round to irregular with visible nucleoli outlined within the stain
Interspersed small ALK-negative background lymphocytes (blue nuclei)
Cohesive, sinusoidal-like clustering of positive cells
60488.describe_en: ALK immunohistochemical stain shows sheets of large, pleomorphic tumor cells with strong combined nuclear and cytoplasmic ALK positivity, while interspersed small background lymphocytes are negative. The tumor cells have large irregular nuclei with nucleoli discernible through the stain. The nuclear and cytoplasmic staining pattern indicates an NPM1::ALK fusion (t(2;5)(p23;q35)). In a CD30-positive large cell lymphoma, findings are consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma, ALK-positive.

ddx.vs: ALK+ LBCL shows granular cytoplasmic-only ALK (CLTC::ALK) with plasmablastic morphology, CD138/EMA positivity and weak or absent CD30.
ALK-negative ALCL is morphologically similar with uniform strong CD30 but lacks ALK staining and has a worse prognosis (unless DUSP22-rearranged).

ddx.dx: Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor or ALK+ carcinoma
ddx.vs: Non-lymphoid ALK+ tumors are spindled or epithelial, keratin/SMA positive and CD30/CD45 negative.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5 and are ALK negative, scattered in a mixed inflammatory background rather than cohesive sheets.

exam.answer_en: ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma — ALK IHC with nuclear and cytoplasmic staining indicating NPM1::ALK (t(2;5))
pearls_zh: 考法：考官問「染色位置代表什麼」：核＋細胞質 ALK 陽性 = NPM1::ALK，小淋巴球陰性作為內部陰性對照。
ALK 染色位置對應融合伴侶：NPM1::ALK（t(2;5)(p23;q35)，最常見）呈核＋細胞質陽性；其他伴侶如 TPM3::ALK 多只見細胞質或膜陽性。
ALK+ ALCL 好發兒童與年輕人，預後優於 ALK− ALCL；CD30 強且均勻、常 EMA+，T 細胞標記常丟失（null phenotype）但細胞毒性標記（TIA-1、granzyme B、perforin）陽性。
治療關聯：CD30 是 brentuximab vedotin 的標靶（如 BV-CHP）；ALK 抑制劑（如 crizotinib）用於復發/難治 ALK+ ALCL。
exam.pitfall_zh: ALK 陽性不等於 ALCL：ALK+ large B-cell lymphoma（CD30 弱/陰性、漿母細胞表型、呈顆粒狀細胞質 ALK）與 inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor 也 ALK+，需配合 CD30 與譜系標記。

quiz.q: 此 ALK 染色同時呈細胞核與細胞質陽性，代表哪個融合基因與染色體轉位？

60232.recognize_zh: 高倍下大量中大型母細胞（blasts），核圓或微凹、染色質細緻、細胞質少至中等偏藍；其間夾雜數顆充滿粗大深紫色顆粒、部分顆粒空泡化或脫落的異常嗜鹼性球（basophils），母細胞增加合併嗜鹼性球增多是t(6;9) AML的提示線索。
features: Sheets of medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio, round to slightly indented nuclei and finely dispersed chromatin
Blast cytoplasm scant to moderate, basophilic, mostly agranular; occasional small inconspicuous nucleoli
Several basophil-lineage cells with coarse dark purple granules, some with partial degranulation and cytoplasmic vacuoles (abnormal basophils)
Occasional mature and maturing granulocytes; Auer rods not clearly identified in this field
Background of red cells in a cellular aspirate smear
60232.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a markedly increased population of blasts with round to slightly indented nuclei, fine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm. Admixed are several basophils containing coarse dark granules, some showing irregular degranulation and vacuolization. Definite Auer rods are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with increased basophils, suggestive of AML with t(6;9)(p23;q34); DEK::NUP214 in the appropriate cytogenetic context.

ddx.vs: Blasts themselves show basophilic granules and there is no recurrent genetic abnormality; t(6;9) must be excluded by karyotype/FISH before this diagnosis.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia in blast phase
ddx.vs: Also shows basophilia with blasts but carries BCR::ABL1, detected by FISH/RT-PCR, and usually a preceding chronic phase.
May show multilineage dysplasia with basophilia, but lacks DEK::NUP214 and typically shows MDS-related cytogenetics or mutations.
Leukemic cells are abnormal promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and heavy azurophilic granules/Auer rod bundles rather than agranular blasts with separate basophils.

60168.recognize_zh: 這張抽吸抹片的主角是一顆大的巨核細胞，細胞核呈多葉且葉間相連、分葉正常（normally lobated），周圍圍繞數顆嗜中性球；單看此圖無法診斷非典型慢性骨髓性白血病（aCML），它只是說明該病例中巨核細胞型態並無明顯發育不良。
features: Single large megakaryocyte with abundant finely granular cytoplasm
Nucleus is multilobated with connected, overlapping lobes (normal lobation), not separated or hypolobated
A dark pigmented/refractile particle overlies the cytoplasm (likely debris or hemosiderin)
Several neutrophils and band forms surround the megakaryocyte; smudged/crushed cells at top
Background is thinly spread without a particle; dysgranulopoiesis cannot be assessed reliably at this magnification
60168.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with abundant granular cytoplasm and a multilobated nucleus with connected lobes, without separated nuclear lobes or micromegakaryocytic features. Several neutrophils and bands cluster at its periphery, and a dark particle of debris or pigment overlies the cytoplasm. This field demonstrates a morphologically unremarkable megakaryocyte and is not in itself diagnostic; in the context of neutrophilic leukocytosis with dysgranulopoiesis and circulating precursors without basophilia, monocytosis or BCR::ABL1, the overall findings support atypical chronic myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: MDS megakaryocytes are small monolobated or have widely separated nuclear lobes, unlike the connected normal lobation seen here.
CML shows numerous small hypolobated 'dwarf' megakaryocytes with basophilia, whereas aCML megakaryocytes are often decreased and normally lobated; BCR::ABL1 testing is definitive.
ET megakaryocytes are larger with hyperlobated staghorn nuclei and are increased, rather than decreased with normal lobation.
In emperipolesis the neutrophils lie within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm, while here they are adjacent at the periphery in the same plane.

27912.recognize_zh: 左圖為水腫、呈葡萄狀的絨毛膜絨毛（hydropic chorionic villi），周圍有增生的滋養層細胞，代表完全性葡萄胎；右圖周邊血中出現核質比高、染色質細緻的芽細胞——兩者結合，提示化療（含拓樸異構酶 II 抑制劑的 EMA/CO）後的治療相關急性骨髓性白血病。
features: Panel A (H&E): enlarged hydropic chorionic villi with edematous, paucicellular stroma and cistern-like change
Panel A: circumferential hyperplastic trophoblast lining the villi
Panel B (PB): large blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Panel B: blast nuclei round to slightly irregular/indented; Auer rods not evident
Panel B: background red cells without increased schistocytes; no platelets seen in the field, in keeping with thrombocytopenia
27912.describe_en: Composite figure. Panel A shows placental tissue with markedly hydropic, grape-like chorionic villi with edematous stroma surrounded by hyperplastic trophoblast, consistent with a complete hydatidiform mole. Panel B, a peripheral blood smear obtained 13 months after EMA/CO chemotherapy, shows several large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm; no Auer rods or abnormal eosinophils are seen in this field. In the clinical context, with immunophenotype CD13/CD33/CD34/MPO positive and a CBFB rearrangement, findings are consistent with therapy-related acute myeloid leukemia following topoisomerase II inhibitor exposure.

ddx.dx: De novo AML with inv(16)/t(16;16) CBFB::MYH11
ddx.vs: Morphologically identical; the prior cytotoxic (topoisomerase II inhibitor) exposure places the case in the therapy-related category.
Lymphoblasts are MPO-negative and express B- or T-lineage markers, unlike the MPO/CD13/CD33-positive blasts reported here.

ddx.dx: Metastatic gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (choriocarcinoma) in blood/marrow
ddx.vs: Trophoblastic cells are large, multinucleated, cohesive, keratin- and hCG-positive and CD45-negative.

15240.recognize_zh: 骨髓針切片中，骨小樑之間的造血組織內有一個邊界較模糊的淡粉紅色結節（箭頭），由上皮樣組織球聚集而成，中央呈顆粒狀壞死樣，符合肉芽腫，提示分枝桿菌等全身性感染。
features: Needle core bone marrow biopsy with bony trabeculae and hematopoietic marrow with fat spaces
Ill-defined nodular aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm (arrow)
Center of the aggregate with granular eosinophilic debris suggestive of early necrosis
Surrounding cellular marrow with mixed hematopoietic cells and scattered lymphocytes
Multinucleated giant cells and organisms not resolved at this magnification
15240.describe_en: Needle core bone marrow biopsy (H&E) shows cellular hematopoietic marrow between bony trabeculae. Within the marrow there is an ill-defined aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm (arrow) and a central zone of granular eosinophilic material suggestive of necrosis. Langhans giant cells and organisms cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with granulomatous inflammation of the marrow, which in a patient with fever, hepatomegaly and pulmonary infiltrates suggests disseminated mycobacterial infection; acid-fast and fungal stains and marrow culture are required.

ddx.dx: Disseminated histoplasmosis or other fungal infection
ddx.vs: Fungal granulomas look similar and require GMS/PAS stains to demonstrate yeasts, whereas mycobacteria are identified by Ziehl-Neelsen/AFB stain and culture.
Sarcoid granulomas are tight, well-formed and non-necrotizing, with negative special stains and cultures.

ddx.dx: Hodgkin lymphoma or other lymphoma with granulomas
ddx.vs: Lymphoma-associated granulomas are accompanied by Reed-Sternberg or atypical lymphoid cells (CD30/CD15 or clonal B/T cells).
Lipogranulomas are small incidental aggregates of histiocytes around fat vacuoles without necrosis and have no clinical significance.

3464.recognize_zh: 低倍免疫組織化學染色中，組織中央一大片不規則、呈地圖狀分布的棕色陽性細胞浸潤，左側殘存的淋巴組織（藍色）為陰性；配合 LCH 臨床，代表蘭格漢斯細胞呈片狀浸潤的範圍。
features: Low-power view with a large, geographic, confluent zone of brown-staining cells in the center
Positive cells extend in irregular cords and patches toward the periphery
Residual hematoxylin-counterstained (negative) lymphoid tissue at the left and lower left
Paucicellular negative area at the right
Marker not labeled; cytologic detail cannot be assessed at this magnification
3464.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain (marker not specified) shows a large, geographic infiltrate of positive cells occupying the center of the tissue and extending in irregular cords and patches, with residual negative lymphoid tissue at one edge. Cytologic features and staining compartment cannot be resolved at this magnification. In the setting of Langerhans cell histiocytosis, this pattern most likely represents CD1a, langerin or S100 highlighting the extent of the lesional Langerhans cell infiltrate, possibly within expanded lymph node sinuses. Findings support Langerhans cell histiocytosis in correlation with high-power morphology.

ddx.vs: Rosai-Dorfman disease also expands sinuses with S100-positive cells but is CD1a- and langerin-negative.
Dermatopathic change shows paracortical nodules of CD1a/S100-positive cells with melanophages rather than a confluent geographic infiltrate with eosinophils.
Melanoma is S100-positive but also expresses SOX10, HMB45 and Melan-A and shows malignant cytology, not grooved histiocytoid cells.

1352.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中散佈大量小型深染成熟淋巴球，以及許多形狀不規則、淡紫色破碎的塗抹細胞（smudge cells），而血小板只剩箭頭所指的零星幾顆，符合 CLL 合併血小板低下。
features: Numerous smudge (basket) cells: irregular, pale purple disrupted nuclear remnants
Increased small mature lymphocytes with dense round nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Platelets markedly decreased; only rare platelets (arrows)
Red cells normocytic with no schistocytes evident
Low-power field limits assessment of individual lymphocyte chromatin detail
1352.describe_en: Low-power peripheral blood smear shows an absolute lymphocytosis of small, mature-appearing lymphocytes with dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm, accompanied by numerous smudge cells. Platelets are markedly reduced, with only rare forms identified (arrows), and red cells show no fragmentation. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with thrombocytopenia; flow cytometry (CD5+, CD23+, dim surface light chain) confirms the diagnosis, and the cause of thrombocytopenia (immune versus marrow failure) should be investigated.

ddx.vs: Smudge cells are fewer and cells show nuclear irregularity; CD23 negativity and cyclin D1/SOX11 expression distinguish it.
Reactive lymphocytes are polyclonal, and smudge cells are not a prominent feature.
Would show platelet clumps rather than a true paucity of platelets.

ddx.dx: Lymphoplasmacytic or marginal zone lymphoma in blood
ddx.vs: Show plasmacytoid or villous cytoplasmic features and a CD5-, CD23- immunophenotype.

exam.answer_en: CLL with thrombocytopenia — numerous small mature lymphocytes and smudge cells with only rare platelets on peripheral smear
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍抹片，考官指破碎淡紫色細胞問名稱（smudge cells），再指箭頭問血小板數量，並問 CLL 合併血小板低下的兩大機轉。
兩大機轉：骨髓浸潤造成產生不足 vs 免疫性血小板低下（ITP）；鑑別靠骨髓 megakaryocyte 數量與浸潤程度。自體免疫性血球低下本身不作為分期依據。
分期：Rai stage IV 與 Binet stage C 以血小板 <100×10⁹/L 為界（需排除自體免疫原因）；進行性骨髓衰竭為 iwCLL 治療適應症之一。
iwCLL 診斷門檻：周邊血單株 B 細胞 ≥5×10⁹/L；未達此值且無淋巴結/器官侵犯為 MBL，有淋巴結病灶則為 SLL。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 smudge cells 誤當成退化的母細胞或忽略不計而低估淋巴球數；此外血小板低時需先看抹片排除 EDTA 血小板凝集造成的偽低，再判斷是浸潤或 ITP。

quiz.q: 圖中大量淡紫色破碎細胞叫什麼？CLL 病人血小板低下時需區分哪兩種機轉？
quiz.a: Smudge cells；骨髓浸潤（產生不足）vs 免疫性血小板低下（ITP）。

1544.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指為體積大、橢圓形且缺乏中央淡染區的巨紅血球（macro-ovalocytes），背景還有淚滴狀紅血球與小紅血球，大小與形狀明顯不一，這是惡性貧血等巨母細胞性貧血最具代表性的紅血球變化。
features: Large oval red cells (macro-ovalocytes, arrows) larger than neighboring cells
Macro-ovalocytes are well hemoglobinized with little or no central pallor
Marked anisopoikilocytosis including teardrop cells and elongated forms
Admixed small microcytic red cells and fragments
No polychromasia; a single small platelet in the field
1544.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with numerous large, well-hemoglobinized oval macrocytes (macro-ovalocytes, arrows) lacking central pallor. Teardrop cells, elongated forms, and small microcytic fragments are also present. Polychromasia is not seen. No leukocytes are present in this field. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia, such as pernicious anemia.

ddx.vs: Non-megaloblastic macrocytes are round rather than oval and are not accompanied by marked poikilocytosis.
Elliptocytes are normocytic, uniform, and cigar-shaped with a central bar of hemoglobin, rather than enlarged oval cells with teardrops.
Spherocytes are small dense round cells, whereas these lack pallor because they are large and thick oval macrocytes.
MDS can produce macro-ovalocytes, but vitamin B12/folate levels are normal and dysplastic leukocytes or cytopenias are present.

exam.answer_en: Megaloblastic anemia (pernicious anemia) — macro-ovalocytes with marked anisopoikilocytosis and teardrop cells
pearls_zh: 考法：箭頭指著大而橢圓、缺乏中央淡染區的紅血球問名稱；答 macro-ovalocyte，並說明其卵圓形是 megaloblastic anemia 與肝病/酒精造成「圓形」macrocyte 的區分點。
Macrocytosis 分兩類：megaloblastic（B12/folate 缺乏、藥物）與 non-megaloblastic（酒精、肝病、hypothyroidism、reticulocytosis、MDS）；後者多為圓形巨紅血球。
B12 吸收路徑是必考：胃酸釋放 B12 → R-binder → 十二指腸 pancreatic protease 釋出 → 與 intrinsic factor 結合 → terminal ileum 吸收；任一環節（胃切除、迴腸切除、Crohn）皆可致缺乏。
Metformin 與長期 PPI 使用可降低 B12 吸收；素食者為飲食性缺乏高風險族群。
exam.pitfall_zh: 巨大卵圓形紅血球因較厚而缺乏中央淡染區，易被誤認為 spherocytes；spherocytes 體積小、圓形緻密，而 macro-ovalocytes 明顯比周圍紅血球大。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指大而卵圓、無中央淡染區的紅血球稱為什麼？最常見於哪類貧血？
quiz.a: Macro-ovalocytes；megaloblastic anemia（B12/folate 缺乏）

2120.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結結構被一片斑駁、淡染的區域擴張佔據，裡面有許多細小的血管腔隙，看不到明顯的次級濾泡，提示副皮質區（paracortex）擴張；這是自體免疫淋巴增生症候群（ALPS）淋巴結的常見樣式，但此倍率無法評估細胞型態。
features: Low-power view of lymph node with diffuse expansion of the interfollicular/paracortical compartment
Mottled pale areas containing numerous small vascular channels (prominent high endothelial venules)
No well-formed secondary follicles evident in this field
Eosinophilic fibrous trabecula/vessel wall on the right
Cytologic detail not assessable at this magnification
2120.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows diffuse expansion of the nodal parenchyma, with a mottled pattern of paler zones rich in small vascular channels consistent with paracortical expansion. Well-formed secondary follicles are not apparent in this field, and a fibrous trabecula is present. Cellular composition, including the double-negative T cells characteristic of ALPS, cannot be judged at this magnification and would require high-power review and immunophenotyping (CD3+, CD4-, CD8-, TCR alpha/beta+). Findings are compatible with paracortical hyperplasia as seen in autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome, but are not specific.

ddx.dx: Viral (e.g., EBV) or dermatopathic paracortical hyperplasia
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; ALPS is supported by increased TCR alpha/beta+ CD4-/CD8- double-negative T cells on flow cytometry and FAS pathway defects.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma / angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: AITL shows effaced architecture with arborizing HEVs, expanded follicular dendritic cell meshworks and clonal TFH-phenotype T cells, whereas ALPS lacks cytologic atypia and T-cell clonality.
Rosai-Dorfman expands sinuses with large S100+ histiocytes showing emperipolesis rather than paracortex rich in small lymphocytes and vessels.

2952.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中骨小樑增厚、形狀不規則且表面呈扇貝狀，骨小樑之間的造血組織幾乎完全被鬆散的纖維組織取代，符合腎性骨病變（renal osteodystrophy）的纖維性骨炎（osteitis fibrosa）。
features: Thickened, irregular, anastomosing bony trabeculae with scalloped surfaces
Intertrabecular marrow spaces replaced by loose to wavy fibrous tissue with spindle fibroblasts
Essentially no hematopoietic cells or fat in this field
Peritrabecular and intertrabecular fibrosis with scattered red cells
Osteoclasts not clearly resolved at this magnification
2952.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows thickened, irregular and anastomosing trabeculae with scalloped resorptive surfaces. The intertrabecular spaces are replaced by loose, wavy fibrous tissue containing spindle-shaped fibroblasts and extravasated red cells, with hematopoietic elements and fat essentially absent in this field. Discrete osteoclasts are not well resolved at this power. Findings are consistent with osteitis fibrosa with marrow fibrosis, as seen in renal osteodystrophy with secondary hyperparathyroidism.

ddx.vs: Myelofibrosis retains clusters of atypical megakaryocytes and dilated sinusoids with intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis, rather than fibrosis tied to active bone remodeling.
Paget disease shows a mosaic pattern of irregular cement lines and giant osteoclasts, and is usually focal rather than associated with renal failure.
Desmoplastic metastases contain nests or single cells of keratin-positive tumor within the fibrosis.
Morphology is identical; separation relies on renal function, calcium and PTH levels.

1416.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散布圖：A 圖圈選 CD38 強陽性的漿細胞群，B 圖這群細胞表現 λ（事件落在右上象限），C 圖則為 κ 陰性（事件在左上象限），顯示 λ 輕鏈限制性單株漿細胞。
features: Panel A: forward scatter versus CD38-PC5 with a gate drawn around the CD38-bright population
Panel B: gated CD38-bright cells are lambda-FITC positive (upper right quadrant)
Panel C: gated CD38-bright cells are kappa-FITC negative (upper left quadrant)
Light chain restriction to lambda within the plasma cell gate
Low image resolution; quadrant percentages are not legible
1416.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis is shown. In panel A, a CD38-bright population is gated on forward scatter versus CD38. In panel B, the gated cells fall into the upper right quadrant, indicating lambda light chain expression, whereas in panel C they fall into the upper left quadrant, indicating absence of kappa expression. Findings demonstrate a lambda-restricted plasma cell population, consistent with a clonal plasma cell neoplasm; the quadrant percentages cannot be read at this resolution, and typically light chain staining is intracytoplasmic for plasma cells.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells split between kappa and lambda quadrants (roughly 2:1 kappa:lambda), whereas this population is exclusively lambda.

ddx.dx: Lambda-restricted B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Lymphoma shows an accompanying CD19+/CD20+ surface light chain restricted B-cell population, whereas myeloma cells are typically CD19-/CD45-/CD56+.
Nonspecific binding labels both kappa and lambda channels, whereas here the population is positive only for lambda.

1224.recognize_zh: 周邊血液厚區可見大量散在血小板，大小不一，並有一個明顯的血小板聚集團塊；左側另有一顆帶粗紫顆粒的單核細胞。血小板數量增多與大小不均符合原發性血小板增多症（ET）的抹片，但此圖本身無法區分原發或反應性。
features: Numerous scattered platelets with variation in size, including some large forms
A loose platelet aggregate in the center of the field
Single mononuclear cell with coarse purple cytoplasmic granules at left, its lineage indeterminate at this magnification (basophil or mast cell-like)
Red cells overlapping in a thick area, grossly normochromic without teardrop cells
No blasts or nucleated red cells in this field
1224.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, examined in a relatively thick area, shows numerous scattered platelets with variation in size, including large platelets and a central platelet aggregate. A single mononuclear cell with coarse purple cytoplasmic granules is present, which may represent a basophil, although its lineage cannot be determined with confidence. Red cells appear normochromic without teardrop forms, and no blasts or nucleated red cells are seen. The findings suggest thrombocytosis with platelet anisocytosis and are consistent with essential thrombocythemia in the appropriate clinical and molecular context (JAK2, CALR or MPL mutation), although reactive thrombocytosis and other MPNs cannot be excluded on the smear alone.

ddx.vs: Platelets are usually more uniform in size without giant forms, and there is no driver mutation or megakaryocytic clustering in the marrow.
PMF often shows teardrop cells and leukoerythroblastosis, which are absent here, and its marrow megakaryocytes are atypical with cloud-like nuclei.
CML shows leukocytosis with a myelocyte peak and basophilia, and it is excluded by BCR::ABL1 testing.
EDTA-induced clumping produces large aggregates with a falsely low count, whereas here many single platelets are dispersed across the field.

1096.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片骨小樑間幾乎全被造血細胞占滿、看不到脂肪，以密集的骨髓性（myeloid）細胞為主，巨核細胞稀少，符合 JMML 的高細胞密度骨髓。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow (near 100%) between bony trabeculae
Diffuse sheets of maturing myeloid/myelomonocytic cells
Megakaryocytes decreased, only occasional forms seen
No discrete blast sheets or granulomas identified at this power
Interspersed dilated sinusoids with red cells
1096.describe_en: H&E section of bone marrow biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow (approaching 100%) with near-complete replacement of fat by sheets of maturing myeloid and myelomonocytic cells. Megakaryocytes are decreased, with only occasional forms identified. No discrete blast aggregates are evident at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a myeloproliferative process such as juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia in the appropriate clinical and genetic context; blast enumeration on aspirate and CD34 IHC are recommended.

ddx.vs: AML shows sheets of blasts (≥20%) with loss of maturation, highlighted by CD34/CD117 IHC.
Reactive hyperplasia preserves megakaryocytes and normal maturation and lacks RAS-pathway mutations.
CML shows small hypolobated megakaryocytes, basophilia and BCR::ABL1 fusion.

4232.recognize_zh: 幾乎所有細胞都是異常前骨髓球（abnormal promyelocyte）：核常呈摺疊或雙葉狀（bilobed），胞質充滿細小紫紅色嗜苯胺藍顆粒，顆粒甚至散落在背景中，符合急性前骨髓球性白血病（APL）。
features: Monotonous population of abnormal promyelocytes with moderate to abundant cytoplasm
Nuclei frequently folded, reniform, or bilobed with fine chromatin
Cytoplasm packed with fine purple-red azurophilic granules that partially obscure the nuclear outline
Numerous free granules in the background from disrupted cells
Normal maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors essentially absent in this field
4232.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows replacement by a monotonous population of abnormal promyelocytes. The cells have folded to bilobed nuclei with fine chromatin and abundant cytoplasm densely filled with fine azurophilic granules, many of which are released into the background. Auer rods are not clearly identified in this field, and normal hematopoietic maturation is not seen. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia (hypergranular type); urgent coagulation studies and confirmation of PML::RARA by FISH or RT-PCR are recommended.

ddx.vs: AML with maturation shows myeloblasts with salmon-pink granules and a single long Auer rod plus maturing neutrophils, rather than sheets of hypergranular bilobed promyelocytes.
Reactive promyelocytes have round eccentric nuclei with a distinct Golgi hof and are followed by normal maturation, without faggot cells.
Monoblasts/promonocytes also have folded nuclei but have gray-blue cytoplasm with sparse fine granules and are nonspecific esterase positive, with weak MPO.

exam.answer_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia, hypergranular — sheets of abnormal promyelocytes with folded/bilobed nuclei and dense azurophilic granules
pearls_zh: 考法：指顆粒密布、核摺疊或雙葉的細胞問是什麼細胞與診斷。答 abnormal promyelocytes，APL；並被追問遺傳異常 t(15;17)(q24;q21) PML::RARA。
Flow 典型表型：CD33+、CD13+（異質）、CD117+、MPO 強陽性，CD34−、HLA-DR−、CD11b−。
急症：易合併 DIC 與 hyperfibrinolysis 致命出血；形態懷疑就立刻給 ATRA、積極補 cryoprecipitate/血小板，不必等基因確認。
治療：低/中風險（WBC ≤10×10⁹/L）以 ATRA + arsenic trioxide 為標準；注意 differentiation syndrome 與 QTc 延長。WHO 5th 對 PML::RARA 的 APL 不設 blast 門檻。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 AML with maturation（t(8;21)）或反應性前骨髓球增生：t(8;21) 有單根長 Auer rod 與成熟中的中性球；反應性增生有完整成熟梯度，而非單一族群的雙葉異常前骨髓球。

quiz.q: 圖中細胞為何？最需立即處理的併發症與首先應給的藥物為何？
quiz.a: Abnormal promyelocytes（APL）；DIC/出血，立即給 ATRA

1032.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片顯示細胞量很多、細胞密集成片，但放大倍率太低，看不清個別細胞與噬血組織球，單憑此圖無法判讀噬血現象，只能評估抹片細胞量。
features: Very low magnification aspirate smear
Markedly cellular smear with dense sheets and clumps of nucleated cells
Intervening red cells in the background
A few scattered darker larger cells, possibly megakaryocytes, not resolvable
Individual cell morphology and phagocytic histiocytes cannot be assessed at this power
1032.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at scanning magnification shows a highly cellular specimen with dense sheets of nucleated cells and scattered larger dark cells. Cytologic detail is not resolvable at this power, and hemophagocytic histiocytes cannot be identified. The image establishes an adequate, cellular aspirate; evaluation for hemophagocytosis requires high-power examination of the smear.

4104.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆嗜中性球的細胞質內布滿粗大、深紫黑色的顆粒，明顯比正常嗜中性球的淡粉紅色顆粒粗而深，即毒性顆粒（toxic granulation）；紅血球上的小黑點多為染劑沉積假影。
features: Single segmented neutrophil with a normal-sized, lobated nucleus
Coarse, dark purple-black primary-like granules evenly distributed throughout cytoplasm
No Dohle bodies or cytoplasmic vacuoles clearly identified
Red cells with occasional poikilocytes (teardrop/helmet-like forms)
Fine dark dots on many red cells, most consistent with stain precipitate
4104.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil with numerous coarse, dark purple cytoplasmic granules distributed throughout the cytoplasm, consistent with toxic granulation. Dohle bodies and vacuolization are not clearly seen. Red cells show mild poikilocytosis, and fine dark dots overlying many red cells are most consistent with stain precipitate. Findings are consistent with toxic change, as seen in sepsis, inflammation or G-CSF therapy.
