ddx.vs: Alder-Reilly granules are present in all leukocyte types including lymphocytes and monocytes, and occur without infection.
Chediak-Higashi shows few giant, irregular fused granules rather than numerous fine coarse granules.
Overstaining darkens granules in all neutrophils and background elements uniformly, whereas true toxic granulation varies between cells with other toxic changes.

exam.answer_en: Toxic granulation — segmented neutrophil with coarse dark purple-black cytoplasmic granules
pearls_zh: 考法：指著嗜中性球問「胞質顆粒有何異常？」答 toxic granulation（主要顆粒變粗、染色加深），代表感染、敗血症或發炎。
常一起出現的 toxic changes：Döhle bodies（殘存粗糙內質網）、cytoplasmic vacuoles（空泡提示敗血症）與左移；G-CSF 治療也會出現。
先天性鑑別：Alder-Reilly anomaly（黏多醣症，顆粒粗大且見於各類白血球）、Chédiak-Higashi（巨大顆粒）、May-Hegglin（Döhle-like 包涵體 + 巨大血小板，MYH9）。
判讀時要排除染劑沉積：此圖紅血球上的小黑點是染劑沉積，不是細胞內構造。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Alder-Reilly anomaly 混淆：Alder-Reilly 的粗顆粒在淋巴球、單核球也可見且與感染無關；toxic granulation 只見於嗜中性球且隨感染消退。

quiz.q: 圖中嗜中性球胞質的變化稱為什麼？臨床最常代表什麼？
quiz.a: Toxic granulation；細菌感染／敗血症（或 G-CSF 使用）

4040.recognize_zh: 一串大型單核芽細胞（monoblast），細胞核圓形、染色質細緻並有核仁，細胞質豐富灰藍且布滿小空泡；最上方的芽細胞細胞質空泡內可見被吞噬的紅血球（erythrophagocytosis）。
features: Cluster of large blasts with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm and round to slightly indented nuclei
Fine, lacy chromatin with one or more distinct nucleoli
Numerous small cytoplasmic vacuoles in most blasts
Top blast contains a phagocytosed red cell within a clear vacuole (erythrophagocytosis)
Adjacent small neutrophil and pyknotic cells for size comparison
4040.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of large blasts with abundant gray-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm, round to slightly indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, and prominent nucleoli, morphologically monoblasts. One blast contains an engulfed red blood cell within a cytoplasmic vacuole. Erythrophagocytosis by leukemic blasts is characteristically associated with acute monoblastic/monocytic leukemia and with the KAT6A::CREBBP (t(8;16)(p11.2;p13.3)) fusion. Findings are consistent with acute monoblastic leukemia with erythrophagocytosis; nonspecific esterase cytochemistry, flow cytometry, and cytogenetics are recommended.

ddx.vs: Hemophagocytosis is performed by mature benign histiocytes with low N:C ratio and condensed chromatin, not by nucleolated blasts.
Megakaryoblasts may be vacuolated with cytoplasmic blebs but lack phagocytosis and are CD41/CD61-positive and NSE-negative.
Plasmablasts have eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and deeply basophilic cytoplasm and are CD138-positive rather than CD14/CD64-positive.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm and coarser chromatin, and express CD10/CD19/surface Ig with MYC rearrangement.

exam.answer_en: Acute monoblastic leukemia (FAB M5a) — vacuolated monoblasts with nucleoli, one showing erythrophagocytosis
pearls_zh: 考法：指最上方胞質含紅血球的芽細胞，問現象與相關遺傳；答 erythrophagocytosis，典型聯想 t(8;16)(p11;p13) KAT6A::CREBBP。
細胞化學：nonspecific esterase（α-naphthyl butyrate）陽性且可被 NaF 抑制；MPO 常陰性或弱陽性。
Flow：CD64、CD4、CD11b、CD14（成熟度較高者）、CD36 等單核系標記，lysozyme 可用於 IHC。
臨床：單核系 AML 常見牙齦腫、皮膚與 CNS 侵犯、高白血球 leukostasis；t(8;16) 常伴 DIC。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 HLH 的吞噬組織球：本圖吞噬細胞是有核仁、細緻染色質的芽細胞，且成群出現；HLH 巨噬細胞核成熟、胞質更豐富。

quiz.q: 圖中芽細胞吞噬紅血球，最常相關的染色體轉位為何？
quiz.a: t(8;16)(p11;p13) KAT6A::CREBBP

3976.recognize_zh: 剛果紅（Congo red）染色中間質布滿塊狀橘紅色無定形沉積物（長箭頭），並包覆血管，右上方短箭頭指向一群慢性發炎的淋巴漿細胞浸潤；橘紅色無細胞沉積即類澱粉，骨髓瘤病人應考慮 AL 類澱粉沉積症。
features: Nodular and sheet-like salmon-orange congophilic amorphous deposits (long arrow)
Deposits encircle small vessels and separate stromal fibroblasts
Aggregate of small dark lymphoplasmacytic inflammatory cells at upper right (short arrow)
Paucicellular stroma between deposits with occasional small capillaries
Polarization not shown
3976.describe_en: Congo red-stained section at intermediate power shows abundant nodular salmon-orange amorphous deposits in the interstitium and around vessels (long arrow). A small cluster of lymphocytes and plasma cells is present at the upper right (short arrow). The intervening stroma is paucicellular. Findings are consistent with amyloid deposition; in the setting of multiple myeloma this is most likely AL amyloid, pending confirmation of apple-green birefringence and amyloid typing.

ddx.vs: Hyalinized collagen is Congo red negative or only faintly stained and lacks apple-green birefringence.
LCDD deposits are Congo red negative and show monotypic light chain staining in basement membranes without fibrils.

ddx.dx: Nodular pulmonary AL amyloidoma with MALT lymphoma
ddx.vs: Localized amyloidoma may arise from an extranodal marginal zone lymphoma, which requires evaluation of the associated lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate for clonality.

3912.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有一條分枝的帶狀結構，裡面排列著許多細長、紡錘形的核，沿著淡紫色的膠質基質平行排列，這是骨髓小血管（微血管）的碎片，屬正常結構，不要誤認為腫瘤細胞團。
features: Elongated branching strand of pale lilac fibrillar stroma traversing the smear
Numerous spindle to oval endothelial/pericyte nuclei aligned parallel to the long axis
Nuclei with smooth contours and fine chromatin, no mitoses or pleomorphism
Hematopoietic cells and red cells trapped along the vessel, including myeloid and erythroid precursors
Scattered free red cells in the background
3912.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an elongated, branching capillary fragment composed of pale fibrillar stroma lined by numerous bland spindle-shaped endothelial nuclei oriented along its long axis. Hematopoietic precursors and red cells adhere to the vessel. There is no nuclear pleomorphism, mitotic activity or cohesive epithelial arrangement. Findings are consistent with a normal bone marrow blood vessel fragment in the aspirate.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma clusters are cohesive three-dimensional groups of large pleomorphic cells with nuclear molding and prominent nucleoli, not bland spindle nuclei along a linear stroma.
Fibrotic stromal fragments are more irregular with dense collagen and associated megakaryocytes, lacking a tubular branching vascular outline.
Spindled mast cells have metachromatic granules, and sarcoma cells show atypia and mitoses, unlike these bland endothelial nuclei.

3656.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中三系造血都在：左下有一顆成熟巨核細胞，顆粒球由前骨髓細胞到分葉核依序成熟，並夾雜濃縮圓核的紅血球母細胞，沒有原始細胞增多或明顯發育不良，屬於反應性骨髓。
features: Trilineage hematopoiesis with a mature megakaryocyte present
Granulocytic series showing full orderly maturation from promyelocytes to segmented neutrophils
Erythroid precursors with round dense nuclei and polychromatic cytoplasm, maturing normally
No increase in blasts; scattered promyelocytes with azurophilic granules
No overt dysplastic features in neutrophils or erythroid cells in this field
3656.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows cellular spicule trails with trilineage hematopoiesis. Granulocytic precursors show complete, orderly maturation to segmented neutrophils, erythroid precursors mature normally, and a morphologically unremarkable megakaryocyte is present. Blasts are not increased and no significant dysplasia is identified. Findings are consistent with a reactive/benign bone marrow aspirate.

ddx.vs: Would show dysplasia in ≥10% of cells of a lineage, such as hypogranular or pseudo-Pelger neutrophils, megaloblastoid erythroids or small hypolobated megakaryocytes, which are absent here.
Shows marked granulocytic hyperplasia with a myelocyte and neutrophil bulge, basophilia and small hypolobated megakaryocytes, rather than the balanced trilineage picture seen here.
Features an increase in blasts (≥20%) replacing normal maturation, which is not present in this field.

3720.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一條橫貫畫面的管狀結構，由一排細長梭形、首尾相接的內皮細胞核（endothelial nuclei）和淡藍色基質組成，周圍是被抹破的裸核細胞與紅血球，這是骨髓中的小血管。
features: Linear tubular structure composed of elongated spindle-shaped endothelial nuclei aligned end to end
Pale blue-grey fibrillar stromal/basement membrane material along the vessel
Adjacent smudged, bare hematopoietic nuclei with fine reticular chromatin (crush/smear artifact)
Scattered intact small lymphocytes, a neutrophil and red cells nearby
No atypical cohesive tumor cells within or around the vessel
3720.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a capillary-sized vessel traversing the field, composed of a row of elongated, spindle-shaped endothelial nuclei with pale blue fibrillar stroma. Numerous adjacent disrupted bare nuclei with smudged chromatin represent smearing artifact of hematopoietic cells, admixed with intact lymphocytes, a neutrophil and red cells. No cohesive atypical cells are present. Findings represent a normal marrow vascular/stromal element and should not be mistaken for a spindle-cell neoplasm or metastatic tumor.

ddx.vs: Metastatic cells form cohesive clusters of large pleomorphic cells with high N:C ratio and nuclear molding, not a single-file row of bland elongated endothelial nuclei.
Spindled mast cells contain abundant metachromatic purple granules, whereas these endothelial cells have agranular pale cytoplasm.
Fibroblastic fragments are haphazardly arranged with wavy nuclei and collagen rather than forming an organized tubular vessel wall.

3208.recognize_zh: 纖維性管壁中的一條小血管腔內擠滿大型異型細胞，核大、染色質空泡狀、核仁清楚，與紅血球混在管腔內，周圍間質內則無類似腫瘤細胞浸潤，符合血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Small vessel within a fibrous wall whose lumen is filled with large atypical lymphoid cells
Large cells with enlarged round-to-oval vesicular nuclei and distinct nucleoli
Tumor cells admixed with intraluminal red blood cells
Surrounding fibrous stroma largely free of tumor cells
Adjacent empty larger lumen at the top right
3208.describe_en: Section of a fibrous wall shows a small intramural vessel whose lumen is distended by large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, admixed with erythrocytes. Similar cells are also present in nearby small capillaries, while the surrounding stroma lacks a significant extravascular infiltrate. No mass-forming lesion is seen in this field. Findings are consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma; immunostaining for CD20 and an endothelial marker (CD34 or CD31) would confirm the intraluminal B-cell population.

ddx.vs: The intravascular NK/T variant is CD3epsilon+ CD56+ EBER+ and CD20-, requiring immunostaining to separate from the B-cell type.
Leukostasis shows circulating blasts or CLL cells with a corresponding peripheral blood leukocytosis rather than large atypical B cells confined to small vessels.
Metastatic emboli are cohesive clusters with epithelial or melanocytic markers rather than discohesive CD45+ CD20+ cells.
Reactive endothelial or histiocytic cells are bland, CD31+ or CD68+, and lack the large vesicular nuclei with nucleoli of lymphoma cells.

exam.answer_en: Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma — large atypical lymphoid cells confined to small vessel lumina without extravascular mass
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指血管腔內的大細胞，問「腫瘤在哪個腔室」；重點是只在血管內、周圍間質乾淨，答 IVLBCL。
IHC：CD20/PAX5 標出腫瘤 B 細胞，CD34 或 CD31 標出血管內皮證明位於管腔內；多數為 non-GCB 表型（MUM1+）。
臨床：常無淋巴結腫大或腫塊，以不明熱、神經症狀、皮膚病灶、LDH 升高表現；random skin biopsy 是常用診斷手段。
Asian variant 以 HLH 相關表現（全血球低下、肝脾腫大、骨髓噬血）為主；治療為 R-CHOP 類化療，CNS 侵犯風險需評估與預防。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為一般血管內的白血球或血栓中的細胞；IVLBCL 細胞大、核空泡狀有核仁，且 CD20+ 群聚於小血管，周邊血通常無相應 leukocytosis。

quiz.q: 大型異型淋巴細胞只填滿小血管腔、不形成腫塊，最可能的診斷？用哪個 IHC 組合確認？
quiz.a: Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma；CD20 + CD34/CD31

3144.recognize_zh: 數顆大型細胞具偏位圓核、粗塊狀（鐘面樣）染色質，以及豐富深藍色帶小空泡的胞質，在血液背景中成群出現，符合循環中的漿細胞（漿細胞白血病）。
features: Several large plasma cells with abundant deep blue cytoplasm and eccentric round nuclei
Coarsely clumped, clock-face-like chromatin; small nucleoli in some cells
Fine cytoplasmic vacuoles; perinuclear hof only subtle
Adjacent monocyte with folded nucleus and a small degenerated granulocyte for size comparison
Red cell background without striking rouleaux in this field
3144.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a group of large circulating plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin, occasional small nucleoli, and abundant deeply basophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm. A monocyte and a degenerating granulocyte are present nearby. The plasma cells are larger than typical mature plasma cells, suggesting some immaturity. Findings are consistent with plasma cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are fewer, smaller, and polytypic for kappa and lambda light chains.
LPL shows mainly small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with CD19/CD20 expression and MYD88 L265P rather than sheets of CD138-positive plasma cells.
Plasmablastic lymphoma cells have larger nuclei with prominent central nucleoli and very high proliferation, usually presenting as an extramedullary mass, often EBV-positive.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell leukemia — clusters of large circulating plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin and deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：旁邊有 monocyte 作大小對照，考官會問這群胞質深藍、核偏位的大細胞是什麼；比成熟漿細胞大、偶見核仁，代表較不成熟。
診斷門檻（WHO 5th / ICC 2022）：周邊血抹片循環漿細胞 ≥5% 即為 plasma cell leukemia。
Flow 確認單株性：CD38 bright、CD138+、CD19−、cytoplasmic kappa 或 lambda 單一限制；PCL 常 CD56 陰性。
primary PCL 常見 t(11;14)，也常伴高風險細胞遺傳異常；整體預後明顯差於一般 multiple myeloma。
需同時查 serum/urine protein electrophoresis、immunofixation、free light chain、鈣、肌酸酐與 LDH。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 plasmablastic lymphoma 或 reactive plasmacytosis 混淆；後者漿細胞數少、較小且 kappa/lambda 呈多株，PCL 為單株並伴 M protein。

quiz.q: 圖中胞質深藍、核偏位的大細胞以 flow 檢查，最能證明是腫瘤性的結果是什麼？
quiz.a: Cytoplasmic kappa 或 lambda 單一輕鏈限制（monotypic），CD38+/CD138+/CD19−

3080.recognize_zh: 胸水抹片中一大群黏著的上皮樣細胞旁，有兩顆胞質塞滿紫紅色異染性顆粒（metachromatic granules）的肥大細胞，另散在小淋巴球。
features: Large cohesive three-dimensional cluster of epithelioid cells with round eccentric nuclei and vacuolated blue cytoplasm
Two mast cells at the cluster edges with cytoplasm packed with purple-red metachromatic granules and a round nucleus
Additional granular cell within the cluster
Scattered small lymphocytes around the cluster
Clean background without red cells
3080.describe_en: Cytocentrifuge preparation of pleural fluid shows a large cohesive cluster of epithelioid cells with round eccentric nuclei and vacuolated basophilic cytoplasm. Two mast cells with cytoplasm filled with coarse purple metachromatic granules lie at the edges of the cluster, and small lymphocytes are scattered nearby. The epithelioid cluster cannot be definitively classified as reactive mesothelial cells versus metastatic carcinoma on morphology alone. Findings show mast cells in pleural fluid accompanying a cohesive epithelioid cell cluster; immunocytochemistry (calretinin, WT1, claudin-4, MOC-31) is recommended for the cluster.

ddx.vs: Basophils are smaller with a lobulated nucleus and fewer, larger, water-soluble granules, whereas mast cells have a round nucleus with densely packed granules.

ddx.dx: Reactive mesothelial cells vs metastatic adenocarcinoma
ddx.vs: Mesothelial cells show windows and knobby borders and are calretinin/WT1-positive, while adenocarcinoma forms three-dimensional balls with claudin-4/MOC-31 positivity.
Siderophages have golden-brown to blue-black refractile pigment and a bean-shaped nucleus rather than uniform purple metachromatic granules.

3016.recognize_zh: 高倍下兩個圓形芽細胞，只有極細的一圈淡藍細胞質，核染色質均勻細緻、呈點狀，沒有顆粒，核仁不明顯；周圍紅血球有乾燥假影，這是典型的前 B 淋巴芽細胞。
features: Two round blasts, about 1.5-2 times RBC diameter
Very high N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Round nuclei with smooth contours
Finely stippled, evenly distributed chromatin; nucleoli faint or inconspicuous
Agranular cytoplasm without Auer rods; adjacent RBCs show drying artifact
3016.describe_en: High-power view shows two round blasts with a very high N:C ratio and only a thin rim of agranular pale blue cytoplasm. The nuclei are round with smooth contours, finely stippled evenly distributed chromatin, and inconspicuous nucleoli. No cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods are present. Adjacent red cells display drying artifact. Findings are consistent with lymphoblasts, supporting precursor B-lymphoblastic leukemia when confirmed by flow cytometry (CD19, CD10, CD34, TdT).

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts usually have more cytoplasm, one or more distinct nucleoli, and may contain granules or Auer rods, and are MPO-positive or CD13/CD33/CD117-positive.
Mature lymphocytes have coarsely clumped chromatin with visible chromatin blocks, unlike the fine chromatin here.
Hematogones can look similar individually but show a maturing phenotypic spectrum on flow and do not replace the marrow.

exam.answer_en: Lymphoblasts of B-lymphoblastic leukemia — round blasts with thin agranular cytoplasmic rim, finely stippled chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍兩顆細胞，考官要你說出 lymphoblast 與 myeloblast 的形態差異：lymphoblast 較小、胞質極少、核仁不明顯、無顆粒與 Auer rod。
形態只能提示，分系需 flow：B 系 CD19、CD10、cCD79a、TdT；髓系 MPO、CD13、CD33、CD117。
WHO 5th 與 ICC 2022 的 B-ALL 分類以遺傳異常為主，如 BCR::ABL1、KMT2A 重組、ETV6::RUNX1、hyperdiploidy、hypodiploidy、iAMP21。
BCR::ABL1 陽性 B-ALL 需合併 TKI 治療，是初診時必須快速回報的分子檢查。
背景紅血球乾燥假影屬於製片問題，報告時不要描述為病理發現。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 myeloblast；myeloblast 胞質較多、核仁明顯、可有顆粒或 Auer rod 且 MPO 陽性，本圖細胞胞質僅一細圈且無顆粒。

quiz.q: 圖中兩顆母細胞沒有顆粒且核仁不明顯，最可能是哪一種 blast？初診時必須快速檢查的融合基因之一是什麼？
quiz.a: Lymphoblast；BCR::ABL1（t(9;22)）

2888.recognize_zh: 中倍 H&E：肉芽腫中央為粉紅色顆粒狀壞死，周圍是細長核的類上皮組織球與同心圓纖維，左下緣可見多核巨細胞（Langhans type），外圍紅髓充血。
features: Central granular eosinophilic necrosis with scattered nuclear debris
Epithelioid histiocytes with elongated vesicular nuclei arranged concentrically
Multinucleated giant cells at the granuloma periphery
Outer concentric fibrous rim; congested red pulp at corners
2888.describe_en: Higher-power H&E section of spleen shows a granuloma with a central zone of granular eosinophilic necrosis containing sparse nuclear debris. The necrosis is surrounded by epithelioid histiocytes with elongated vesicular nuclei in a concentric arrangement, with multinucleated giant cells at the periphery and an outer fibrous rim. Adjacent red pulp is congested. Findings are consistent with necrotizing granulomatous inflammation; infectious etiologies such as mycobacteria and fungi should be excluded with special stains and culture.

ddx.vs: Sarcoid granulomas lack central necrosis and are composed of tight epithelioid clusters with giant cells.
Necrobiotic nodules show fibrinoid collagen necrosis in skin/soft tissue context and are negative for organisms, which requires stains to confirm.
Lymphoma-associated granulomas are non-necrotizing and accompanied by atypical lymphoid cells, which are absent here.

exam.answer_en: Necrotizing (caseating) granulomatous inflammation of spleen — central eosinophilic necrosis rimmed by epithelioid histiocytes and multinucleated giant cells
pearls_zh: 考法：考官依序指中央粉紅顆粒狀區（caseous necrosis）、周圍拉長囊泡狀核細胞（epithelioid histiocytes）、外圍多核細胞（Langhans/multinucleated giant cell），要你逐一命名。
看到壞死性肉芽腫第一反應是感染：TB（AFB/Ziehl-Neelsen、TB-PCR、培養）與真菌（GMS/PAS）；台灣 TB 盛行，病史與影像必須對照。
Non-necrotizing granuloma 多見於 sarcoidosis、藥物、CVID、Hodgkin lymphoma 或 lymphoma 伴隨反應；有壞死時不應先下 sarcoidosis。
脾臟多發性 granulomatous lesion 在影像上可表現為多發低密度結節，臨床需與 lymphoma、metastasis、abscess 鑑別，脾切片/切除後需同送培養。
免疫低下者（HIV、TNF inhibitor、移植）可能肉芽腫形成不良，病原體數量反而多，特殊染色更重要。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把中央壞死誤認為纖維化或 infarct：caseous necrosis 為無結構顆粒狀粉紅伴核碎片、周圍有 palisading epithelioid histiocytes；infarct 則保留細胞輪廓鬼影且無肉芽腫邊緣。

quiz.q: 圍繞中央壞死、呈同心排列、核拉長呈囊泡狀的細胞稱為什麼？此病灶必做哪兩個特殊染色？
quiz.a: Epithelioid histiocytes；AFB（Ziehl-Neelsen）與 GMS（或 PAS）

2824.recognize_zh: 畫面擠滿白血球，涵蓋骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞、帶狀及分葉核中性球等完整成熟階段，並有嗜鹼性球與嗜酸性球，母細胞稀少，是慢性期 CML 周邊血「縮小版骨髓」的樣貌。
features: Marked leukocytosis with densely packed granulocytic cells
Full spectrum of granulocytic maturation, with myelocytes and segmented/band neutrophils predominating
Basophils with coarse dark purple granules and eosinophils with orange granules
Occasional promyelocytes and rare blast-like cells; blasts not increased
Occasional small lymphocyte/nucleated cell; platelets scattered
2824.describe_en: The smear shows a marked leukocytosis composed of granulocytes at all stages of maturation, with a myelocyte and mature neutrophil predominance. Basophils and eosinophils are readily identified. Promyelocytes and rare blast-like cells are present, but blasts are not increased. Neutrophils lack prominent toxic granulation or dysplasia. Given the very high cellularity, the preparation may be a thick peripheral blood area or buffy coat; the findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, chronic phase.

ddx.vs: Leukemoid reactions show toxic granulation and Döhle bodies, a mature neutrophil predominance without a myelocyte bulge, no basophilia, and are BCR::ABL1-negative.
aCML shows dysplastic hypogranular or pseudo-Pelger neutrophils, lacks basophilia and is BCR::ABL1-negative.
CMML shows absolute monocytosis (>=0.5 x 10^9/L and >=10% of WBC) with fewer circulating immature granulocytes.
Advanced disease shows increased blasts or basophils >=20%, which are not evident in this field.

exam.answer_en: Chronic myeloid leukemia, chronic phase (blood) — marked leukocytosis with full granulocytic maturation, myelocyte and neutrophil peaks, basophilia and eosinophilia
pearls_zh: 考法：考官問分類計數的特徵——myelocyte 與 segmented neutrophil 雙峰（myelocyte bulge）、basophil 與 eosinophil 增加、blasts 少；指深紫顆粒細胞要答 basophil。
CML 常以 WBC 顯著增加、脾腫大、血小板正常或升高表現；也可能在健檢無症狀時發現。
確診：PB 即可做 BCR::ABL1 RT-PCR（定性與 IS 定量）或 FISH；但初診仍建議骨髓檢查以 karyotype 看 additional chromosomal abnormalities 並評估 blast 比例。
預後評分：ELTS score（年齡、脾大小、PB blasts、血小板）用於預測 CML 相關死亡，已較 Sokal 常用於 TKI 時代。
WBC 極高時要注意 leukostasis 與 tumor lysis；初期可用 hydroxyurea 降白血球，等待 BCR::ABL1 確認後開始 TKI。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 leukemoid reaction、aCML 或 CNL 混淆：aCML 有明顯 dysgranulopoiesis 且無 basophilia、BCR::ABL1 陰性；CNL 以成熟 neutrophil 為主、少 immature、CSF3R 突變。

quiz.q: CML 周邊血分類計數中 myelocyte 與成熟 neutrophil 兩者比例偏高、metamyelocyte 相對少的現象稱為什麼？
quiz.a: Myelocyte bulge（bimodal peak of myelocytes and segmented neutrophils）

2696.recognize_zh: 視野中三顆嗜中性球的核都是單一圓形或橢圓形、染色質濃縮，細胞質淡且有細顆粒；成熟嗜中性球普遍不分葉，符合 Pelger-Huët 異常的低分葉表現。
features: Three neutrophils with round-to-oval non-segmented nuclei
Condensed, clumped chromatin despite lack of lobation
Moderate pale cytoplasm with fine granules; one cell with slightly vacuolated cytoplasm
Normochromic red cells with scattered polychromatic cells
Occasional small platelets
2696.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three neutrophils, each with a single round-to-oval nucleus with mature, condensed chromatin and no segmentation. Cytoplasm is pale with fine granules, and one cell shows slight cytoplasmic vacuolization. Red cells are normochromic with scattered polychromatic cells. Findings are consistent with hyposegmented neutrophils of Pelger-Huët type; the proportion of affected neutrophils and presence of dysplasia should be assessed to exclude pseudo-Pelger-Huët change.

ddx.vs: Myelocytes have round nuclei with finer, less condensed chromatin and usually more basophilic cytoplasm with primary granules.
Dysplastic cells are typically hypogranular, involve a subset of neutrophils, and occur with cytopenias or other dysplastic features.
Monocytes are larger with folded nuclei, lacy chromatin and gray-blue cytoplasm lacking neutrophilic granules.

exam.answer_en: Pelger-Huët anomaly — mature neutrophils with round/non-segmented nuclei and condensed chromatin but normal granulation
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著「核圓但染色質很成熟」的嗜中性球，問是 myelocyte 還是 Pelger-Huët；關鍵是染色質濃縮程度與細胞質顆粒是否正常。
遺傳性 Pelger-Huët anomaly 為 LBR（lamin B receptor）基因突變，體染色體顯性；雜合子多呈雙葉夾鼻眼鏡狀，同型合子則可見圓形單核（如本圖）。
遺傳型嗜中性球功能正常、無臨床症狀，重點是避免被誤判為 left shift 而做不必要的感染檢查或抗生素治療。
判斷先天或後天：先天型幾乎所有嗜中性球均受影響、顆粒正常、血球數正常；家族成員抹片可協助確認。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤認為 myelocyte／left shift：myelocyte 染色質較細、胞質偏藍有 primary granules，而本圖核染色質已成熟濃縮。

quiz.q: 圖中嗜中性球核不分葉但染色質濃縮，若病人無血球減少且家人抹片相同，最可能的診斷與致病基因為何？
quiz.a: Hereditary Pelger-Huët anomaly；LBR 基因突變

2632.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中左下方一顆偏藍紫色的紅血球及右側重疊紅血球內，可見多顆深藍色粗點狀顆粒（粗嗜鹼性點彩），其餘紅血球多為正常大小，配合病史提示鉛中毒。
features: A few red cells with coarse dark-blue cytoplasmic dots (coarse basophilic stippling)
Stippled cells show a faint polychromatic, bluish-gray tint; one polychromatic cell without clear stippling nearby
Majority of red cells normocytic and normochromic with central pallor
Occasional crenated red cells and small fragments
Scattered normal platelets; no leukocytes in field
2632.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows predominantly normocytic, normochromic red cells with occasional crenated forms. A small number of red cells, some with a faint polychromatic tint, contain coarse dark-blue punctate inclusions consistent with coarse basophilic stippling. Platelets appear adequate on this field, and no leukocytes are present for evaluation. The stippling is focal and only a few cells are affected in this field. Findings are consistent with coarse basophilic stippling, which in this clinical context supports lead toxicity; correlation with blood lead level is recommended.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are a small cluster of angular granules at the cell edge that are Prussian blue positive, unlike scattered iron-negative ribosomal stippling.
Thalassemia trait also shows stippling but with uniform microcytosis, hypochromia and target cells, and hemoglobin A2 is elevated.

ddx.dx: Fine basophilic stippling of polychromatic cells
ddx.vs: Fine stippling in reticulocytes is barely visible dust-like granularity, whereas lead causes coarse, distinct dots.

exam.answer_en: Coarse basophilic stippling in a few red cells — supports lead toxicity in the clinical context
pearls_zh: 考法：本圖 stippling 只在少數細胞，考官會指左下偏藍紫的紅血球，考你能否在正常背景中找出 stippled cell。
鉛抑制 pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase 導致 ribosomal RNA 聚集；亦抑制 ALA dehydratase 與 ferrochelatase，造成 ZPP 上升與 microcytic anemia。
確診靠 blood lead level；治療首重移除暴露來源，嚴重者使用螯合劑（如 succimer、CaNa2EDTA）。
Coarse stippling 不專屬鉛中毒：thalassemia、先天 pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase deficiency、MDS 亦可見，需搭配 MCV、Hb 分析與病史。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 polychromatic 紅血球的細微點狀或疊在紅血球上的血小板：lead 的點彩粗大分明、在細胞內；血小板為單一較大紫色顆粒體。

quiz.q: 在圖中偏藍紫紅血球內看到的深藍點稱為什麼？確認鉛中毒應安排哪項檢查？
quiz.a: Coarse basophilic stippling；blood lead level

2568.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中大片脂肪空泡佔據整個顆粒，只有沿基質及空泡邊緣零星分布的造血細胞，顯示骨髓顆粒細胞量低（hypocellular）。
features: Low-power marrow particle dominated by large, empty fat vacuoles
Scattered small hematopoietic cells lining fat spaces and stromal strands
Dark-staining stromal condensations without cellular sheets
No clusters of large atypical cells or blasts evident at this power
Cytologic detail and dysplasia not assessable at this magnification
2568.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power shows a marrow particle largely replaced by adipocytes, with only scattered hematopoietic cells along stromal strands and at the edges of fat vacuoles, indicating decreased cellularity. Cytologic detail is insufficient at this magnification to evaluate dysplasia or blast percentage. Cellularity should be confirmed on core biopsy. With supportive dysplasia, blast count and cytogenetic findings, the features are consistent with hypocellular myelodysplastic syndrome.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia has equally fatty particles, so distinction relies on absent dysplasia and clonal cytogenetics, often supported by PNH clone and immune-mediated features.
Hypoplastic AML is also hypocellular but has at least 20% blasts on high-power count, which cannot be judged at this magnification.
Poorly sampled or subcortical aspirates may appear fatty, so a representative trephine biopsy is needed to confirm true hypocellularity.

2504.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片中大量嗜酸性球系細胞：成熟雙葉嗜酸性球、含橘紅顆粒的嗜酸性骨髓球與後骨髓球，偶見顆粒較少或核分葉異常者，嗜酸性系明顯增加，符合嗜酸性球增多症候群的骨髓。
features: Marked increase in eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors (myelocytes, metamyelocytes)
Cytoplasm filled with orange-red granules; some precursors with mixed dark purple granules
Mature eosinophils with bilobed or ring-like segmented nuclei
Occasional eosinophils with sparser granulation or irregular nuclear lobation
Scattered neutrophils, normoblasts and small lymphocytes; free granules in background
2504.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a predominance of eosinophilic lineage cells at all stages of maturation, including eosinophilic myelocytes and metamyelocytes packed with orange-red granules and mature bilobed eosinophils. Occasional eosinophils show sparser granulation or irregular nuclear segmentation, a nonspecific finding. Neutrophils, normoblasts and small lymphocytes are present, and blasts are not increased in this field. Findings indicate marked eosinophilic hyperplasia, consistent with hypereosinophilic syndrome once reactive and clonal eosinophilic neoplasms have been excluded.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with PDGFRB or FGFR1 rearrangement
ddx.vs: These clonal eosinophilic neoplasms are morphologically similar and are separated by cytogenetics/FISH showing 5q32 or 8p11 rearrangement.
In lymphocyte-variant HES the eosinophils are reactive to a clonal aberrant T-cell population (e.g. CD3-/CD4+) detectable by flow cytometry.
CML shows neutrophilic predominance with basophilia and a myelocyte bulge and is BCR::ABL1 positive.

2376.recognize_zh: 數顆漿細胞的細胞質被大量圓形、淡藍到深藍的球狀包涵體（Russell bodies）塞滿，看起來像一串葡萄，核被推擠到一側，這是 Mott cell（葡萄細胞）的典型外觀。
features: Plasma cells with cytoplasm packed by numerous round, variably sized globular inclusions (Russell bodies)
Globules range from pale blue to deeply basophilic, giving a grape-cluster (Mott cell) appearance
Round to slightly irregular eccentric nuclei with clumped chromatin, partly obscured by the globules
One binucleate/indented nucleus in a Mott cell
Background red cells with a few platelets
2376.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows several plasma cells whose cytoplasm is distended by numerous round, variably sized pale to deep blue globular inclusions, consistent with Russell bodies forming Mott (grape) cells. The nuclei are eccentric with clumped chromatin and are partly obscured by the inclusions, and one cell has an indented or bilobed nucleus. These inclusions represent accumulated immunoglobulin within dilated endoplasmic reticulum. Mott cells can be seen in both reactive plasmacytosis and plasma cell neoplasms; clonality should be assessed by kappa/lambda studies and correlated with the overall plasma cell burden.

ddx.vs: Storage histiocytes have small central nuclei and granular or foamy cytoplasm with lipid material, lacking immunoglobulin globules and plasma cell nuclear features.
Basophil and mast cell granules are small, uniform, dark purple-black and metachromatic, not large pale blue globules.
Burkitt cells have clear lipid vacuoles in deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a high N:C ratio, rather than solid immunoglobulin globules in mature plasma cells.

exam.answer_en: Mott cells (grape cells) — plasma cells packed with multiple Russell bodies (cytoplasmic immunoglobulin globules)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指葡萄串樣細胞，問「這是什麼細胞、包涵體成分？」答 Mott cell，Russell bodies 為堆積於擴張 RER 的免疫球蛋白。
Russell body 在胞質；Dutcher body 為疊在核上的胞質內陷（假性核內包涵體），較常見於 lymphoplasmacytic/marginal zone lymphoma 與骨髓瘤，兩者常成對考。
Mott cell 本身不具診斷特異性：可見於反應性漿細胞增多（慢性感染、自體免疫）與 plasma cell neoplasm，需看總漿細胞比例與克隆性。
克隆性評估：kappa/lambda IHC 或 ISH、flow（CD38、CD138、CD19−、CD56+ 提示腫瘤性）；骨髓瘤診斷需 clonal BMPC ≥10% 加 myeloma-defining event。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 Russell bodies 誤認為 Burkitt 或單核母細胞的空泡：空泡是透明中空、出現在高核質比芽細胞；Mott cell 為成熟漿細胞，球體實心呈藍色。

quiz.q: 圖中葡萄串樣細胞內的圓球叫什麼？主要由什麼構成？
quiz.a: Russell bodies；堆積於擴張內質網的免疫球蛋白

2312.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中出現大量成群聚集的中大型母細胞（blasts），高核質比、細緻染色質、少量嗜鹼性細胞質，數量遠超過成熟白血球，搭配慢性骨髓性白血病病史即為急性轉化（blast crisis）。
features: Numerous medium to large blasts, many clumped in small aggregates
High N:C ratio with round to slightly irregular nuclei and fine chromatin
Scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm without obvious granules at this power
Occasional smudged/degenerated cells and a granular fragmented cell
Rare maturing neutrophil; red cells unremarkable at this magnification
2312.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low-intermediate power shows a marked increase in circulating blasts, many forming small aggregates. The blasts are medium to large with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm; maturing granulocytes are sparse and scattered smudged cells are present. Lineage cannot be assigned morphologically at this magnification. In a patient with known CML, BCR-ABL1-positive, the findings are consistent with blast phase; flow cytometry is required to distinguish myeloid from lymphoid blast phase.

ddx.vs: De novo disease lacks a prior chronic phase, basophilia and marked splenomegaly, and is separated by history and BCR-ABL1 transcript/cytogenetic pattern rather than blast morphology.
Lymphoblasts have scantier cytoplasm and denser chromatin, but distinction from lymphoid blast phase of CML requires flow cytometry and BCR-ABL1 in neutrophils/FISH.
Chronic phase shows a left-shifted spectrum dominated by myelocytes and segmented neutrophils with basophilia and few blasts, not sheets of blasts.

exam.answer_en: CML in blast phase (peripheral blood) — sheets of circulating blasts replacing the maturing granulocytic spectrum
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍周邊血充滿芽細胞，問「和 chronic phase 的血片有何不同？」答 chronic phase 為 myelocyte 與成熟嗜中性球為主加嗜鹼球，blast phase 由芽細胞主導。
定義：blasts ≥20%（PB 或 BM）或髓外芽細胞增生即為 blast phase；WHO 5th 另將 PB/BM 出現增加的 lymphoblasts 視為 blast phase 警訊。
形態無法定系，flow 區分 myeloid（MPO、CD13、CD33、CD117）與 lymphoid（CD19、CD10、TdT）；lymphoid BP 需排除 de novo Ph+ B-ALL。
治療：依既往 TKI 與 ABL1 kinase domain mutation 選擇 TKI，合併誘導化療，緩解後以 allogeneic HSCT 為目標；預後明顯差於 chronic phase。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤當成 de novo Ph+ B-ALL 或 AML：lymphoid BP 常為 p210，de novo Ph+ ALL 多為 p190；並需結合既往 chronic phase 病史與嗜中性球中 BCR::ABL1 的存在。

quiz.q: 此周邊血抹片充滿芽細胞，已知 CML 病人達到 blast phase 的芽細胞門檻為多少？
quiz.a: ≥20% blasts（PB 或 BM）

2184.recognize_zh: 組織中瀰漫成片的多形性淋巴樣細胞，大小不一，從小型到大型、核不規則並可見核仁，細胞之間有粉紅色間質與上皮樣組織球，缺乏特定亞型的結構特徵，是 PTCL, NOS 的典型「多形性混合」外觀。
features: Diffuse effacing infiltrate of lymphoid cells without follicles
Marked cytologic spectrum: small, medium and large cells
Irregular, vesicular to hyperchromatic nuclei with visible nucleoli in larger cells
Moderate pale to clear cytoplasm in some cells
Admixed histiocytes and eosinophilic stroma; scattered mitoses and apoptotic bodies
2184.describe_en: Section shows diffuse effacement by a polymorphous lymphoid infiltrate composed of small, medium and large cells with irregular, vesicular to hyperchromatic nuclei and visible nucleoli in the larger cells. Some cells have moderate pale to clear cytoplasm. Admixed histiocytes and eosinophilic stromal strands are present, together with scattered mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies. No follicular architecture or specific pattern is evident. Findings are suggestive of peripheral T-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified, pending T-cell immunophenotyping, TFH marker exclusion and TCR gene rearrangement studies.

ddx.vs: AITL shows arborizing high endothelial venules, expanded follicular dendritic cell meshworks, clear cells and TFH markers (PD1, CXCL13, ICOS).
cHL has rare large Reed-Sternberg cells (CD30+ CD15+ PAX5 weak, CD45-) in a reactive background rather than a continuous spectrum of atypical T cells.
THRLBCL has scattered CD20+ large B cells in a bland T-cell and histiocyte background, while small T cells lack atypia.
ALCL shows cohesive sheets of hallmark cells with strong uniform CD30 and frequent ALK positivity.

2056.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片低倍下，深藍色的小淋巴細胞浸潤緊貼著骨小樑表面分布，沿骨小樑形成帶狀或新月形聚集（paratrabecular aggregates），這種貼骨小樑的淋巴聚集是濾泡性淋巴瘤侵犯骨髓的典型型態。
features: Dense basophilic lymphoid infiltrates hugging and wrapping bony trabeculae (paratrabecular pattern)
Aggregates follow the contour of the trabeculae, forming band-like and crescentic collars
Intervening marrow shows residual trilineage hematopoiesis with scattered fat spaces
Overall marrow cellularity is increased for most ages
Cytologic detail of the lymphoid cells is not assessable at this magnification
2056.describe_en: Low-power bone marrow core biopsy shows dense lymphoid aggregates closely applied to and spreading along the surfaces of bony trabeculae. The intertrabecular spaces contain residual trilineage hematopoiesis and fat. Cytologic features cannot be evaluated at this magnification. The paratrabecular distribution is characteristic of bone marrow involvement by follicular lymphoma, which should be confirmed by immunohistochemistry (CD20, CD10, BCL2).

ddx.vs: Reactive aggregates are small, well-circumscribed, non-paratrabecular and interstitial, containing mixed T and B cells.
MCL can be paratrabecular but more often interstitial or nodular, and is cyclin D1/SOX11 positive and CD10 negative.
CLL/SLL typically shows non-paratrabecular nodular, interstitial or diffuse infiltrates of CD5+ CD23+ small round cells.
SMZL characteristically shows intrasinusoidal infiltration and nodular aggregates, and is CD10 negative.

exam.answer_en: Follicular lymphoma involving bone marrow — paratrabecular lymphoid aggregates hugging bony trabeculae
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍切片指著貼骨小樑的藍色帶狀浸潤問「這是什麼分布型態？最可能哪種淋巴瘤？」答：paratrabecular aggregates → follicular lymphoma。
IHC：CD20+、CD10+、BCL6+、BCL2+；骨髓內 paratrabecular 病灶 CD10 可能減弱，BCL2 陽性但需與反應性 T 細胞對照判讀，CD21 顯示 FDC 網常不明顯。
遺傳：約 85% nodal FL 帶 t(14;18)(q32;q21) IGH::BCL2，可用 FISH 確認；骨髓抽吸液常因 paratrabecular 病灶不易抽出而 flow 偽陰性，故骨髓切片分期較可靠。
臨床：骨髓侵犯即屬 Ann Arbor stage IV；FLIPI 預後分數含 stage III–IV，但低惡度 FL 無症狀時仍可 watch and wait。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為良性 reactive lymphoid aggregates：後者位於 interstitial、界線清楚、不貼骨小樑且 T/B 混合；貼骨小樑分布本身就應高度懷疑淋巴瘤。

quiz.q: 圖中淋巴細胞浸潤相對於骨小樑呈何種分布？最典型見於哪種淋巴瘤？
quiz.a: Paratrabecular pattern；follicular lymphoma

1992.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆多核巨大異型細胞，有強烈的細胞膜與胞質陽性染色（圖型提示 CD30），旁邊數顆大細胞染色較弱，周圍大量小淋巴球為陰性，呈現間變型的奇異巨細胞。
features: Central giant multinucleated cell with vesicular nuclei and strong membranous/cytoplasmic positivity
Adjacent large cells with weaker membranous and cytoplasmic staining
Isolated positive large cell at lower right
Background of numerous small, negative lymphocytes with dense nuclei
1992.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (antibody not labeled; pattern suggests CD30) shows a giant multinucleated atypical cell with strong membranous and cytoplasmic positivity, accompanied by a cluster of large cells with weaker staining. The background small lymphocytes are negative. This field alone resembles a Reed-Sternberg-like cell; in the context of sheets of large cells with a B-cell immunophenotype, findings are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, anaplastic variant.

ddx.vs: Reed-Sternberg cells in cHL are CD15-positive, CD45-negative, and weakly PAX5-positive, and are isolated rather than part of sheets of CD20-positive large cells.
THRLBCL has scattered large CD20-positive cells in a T-cell and histiocyte background, typically without strong CD30 expression.
ALCL shows strong uniform CD30 in all tumor cells with a T-cell or null phenotype and no B-cell marker expression.

1800.recognize_zh: 高倍周邊血液抹片中多數紅血球周邊有數個長短、粗細不一且間距不規則的尖刺（箭頭），部分細胞緻密缺乏中央淡染區，符合棘狀紅血球（spur cell/acanthocyte）。
features: Red cells with irregularly spaced spicules of unequal length and width, some with knob-like tips (arrows)
Some spiculated cells are dense without central pallor; others retain a central pale zone
Admixed cells with finer, more regular crenation resembling echinocytes
An occasional ovalocyte with preserved central pallor
A neutrophil and scattered platelets in the background
1800.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows many red cells with irregular, unevenly distributed spicules of variable length and thickness (arrows); several are dense with loss of central pallor. Some cells show finer, more regular projections overlapping with echinocytic change. A neutrophil and platelets are present. Findings are consistent with acanthocytes (spur cells), as seen in spur cell hemolytic anemia of severe liver disease; correlation with liver function is recommended.

ddx.vs: Echinocytes have numerous short, uniform, evenly spaced projections around the whole circumference with central pallor, typical of uremia or drying artifact.
Keratocytes have one or two horn-like projections flanking a ruptured vacuole, as seen in microangiopathic hemolysis, rather than multiple spicules.
These hereditary acanthocytoses are morphologically similar and are separated by Kell antigen testing or lipid studies.

exam.answer_en: Spur cells (acanthocytes) — red cells with irregular, unevenly spaced spicules of unequal length, some knob-tipped, many dense without central pallor
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍考官指箭頭要你描述刺的特徵：數量少（約 2–20）、長短粗細不一、間距不規則、尖端可呈小球狀，這是 acanthocyte 的判讀要點。
同一視野混有 echinocyte 樣細胞時，判讀應以最典型的不規則刺細胞為準，並回顧臨床（肝功能、膽紅素）。
spur cell anemia：重度肝病合併溶血（網狀紅血球上升、haptoglobin 下降、間接膽紅素上升），常伴脾腫大。
McLeod phenotype 為 X 性聯（XK 基因），紅血球 Kx 缺乏、Kell 抗原減弱，伴 acanthocytosis 與神經肌肉症狀，常考於血庫。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 keratocyte（horn cell）混淆；keratocyte 只有一到兩個角狀突起、見於 microangiopathic hemolysis，acanthocyte 則是多個不規則刺環繞細胞。

quiz.q: 寫出區分圖中 acanthocyte 與 echinocyte 的兩個形態特徵。
quiz.a: Acanthocyte 刺少、長短不一且分布不均，多無中央淡染；echinocyte 刺短、均勻等距，保留中央淡染區。

1736.recognize_zh: 抹片中一群中大型芽細胞，細胞核圓或略凹陷、染色質細緻、可見多個核仁，細胞質少量淡藍色且看不到顆粒或Auer小體，也沒有成熟中的顆粒球，符合未分化成熟的急性骨髓性白血病（AML without maturation）。
features: Medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly indented or folded nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin
One to several distinct nucleoli per nucleus
Scant to moderate pale blue agranular cytoplasm; no Auer rods seen
No maturing granulocytic cells in this field; background of red cells
1736.describe_en: Wright-Giemsa-stained smear shows a population of medium to large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, and conspicuous nucleoli. The cytoplasm is scant to moderate, pale blue, and agranular without Auer rods. No maturing myeloid cells are present in this field. Morphology alone cannot establish lineage; confirming myeloid lineage requires MPO positivity in at least 3% of blasts or flow cytometry, with fewer than 10% maturing granulocytic cells in the marrow. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia without maturation in the appropriate immunophenotypic context.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts may be morphologically indistinguishable but are MPO negative and express B- or T-lineage markers on flow cytometry.
AML with minimal differentiation has fewer than 3% MPO-positive blasts and is identified only by myeloid markers on flow cytometry.
AML with maturation shows at least 10% maturing granulocytes (promyelocytes onward) and more frequent granules and Auer rods.
Monoblasts have more abundant, often vacuolated cytoplasm with pseudopods, are nonspecific esterase positive, and express CD14/CD64 rather than being MPO-strong.

exam.answer_en: Acute myeloid leukemia without maturation — agranular medium-large blasts with fine chromatin and distinct nucleoli, no maturing granulocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：考官問「這是 AML 還是 ALL？形態能定嗎？」答形態無法確定系別；需 MPO/Sudan black B ≥3% 母細胞陽性或流式證實骨髓系。
定義（依分化分類）：母細胞佔非紅血球系細胞 ≥90%，成熟中顆粒球 <10%，且 ≥3% 母細胞 MPO 陽性；與 AML with minimal differentiation（MPO <3%）靠此區分。
流式：CD34、CD117、CD13、CD33、HLA-DR 常陽性，MPO 可陽性；無 B/T 系專一標記。
WHO 5th 將此類歸入「依分化定義的 AML」，需先排除有定義性遺傳異常（如 NPM1、CEBPA、KMT2A 重組）與 AML-MR 後才使用，且需 ≥20% 母細胞。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤為 ALL；兩者母細胞都可無顆粒，本圖可見多個明顯核仁與稍多細胞質，但真正區分仍靠 MPO 細胞化學或流式（CD13/CD33/CD117 對 CD19/cCD3）。

quiz.q: 圖中無顆粒、無 Auer rod 的母細胞，要以哪個細胞化學染色結果區分 AML without maturation 與 AML with minimal differentiation？
quiz.a: MPO（或 Sudan black B）：≥3% 母細胞陽性為 without maturation，<3% 為 minimal differentiation。

60296.recognize_zh: 中央大細胞有圓形核、細緻顆粒狀染色質，外圍是一圈無顆粒的深藍色細胞質，核周稍淡染，比周圍的髓系細胞和晚期幼紅血球都大，符合原紅血球（proerythroblast）。
features: Large round cell, among the largest in the field
Round central nucleus with finely granular chromatin; nucleoli are indistinct at this resolution
High N:C ratio with a distinct rim of intensely basophilic, agranular cytoplasm
Faint perinuclear clearing (pale zone around the nucleus)
Background marrow with later normoblasts, myelocytes, metamyelocytes and bands
60296.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements, including myelocytes, band forms and late normoblasts with pyknotic nuclei. The central cell is large with a round nucleus, finely granular chromatin and a rim of deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with slight perinuclear clearing. No cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods are present. Findings are consistent with a proerythroblast, the earliest morphologically recognizable erythroid precursor.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have lighter blue to gray cytoplasm, more open chromatin with prominent nucleoli and may contain azurophilic granules or Auer rods, unlike the intensely basophilic agranular cytoplasm here.
Basophilic normoblasts are smaller with coarser checkerboard chromatin and no nucleoli.
Plasma cells have an eccentric nucleus and a prominent paranuclear hof, whereas this nucleus is central.
Megakaryoblasts often show cytoplasmic blebs and require CD41/CD61, and lymphoma cells lack erythroid maturation; immunophenotyping (CD71, E-cadherin, glycophorin) separates them.

exam.answer_en: Proerythroblast — large cell with round nucleus, fine chromatin and a rim of deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm with perinuclear clearing
pearls_zh: 考法：骨髓抹片中考官指最大的深藍色無顆粒細胞，問「myeloblast 還是 proerythroblast？」關鍵是深藍無顆粒細胞質、核周淡染與細胞質邊緣可有小突起。
Proerythroblast 是形態上最早可辨認的紅血球系前驅細胞；IHC 可用 E-cadherin、CD71 協助確認。
Parvovirus B19 感染：骨髓出現 giant pronormoblasts，核內有嗜酸性包涵體，合併紅血球系發育停滯；溶血性貧血病人會引發 aplastic crisis。
Pure erythroid leukemia（WHO 5th：AML with erythroid differentiation）定義為紅血球系 ≥80% 且其中 proerythroblasts ≥30%，常合併複雜核型與 TP53 突變。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 myeloblast：myeloblast 細胞質較淡藍、可有少量顆粒或 Auer rod、MPO 陽性；proerythroblast 細胞質極深藍、完全無顆粒且 MPO 陰性。

quiz.q: 病人有遺傳性球形紅血球症突然血紅素驟降、reticulocyte 近零，骨髓出現巨大的這種細胞並有核內包涵體，最可能病因為何？
quiz.a: Parvovirus B19 感染引起 aplastic crisis

136.recognize_zh: 血液抹片與骨髓切片只看到成熟、形態正常的嗜酸性球增多，沒有母細胞或非典型淋巴球；線索在流式細胞圖：一群 CD3 陰性、CD5 強陽性、CD4 陽性、CD8 陰性並部分失去 CD7 的異常 T 細胞，支持淋巴球變異型嗜酸性球增多症候群（L-HES）。
features: Peripheral blood eosinophilia composed of mature bilobed eosinophils with abundant orange-red granules and no obvious hypogranularity, hypersegmentation or vacuolization
Occasional small lymphocytes without convincing atypia; no circulating blasts or immature myeloid cells; unremarkable red cells
Marrow core mildly hypercellular with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis and increased eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors
Megakaryocytes normal in number and morphology; no blast clusters, fibrosis or mast cell aggregates evident
Flow cytometry: aberrant T-cell population that is surface CD3-negative, bright CD5+, CD2 bright, CD4+, CD8- with partial loss of CD7, separate from normal CD3+ T cells
136.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows eosinophilia consisting of mature, morphologically unremarkable eosinophils with bilobed nuclei and abundant granules; lymphocytes are few and lack cytologic atypia, and no blasts are seen. The bone marrow core biopsy is mildly hypercellular with trilineage hematopoiesis, increased mature eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors, and morphologically normal megakaryocytes, without increased blasts or fibrosis. Flow cytometry of peripheral blood identifies an immunophenotypically aberrant T-cell population that lacks surface CD3 but expresses bright CD5, CD2 and CD4, is CD8-negative, and shows partial loss of CD7. Morphology alone is nonspecific; together with the aberrant CD3-/CD4+ T-cell population (and a clonal TCR rearrangement with negative PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2/BCR-ABL1 studies per history), findings are consistent with the lymphocytic variant of hypereosinophilic syndrome.

ddx.vs: Morphology may be identical, so the discriminator is ancillary: FISH/RT-PCR for FIP1L1-PDGFRA (often with elevated tryptase and B12, spindled mast cells) versus a normal tryptase and an aberrant CD3-/CD4+ T-cell clone here.
Also shows mature normal eosinophils, but lacks an immunophenotypically aberrant clonal T-cell population on flow cytometry and TCR studies.
Requires a myeloid clonal marker or increased blasts (>2% PB or 5-19% BM) and often shows dysplastic eosinophils, whereas this marrow has no blast increase and the clone is T-lymphoid.

ddx.dx: Mature T-cell lymphoma with eosinophilia (e.g., Sezary syndrome, peripheral T-cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Those show overtly atypical (cerebriform or large) circulating or tissue T cells with loss of multiple pan-T antigens and organ infiltration, while L-HES T cells are cytologically bland and the disease is indolent.

captions: PB, low power: increased mature eosinophils with a lymphocyte and normal red cells
PB, high power: three mature bilobed eosinophils with normal granulation and a bland lymphocyte
BM biopsy H&E, low power: mildly hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis
BM biopsy H&E, high power: increased eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors with a normal megakaryocyte
Flow, CD5 vs CD3: gated CD3-negative, bright CD5+ aberrant T-cell population (blue) separate from normal CD3+ T cells
Flow, CD4 vs CD8: aberrant population is CD4+ CD8-
Flow, CD2 vs CD7 (lymphocyte gate): aberrant population is bright CD2+ with partial loss of CD7

72.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中滿是顆粒粗大的異常前骨髓細胞，核呈雙葉或摺疊（butterfly/sliding-plate），部分細胞可見成束的 Auer rods（faggot cells）；切片中細胞質豐富、顆粒狀的細胞成片取代骨髓。臨床有 DIC，染色體與 dual-fusion FISH 雖未見 t(15;17)，RT-PCR 仍證實 PML-RARA。
features: Sheets of large abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm packed with coarse azurophilic granules
Bilobed, folded or reniform nuclei (butterfly/sliding-plate shapes) with fine chromatin and visible nucleoli
Numerous cells with multiple Auer rods in bundles (faggot cells)
Core biopsy: hypercellular marrow effaced by monotonous cells with ample granular eosinophilic cytoplasm; strong diffuse cytoplasmic IHC positivity (consistent with MPO)
Peripheral blood: rare circulating atypical granulated cells with folded nuclei; leukopenic background
Karyotype with t(1;11)(p32;q23) and del(13q) but no t(15;17); interphase FISH with separate PML/RARA signals (no fusion)
72.describe_en: The peripheral blood smear shows leukopenia with rare circulating atypical cells that have folded nuclei and granular cytoplasm. The bone marrow core biopsy is markedly hypercellular and effaced by sheets of cells with abundant granular eosinophilic cytoplasm and round-to-reniform nuclei. On immunohistochemistry, these cells show strong, diffuse cytoplasmic positivity, consistent with a myeloperoxidase stain. The aspirate is dominated by abnormal promyelocytes with coarse azurophilic granules, bilobed or sliding-plate nuclei, and frequent cells containing bundles of Auer rods (faggot cells). G-banded karyotype shows 46,XY,t(1;11)(p32;q23),del(13)(q12q22) without t(15;17), and dual-fusion interphase FISH shows no PML-RARA fusion; however, RT-PCR detected a PML-RARA transcript. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia with a cryptic PML-RARA fusion.

ddx.vs: The microgranular variant shows bilobed nuclei with sparse or dust-like granules and often leukocytosis with CD34/HLA-DR positivity, whereas these cells are overtly hypergranular with faggot cells.

ddx.dx: APL-like AML with variant RARA partner (e.g., ZBTB16-RARA)
ddx.vs: ZBTB16-RARA cases have regular round nuclei, fewer Auer rods and pseudo-Pelger cells and are ATRA-resistant, and they are separated from this case by RARA break-apart FISH or RT-PCR rather than by morphology.

ddx.dx: AML with maturation / NPM1-mutated AML with cup-like nuclei
ddx.vs: These contain agranular or finely granular blasts and lack sheets of hypergranular promyelocytes with faggot cells, and they are CD34 and/or HLA-DR positive without a PML-RARA fusion.

ddx.dx: Reactive promyelocyte-rich marrow (G-CSF effect, recovery after agranulocytosis)
ddx.vs: Recovering marrow shows normal promyelocytes with round nuclei, a perinuclear hof, and orderly progression to mature neutrophils, without Auer rods or DIC.

captions: Bone marrow core biopsy, low power: hypercellular marrow effaced by sheets of granular cells with hemorrhage (H&E)
Peripheral blood: atypical cell with folded nucleus and granular cytoplasm (Wright-Giemsa)
Peripheral blood: circulating atypical granulated cell with irregular nucleus (Wright-Giemsa)
Core biopsy, high power: monotonous cells with abundant granular eosinophilic cytoplasm and reniform nuclei (H&E)
Core biopsy, higher power: sheets of promyelocyte-like cells with ample granular cytoplasm (H&E)
Core biopsy immunohistochemistry: strong diffuse granular cytoplasmic positivity in leukemic cells (consistent with MPO)
Aspirate: hypergranular promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and Auer rods (Wright-Giemsa)
Aspirate: abnormal promyelocytes with sliding-plate nuclei and faggot cells containing Auer rod bundles
Aspirate: multiple faggot cells with bundles of Auer rods and coarse azurophilic granules
G-banded karyogram of a normal 46,XY metaphase (the normal clone)
G-banded karyogram of the abnormal clone: t(1;11)(p32;q23) and del(13)(q12q22) (arrows); no t(15;17)
Interphase FISH with PML/RARA dual-fusion probe: two separate red and two separate green signals, no fusion
Metaphase FISH: two sets of juxtaposed red-green signals on the chromosomes; the probe set is not specified in the image, so interpret alongside the report

exam.answer_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia (hypergranular) — abnormal promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and faggot cells; cryptic PML::RARA detected by RT-PCR
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會指胞質中成束 Auer rods 的細胞問名稱（faggot cell），並問立即處置——懷疑 APL 就立刻給 ATRA，不必等基因確認。
急症：APL 常合併 DIC 與出血，需積極補充血小板、fibrinogen（cryoprecipitate）；早期出血死亡是主要風險。
遺傳：t(15;17) PML::RARA；本例核型與 FISH 皆陰性，屬 cryptic/insertion，靠 RT-PCR 證實——陰性 FISH 不能排除 APL。
治療：低/中風險（WBC ≤10×10⁹/L）以 ATRA + arsenic trioxide 為標準；要監測分化症候群與 QTc。
流式：典型 CD34−、HLA-DR−、CD33 強、CD117+、CD11b−；MPO 強陽性。WHO 5th 以 PML::RARA 定義、不設母細胞門檻。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 G-CSF 或恢復期的反應性前骨髓細胞增多混淆：反應性者有 Golgi 淡染區、成熟梯度完整、無 faggot cell 與 DIC；亦須注意微顆粒變異型的雙葉核。

quiz.q: 胞質中含多根成束 Auer rods 的異常前骨髓細胞稱為什麼？應立即給予哪種藥？
quiz.a: Faggot cell；ATRA（all-trans retinoic acid）

8.recognize_zh: 周邊血與骨髓可見細緻染色質、有核仁的芽細胞（blasts），同時有多核／核碎裂的紅血球前驅細胞與核分離的巨核細胞，屬多系發育不良；流式細胞儀芽細胞為 CD34+CD117+CD13+、部分 MPO+，核型為 -7（箭頭），符合具骨髓發育不良相關變化的 AML（AML-MRC）。
features: Blasts: medium to large cells with high N:C ratio, fine dispersed chromatin, prominent nucleoli and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm, present in blood and marrow
Dyserythropoiesis: erythroid precursor with multinucleation/nuclear budding (four to five nuclear fragments)
Dysmegakaryopoiesis: megakaryocytes with multiple widely separated round nuclei on aspirate and biopsy
Flow cytometry: CD45-dim, low side scatter population positive for CD34, CD117, CD13, with partial MPO and dim/partial CD33, negative for CD15, CD19, CD7 and CD3
Karyotype: loss of one chromosome 7 (monosomy 7), an MDS-defining abnormality
8.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating blasts with fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm, with mild red cell poikilocytosis. The bone marrow aspirate contains increased myeloblasts accompanied by multilineage dysplasia, including multinucleated erythroid precursors and megakaryocytes with multiple separated nuclei, the latter also evident on the core biopsy. Flow cytometry identifies a CD45-dim, low side scatter myeloblast population expressing CD34, CD117, CD13 and partial MPO, without CD15, CD7 or lymphoid markers. Karyotype shows monosomy 7. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes (AML-MR in WHO 5th edition), provided blasts are at least 20% and prior cytotoxic therapy is excluded.

ddx.vs: Shows the same dysplasia and immunophenotype but blasts are below 20% of marrow nucleated cells, so a blast count determines the category.
Morphology and monosomy 7 can be identical, and only a history of prior cytotoxic chemotherapy or radiation separates it.

ddx.dx: AML with NPM1 mutation with multilineage dysplasia
ddx.vs: Frequently CD34-negative with cup-like nuclei and normal karyotype, and NPM1 mutation takes precedence over dysplasia-based classification.
Can show multinucleated erythroid precursors and nuclear abnormalities, but lacks increased CD34+ blasts and clonal cytogenetics and corrects with B12/folate.

captions: Peripheral blood: circulating blast
Bone marrow aspirate: blasts with erythroid precursors and a multilobated erythroid form
Bone marrow aspirate: multinucleated erythroid precursor (dyserythropoiesis) and blasts
Bone marrow aspirate: megakaryocyte with widely separated nuclei
Core biopsy: dysplastic megakaryocytes with separated nuclear lobes
Flow cytometry: CD34+, CD117+, CD13+, partial MPO+ myeloblasts (red)
Karyotype: monosomy 7 (arrow)

exam.answer_en: AML, myelodysplasia-related (AML-MR) — increased myeloblasts with multilineage dysplasia and monosomy 7
pearls_zh: 考法：指多核紅血球前驅細胞或核分離的巨核細胞問發育不良類型，再指芽細胞；需芽細胞 ≥20% 才稱 AML。
WHO 5th 將 AML-MRC 改名 AML-MR，定義依據為 MDS 病史、MDS 相關細胞遺傳異常或基因突變（ASXL1、SRSF2 等）；單純形態多系發育不良已不作為定義條件。
ICC 2022 分為 AML with myelodysplasia-related gene mutations 與 AML with myelodysplasia-related cytogenetic abnormalities；-7 屬後者。
須先排除 therapy-related 與具優先定義性基因異常（如 NPM1）者。
預後較差；CPX-351（liposomal daunorubicin/cytarabine）核准用於 AML-MRC 與 therapy-related AML。
